        }

                            + ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::size_of::<u32Ps3>()

        unsafe impl Send for BinXbox {}
        unsafe impl Send for BinPs3 {}
        impl BinPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(data: Arc<[u8]>) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = BinHeaderPc::from_data(&data).context("header")?;
                let strings = types::StringsPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        header.strings_offset.to_native() as usize,
                        header.strings_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                let asset_handles = AssetHandlePc::slice_from_data(
                        &data[header.asset_handle_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        header.asset_handle_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("asset_handles")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!("Bin headers in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                    );
                };
                let mut raw_data = asset_handles
                    .iter()
                    .map(|info| (
                        info.key.to_native(),
                        CompressedDataRef::from_bytes(
                            &data,
                            info.offset.to_native() as usize,
                            info.size_comp.to_native() as usize,
                            info.size.to_native() as usize,
                        ),
                    ));
                let split = header.vdata_num.to_native() as usize;
                let mut model_data = IndexMap::with_capacity(split);
                let mut texture_data = IndexMap::with_capacity(
                    asset_handles.len() - split,
                );
                for _ in 0..split {
                    let (k, val) = raw_data.next().unwrap();
                    model_data.insert(k, val);
                }
                for _ in split..asset_handles.len() {
                    let (k, val) = raw_data.next().unwrap();
                    texture_data.insert(k, val);
                }
                let header = NonNull::from_ref(header);
                let asset_handles = NonNull::from_ref(asset_handles);
                Ok(Self {
                    _data: data,
                    header,
                    asset_handles,
                    strings,
                    model_data,
                    texture_data,
                })
            }
        }

        impl BinPc {
            pub fn parse(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
                self.model_data
                    .par_values()
                    .chain(self.texture_data.par_values())
                    .try_for_each(|d| {
                        d.get()?;
                        Ok::<_, anyhow::Error>(())
                    })?;
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn header(&self) -> &BinHeaderPc {
                unsafe { self.header.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn strings(&self) -> &types::StringsPc {
                &self.strings
            }
            pub fn asset_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePc] {
                unsafe { self.asset_handles.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn model_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePc] {
                &self.asset_handles()[..self.header().vdata_num.to_native() as usize]
            }
            pub fn texture_handles(&self) -> &[AssetHandlePc] {
                &self.asset_handles()[self.header().vdata_num.to_native() as usize..]
            }
        }

            impl std::str::FromStr for VertexUsage {
                type Err = anyhow::Error;
                fn from_str(s: &str) -> Result<Self, Self::Err> {
                    let string = s.to_lowercase();
                    let s = string.as_str();
                    match s {
                        "position" => Ok(Self::Position),
                        "normal" => Ok(Self::Normal),
                        "tangent" => Ok(Self::Tangent),
                        "blendweight" => Ok(Self::BlendWeight),
                        "blendindices" => Ok(Self::BlendIndices),
                        "psize" => Ok(Self::PSize),
                        s => {
                            if s.starts_with("color(") {
                                Ok(
                                    s[6..]
                                        .split(')')
                                        .next()
                                        .unwrap()
                                        .parse::<usize>()
                                        .map(|i| Self::Color(i))?,
                                )
                            } else if s.starts_with("texturecoord(") {
                                Ok(
                                    s[13..]
                                        .split(')')
                                        .next()
                                        .unwrap()
                                        .parse::<usize>()
                                        .map(|i| Self::TextureCoord(i))?,
                                )
                            } else if s.starts_with("pad(") {
                                Ok(
                                    s[4..]
                                        .split(')')
                                        .next()
                                        .unwrap()
                                        .parse::<usize>()
                                        .map(|i| Self::Pad(i))?,
                                )
                            } else {
                                Err(
                                    ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                        ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                format_args!("unknown vertex usage {0}", s),
                                            )
                                        }),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            impl VertexUsage {
                pub fn order(&self) -> usize {
                    match self {
                        Self::Position => 0,
                        Self::BlendWeight | Self::Pad(0) => 1,
                        Self::BlendIndices | Self::Pad(1) => 2,
                        Self::Pad(2) => 3,
                        Self::Pad(3) => 4,

                        Self::TextureCoord(2) => 11,

                        Self::Pad(5) => 13,
                        Self::Pad(6) => 14,
                        Self::Pad(7) => 15,
                        Self::Tangent => 16,
                        Self::PSize => 17,
                        _ => usize::MAX,

                        Self::Int(vals) => VertexValPc::Int(vals[i].clone().into()),
                        Self::Color(vals) => VertexValPc::Color(vals[i].clone().into()),
                        Self::Vector2(vals) => {
                            VertexValPc::Vector2(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                        Self::Vector3(vals) => {
                            VertexValPc::Vector3(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                        Self::Vector4(vals) => {
                            VertexValPc::Vector4(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                    }
                }
                pub fn get_xbox(&self, i: usize) -> VertexValXbox {
                    match self {
                        Self::Int(vals) => VertexValXbox::Int(vals[i].clone().into()),
                        Self::Color(vals) => VertexValXbox::Color(vals[i].clone().into()),
                        Self::Vector2(vals) => {
                            VertexValXbox::Vector2(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                        Self::Vector3(vals) => {
                            VertexValXbox::Vector3(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                        Self::Vector4(vals) => {
                            VertexValXbox::Vector4(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                    }
                }
                pub fn get_ps3(&self, i: usize) -> VertexValPs3 {
                    match self {
                        Self::Int(vals) => VertexValPs3::Int(vals[i].clone().into()),
                        Self::Color(vals) => VertexValPs3::Color(vals[i].clone().into()),
                        Self::Vector2(vals) => {
                            VertexValPs3::Vector2(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                        Self::Vector3(vals) => {
                            VertexValPs3::Vector3(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                        Self::Vector4(vals) => {
                            VertexValPs3::Vector4(vals[i].clone().into())
                        }
                    }
                }
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    match self {
                        Self::Int(vals) => vals.len(),
                        Self::Color(vals) => vals.len(),
                        Self::Vector2(vals) => vals.len(),
                        Self::Vector3(vals) => vals.len(),
                        Self::Vector4(vals) => vals.len(),
                    }
                }
                pub fn size(&self) -> usize {
                    match self {
                        Self::Int(..) => 4,
                        Self::Color(..) => 4,
                        Self::Vector2(..) => 8,
                        Self::Vector3(..) => 12,
                        Self::Vector4(..) => 16,
                    }
                }
            }

            impl VertexBufferPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    info_src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    offset: usize,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = VBuffInfoPc::from_data(&info_src[offset..])
                        .context("info")?;
                    let fmt1 = info.fmt1.to_native();
                    let fmt2 = info.fmt2.to_native();
                    let offset = info.offset.to_native() as usize;
                    let size = info.size.to_native() as usize;
                    let mut vals = IndexMap::new();
                    let mut s = 0;
                    if fmt2 == 0 {
                        let b1: bool = (fmt1 & 0x40000) != 0;
                        if fmt1 & 1 != 0 {
                            if b1 {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Position,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: VECTOR4_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 16;
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Position,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 12;
                            }
                        }
                        if (fmt1 & 0x400) != 0 {
                            if b1 {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Pad(0),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::BlendWeight,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                            }
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if (fmt1 & 0x800) != 0 {
                            if b1 {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Pad(1),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::BlendIndices,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                            }
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if (fmt1 & 2) != 0 {
                            let usage = VertexUsage::Normal;
                            if b1 {
                                let mut p = 2;
                                for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                                    vals.insert(
                                        VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                        VertexDataIndex {
                                            key: COLOR_KEY,
                                            offset: s,
                                        },
                                    );
                                    s += 4;
                                    p += 1;
                                }
                                vals.insert(
                                    usage,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: VECTOR4_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 16;
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    usage,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 4;
                            }
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x100 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Color(0),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x200 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Color(1),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        for i in 0..((fmt1 >> 2) & 0xF) {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::TextureCoord(i as usize),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR2_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 8;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x40 != 0 {
                            let usage = VertexUsage::Tangent;
                            if b1 {
                                let mut p = 5;
                                for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                                    vals.insert(
                                        VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                        VertexDataIndex {
                                            key: COLOR_KEY,
                                            offset: s,
                                        },
                                    );
                                    s += 4;
                                    p += 1;
                                }
                                vals.insert(
                                    usage,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: VECTOR4_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 16;
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    usage,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 4;
                            }
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x80 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::PSize,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 12;
                        }
                        if b1 {
                            let mut p = 8;
                            for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 4;
                                p += 1;
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        if fmt1 & 1 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Position,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 12;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x400 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::BlendWeight,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x800 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::BlendIndices,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 2 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Normal,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x100 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Color(0),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x200 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Color(1),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        let n = (fmt1 >> 2) & 0xf;
                        if n <= 2 {
                            for i in 0..n {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::TextureCoord(i as usize),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: VECTOR2_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 8;
                            }
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x40 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Tangent,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x80 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::PSize,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 12;
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        _ptr_info: info_src.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        size: s,
                        offsets: vals,
                        data: NonNull::from_ref(&src[offset..offset + size]),
                    })
                }
                pub fn info(&self) -> &VBuffInfoPc {
                    unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
                }
                pub fn iter(&self) -> VertexDataIter<'_> {
                    VertexDataIter {
                        data: unsafe { self.data.as_ref() },
                        size: self.size,
                        offsets: &self.offsets,
                    }
                }
            }

                            }
                        }
                        if (fmt1 & 0x400) != 0 {
                            if b1 {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Pad(0),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::BlendWeight,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                            }
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if (fmt1 & 0x800) != 0 {
                            if b1 {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Pad(1),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::BlendIndices,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                            }
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if (fmt1 & 2) != 0 {
                            let usage = VertexUsage::Normal;
                            if b1 {
                                let mut p = 2;
                                for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                                    vals.insert(
                                        VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                        VertexDataIndex {
                                            key: COLOR_KEY,
                                            offset: s,
                                        },
                                    );
                                    s += 4;
                                    p += 1;
                                }
                                vals.insert(
                                    usage,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: VECTOR4_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 16;
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    usage,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 4;
                            }
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x100 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Color(0),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x200 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Color(1),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        for i in 0..((fmt1 >> 2) & 0xF) {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::TextureCoord(i as usize),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR2_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 8;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x40 != 0 {
                            let usage = VertexUsage::Tangent;
                            if b1 {
                                let mut p = 5;
                                for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                                    vals.insert(
                                        VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                        VertexDataIndex {
                                            key: COLOR_KEY,
                                            offset: s,
                                        },
                                    );
                                    s += 4;
                                    p += 1;
                                }
                                vals.insert(
                                    usage,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: VECTOR4_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 16;
                            } else {
                                vals.insert(
                                    usage,
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 4;
                            }
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x80 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::PSize,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 12;
                        }
                        if b1 {
                            let mut p = 8;
                            for _ in (0..(((s + 15) & 0xFFFF0) - s)).step_by(4) {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::Pad(p),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: COLOR_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 4;
                                p += 1;
                            }
                        }
                    } else {
                        if fmt1 & 1 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Position,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 12;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x400 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::BlendWeight,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x800 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::BlendIndices,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 2 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Normal,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x100 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Color(0),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x200 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Color(1),
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        let n = (fmt1 >> 2) & 0xf;
                        if n <= 2 {
                            for i in 0..n {
                                vals.insert(
                                    VertexUsage::TextureCoord(i as usize),
                                    VertexDataIndex {
                                        key: VECTOR2_KEY,
                                        offset: s,
                                    },
                                );
                                s += 8;
                            }
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x40 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::Tangent,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: COLOR_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 4;
                        }
                        if fmt1 & 0x80 != 0 {
                            vals.insert(
                                VertexUsage::PSize,
                                VertexDataIndex {
                                    key: VECTOR3_KEY,
                                    offset: s,
                                },
                            );
                            s += 12;
                        }
                    }
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        _ptr_info: info_src.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        size: s,
                        offsets: vals,
                        data: NonNull::from_ref(&src[offset..offset + size]),
                    })
                }
                pub fn info(&self) -> &VBuffInfoPs3 {
                    unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
                }
                pub fn iter(&self) -> VertexDataIter<'_> {
                    VertexDataIter {
                        data: unsafe { self.data.as_ref() },
                        size: self.size,
                        offsets: &self.offsets,
                    }
                }
            }
            pub struct VertexBuffer {
                pub info: VBuffInfo,
                pub vals: IndexMap<VertexUsage, VertexData>,
            }
            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::fmt::Debug for VertexBuffer {
                #[inline]
                fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                    ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field2_finish(
                        f,
                        "VertexBuffer",
                        "info",
                        &self.info,
                        "vals",
                        &&self.vals,
                    )
                }
            }
            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::clone::Clone for VertexBuffer {
                #[inline]
                fn clone(&self) -> VertexBuffer {
                    VertexBuffer {
                        info: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.info),
                        vals: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vals),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl VertexBuffer {
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals.first().map(|(_, x)| x.len()).unwrap_or(0)
                }
                pub fn v_size(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.size()).sum::<usize>()
                }
            }
            impl From<&VertexBufferPc> for VertexBuffer {
                fn from(val: &VertexBufferPc) -> Self {
                    let mut vals = IndexMap::with_capacity(val.offsets.len());
                    let val_iter = val.iter();
                    let size = val_iter.len();
                    for (k, v) in val.offsets.iter() {
                        vals.insert(
                            k.clone(),
                            match v.key {
                                INT_KEY => VertexData::Int(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                COLOR_KEY => VertexData::Color(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                VECTOR2_KEY => VertexData::Vector2(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                VECTOR3_KEY => VertexData::Vector3(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                VECTOR4_KEY => VertexData::Vector4(Vec::with_capacity(size)),
                                k => {
                                    ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(
                                        format_args!("Unhandled vertex data type {0}", k),
                                    );
                                }
                            },
                        );
                    }
                    for data in val_iter {
                        for (off, val) in val.offsets.values().zip(vals.values_mut()) {
                            match val {
                                VertexData::Int(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_int_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                                VertexData::Color(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_color_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                                VertexData::Vector2(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_vec2_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                                VertexData::Vector3(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_vec3_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                                VertexData::Vector4(val) => {
                                    val.push(data.get_vec4_pc(off).unwrap().conv())
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Self {
                        info: val.info().conv(),
                        vals,
                    }
                }
            }

            impl IndexBufferPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    src_info: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    offset: usize,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = IBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src_info[offset..])
                        .context("info")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        _ptr_info: src_info.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        data: NonNull::from_ref(
                            &src[info.offset.to_native()
                                as usize..(info.size.to_native() + info.offset.to_native())
                                as usize],
                        ),
                        is_u32: info.format.to_native() != 0x10,
                    })
                }
                pub fn u32(&self) -> Option<&[u32Pc]> {
                    if self.is_u32 {
                        Some(
                            u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                    unsafe { self.data.as_ref() },
                                    self.data.len() / 4,
                                )
                                .unwrap(),
                        )
                    } else {
                        None
                    }
                }
                pub fn u16(&self) -> Option<&[u16Pc]> {
                    if self.is_u32 {
                        None
                    } else {
                        Some(
                            u16Pc::slice_from_data(
                                    unsafe { self.data.as_ref() },
                                    self.data.len() / 2,
                                )
                                .unwrap(),
                        )
                    }
                }
                pub fn info(&self) -> &IBuffInfoPc {
                    unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
                }
            }

            pub enum IndexBuffer {
                U16(Vec<u16>),
                U32(Vec<u32>),
            }
            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::fmt::Debug for IndexBuffer {
                #[inline]
                fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                    match self {
                        IndexBuffer::U16(__self_0) => {
                            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                                f,
                                "U16",
                                &__self_0,
                            )
                        }
                        IndexBuffer::U32(__self_0) => {
                            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                                f,
                                "U32",
                                &__self_0,
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            #[automatically_derived]
            impl ::core::clone::Clone for IndexBuffer {
                #[inline]
                fn clone(&self) -> IndexBuffer {
                    match self {
                        IndexBuffer::U16(__self_0) => {
                            IndexBuffer::U16(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                        }
                        IndexBuffer::U32(__self_0) => {
                            IndexBuffer::U32(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&IndexBufferPc> for IndexBuffer {
                fn from(val: &IndexBufferPc) -> Self {
                    if val.is_u32 {
                        Self::U32(
                            val.u32().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    } else {
                        Self::U16(
                            val.u16().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&IndexBufferXbox> for IndexBuffer {
                fn from(val: &IndexBufferXbox) -> Self {
                    if val.is_u32 {
                        Self::U32(
                            val.u32().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    } else {
                        Self::U16(
                            val.u16().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            impl From<&IndexBufferPs3> for IndexBuffer {
                fn from(val: &IndexBufferPs3) -> Self {
                    if val.is_u32 {
                        Self::U32(
                            val.u32().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    } else {
                        Self::U16(
                            val.u16().unwrap().into_iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            impl IndexBuffer {
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    match self {
                        Self::U16(vals) => vals.len(),
                        Self::U32(vals) => vals.len(),
                    }
                }
            }
            pub struct VertexDataIter<'a> {
                data: &'a [u8],
                size: usize,
                offsets: &'a IndexMap<VertexUsage, VertexDataIndex>,
            }
            impl VertexDataIter<'_> {
                pub fn offsets(&self) -> &IndexMap<VertexUsage, VertexDataIndex> {
                    self.offsets
                }
                pub unsafe fn iter(&self) -> VertexDataIter<'_> {
                    VertexDataIter {
                        data: self.data.as_ref(),
                        size: self.size,
                        offsets: &self.offsets,
                    }
                }
            }
            impl<'a> Iterator for VertexDataIter<'a> {
                type Item = VertexValRef<'a>;
                fn next(&mut self) -> Option<Self::Item> {
                    if self.size > self.data.len() {
                        None
                    } else {
                        let (val, data) = unsafe {
                            self.data.split_at_unchecked(self.size)
                        };
                        self.data = data;
                        Some(VertexValRef { data: val })
                    }
                }
                fn size_hint(&self) -> (usize, Option<usize>) {
                    let size = self.len();
                    (size, Some(size))
                }
            }
            impl ExactSizeIterator for VertexDataIter<'_> {
                fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.data.len() / self.size
                }
            }
            enum VertexDataIterPc<'a> {
                Int(&'a [u32Pc]),
                Color(&'a [ColorPc]),
                Vector2(&'a [Vector2Pc]),
                Vector3(&'a [Vector3Pc]),
                Vector4(&'a [Vector4Pc]),
            }
            enum VertexDataIterXbox<'a> {
                Int(&'a [u32Xbox]),
                Color(&'a [ColorXbox]),
                Vector2(&'a [Vector2Xbox]),
                Vector3(&'a [Vector3Xbox]),
                Vector4(&'a [Vector4Xbox]),
            }

                Vector2(&'a [Vector2Ps3]),
                Vector3(&'a [Vector3Ps3]),
                Vector4(&'a [Vector4Ps3]),
            }

            impl ModelDataPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    src_info: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    info: &ModelInfoPc,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let infos = BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.buffer_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.mat_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let vbuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src_info[info.vbuff_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.vbuff_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_order")?;
                    let ibuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src_info[info.ibuff_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.ibuff_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_order")?;
                    let vertex_offs: IndexMap<_, _> = vbuff_order
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, x)| (x.to_native(), i))
                        .collect();
                    let index_offs: IndexMap<_, _> = ibuff_order
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, x)| (x.to_native(), i))
                        .collect();
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        infos: infos.into(),
                        vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                        ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                        vertex: vertex_offs
                            .into_iter()
                            .map(|(k, off)| Ok((
                                k,
                                VertexBufferPc::from_bytes(src, src_info, off)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("vertex data {0}", k))
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<_>>()?,
                        index: index_offs
                            .into_iter()
                            .map(|(k, off)| Ok((
                                k,
                                IndexBufferPc::from_bytes(src, src_info, off)
                                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("index data {0}", k))
                                    }))?,
                            )))
                            .collect::<Result<_>>()?,
                    })
                }
            }

            impl TryFrom<&ModelRawPc> for ModelDataPc {
                type Error = anyhow::Error;
                fn try_from(val: &ModelRawPc) -> Result<Self> {
                    let data = val.data.get().context("data")?;
                    let vertex = unsafe { val.vbuff_order.as_ref() }
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| Ok((
                            x.to_native(),
                            VertexBufferPc::from_bytes(
                                    &data,
                                    &val._ptr,
                                    x.to_native() as usize,
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("vertex data {0}", x.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    let index = unsafe { val.ibuff_order.as_ref() }
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| Ok((
                            x.to_native(),
                            IndexBufferPc::from_bytes(
                                    &data,
                                    &val._ptr,
                                    x.to_native() as usize,
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("index data {0}", x.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        )))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: val._ptr.clone(),
                        infos: val.buffer_infos,
                        vbuff_order: val.vbuff_order,
                        ibuff_order: val.ibuff_order,
                        vertex,
                        index,
                    })
                }
            }

            impl ::core::clone::Clone for ModelData {
                #[inline]

                        vertex: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vertex),
                        index: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.index),
                    }
                }
            }

                fn from(val: &ModelDataPc) -> Self {
                    Self {
                        vertex: val.vertex.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                        index: val.index.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                    }
                }
            }

                fn from(val: &ModelDataXbox) -> Self {
                    Self {
                        vertex: val.vertex.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                        index: val.index.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                    }
                }
            }

                    Self {
                        vertex: val.vertex.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                        index: val.index.iter().map(|(_, x)| x.into()).collect(),
                    }
                }
            }

            impl MatPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let base = MatBasePc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("base")?;
                    let extra = if base.mat_extra_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                        Some(
                            NonNull::from_ref(
                                MatExtraPc::from_data(
                                        &src[base.mat_extra_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                    )
                                    .context("extra")?,
                            ),
                        )
                    } else {
                        None
                    };
                    Ok(
                        match base.kind.to_native() {
                            0 => {
                                Self::Mat1(
                                    Mat1Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat1")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            1 => {
                                Self::Mat4(
                                    Mat4Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat4")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            2 => {
                                Self::Mat2(
                                    Mat2Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat2")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            3 => {
                                Self::Mat3(
                                    Mat3Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("mat3")?.into(),
                                    extra,
                                )
                            }
                            _ => {
                                return Err(
                                    ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                        ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                format_args!("Unknown Mat Type {0}", base.kind.to_native()),
                                            )
                                        }),
                                    ),
                                );
                            }
                        },
                    )
                }
                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> MatRefPc<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Mat1(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPc::Mat1(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                        Self::Mat2(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPc::Mat2(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                        Self::Mat3(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPc::Mat3(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                        Self::Mat4(mat, extra) => {
                            MatRefPc::Mat4(mat.as_ref(), extra.map(|x| x.as_ref()))
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

                fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, info: &ShapeInfoPc) -> Result<Self> {
                    let mut offset = info.offset.to_native() as usize;
                    let info = ShapeExtraInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..])
                        .context("info")?;
                    offset += info.size();
                    let offs = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[offset..],
                            info.size.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    offset += offs.size();
                    let mut off = offset + offs.last().unwrap().to_native() as usize;
                    while (src[off] != 0) || (src[off + 1] != 0) {
                        off += 1;
                    }
                    let data = &src[offset..off];
                    Ok(ShapeExtraPc {
                        info: info.into(),
                        offs: offs.into(),
                        data: data.into(),
                    })
                }
                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> ShapeExtraRefPc<'_> {
                    ShapeExtraRefPc {
                        info: self.info.as_ref(),
                        offs: self.offs.as_ref(),
                        data: self.data.as_ref(),
                    }
                }
            }
            impl ShapeExtraXbox {

            impl ShapePc {
                pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                    let extra = if info.kind.to_native() == 0 {
                        Some(ShapeExtraPc::from_bytes(src, info).context("extra")?)
                    } else {
                        None
                    };
                    let off = info.hk_shape_offset.to_native() as usize;
                    let hk_shapes = (0..info.hk_shape_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkShapePc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    off + i * HkShapeInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        extra,
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                    })
                }
                pub fn get(&self, index: usize) -> Option<HkShapeRefPc<'_>> {
                    self.hk_shapes.get(index).map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() })
                }
                pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
                    self.hk_shapes.len()
                }
            }

            pub struct ShapeExtraDumpPc<'a> {
                info: &'a mut ShapeExtraInfoPc,
                offs: &'a mut [u32Pc],
                data: &'a mut [u8],
            }
            pub struct ShapeExtraDumpXbox<'a> {
                info: &'a mut ShapeExtraInfoXbox,
                offs: &'a mut [u32Xbox],
                data: &'a mut [u8],
            }
            pub struct ShapeExtraDumpPs3<'a> {
                info: &'a mut ShapeExtraInfoPs3,
                offs: &'a mut [u32Ps3],
                data: &'a mut [u8],
            }
            impl<'a> ShapeExtraDumpPc<'a> {
                fn from_bytes(
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    sizes: (usize, usize),
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeExtraInfoPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("info")?;
                    let offs = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.0).context("offs")?;
                    let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.1).context("data")?;
                    Ok(Self { info, offs, data })
                }
            }
            impl<'a> ShapeExtraDumpXbox<'a> {
                fn from_bytes(
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    sizes: (usize, usize),
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeExtraInfoXbox::mut_from_data(dst).context("info")?;
                    let offs = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.0)
                        .context("offs")?;
                    let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.1).context("data")?;
                    Ok(Self { info, offs, data })
                }
            }
            impl<'a> ShapeExtraDumpPs3<'a> {
                fn from_bytes(
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
                    sizes: (usize, usize),
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = ShapeExtraInfoPs3::mut_from_data(dst).context("info")?;
                    let offs = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.0)
                        .context("offs")?;
                    let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, sizes.1).context("data")?;
                    Ok(Self { info, offs, data })
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpShapeExtraPc {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize);
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                    let vals = ShapeExtraDumpPc::from_bytes(dst, self.get_sizes())
                        .context("vals")?;
                    self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize) -> usize {
                    let sizes = self.get_sizes();
                    offset
                        += ShapeExtraInfoPc::size_of() + sizes.0 * u32Pc::size_of()
                            + sizes.1;
                    offset
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpShapeExtraXbox {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize);
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpXbox) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                    let vals = ShapeExtraDumpXbox::from_bytes(dst, self.get_sizes())
                        .context("vals")?;
                    self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;

            }

            impl DumpShapeExtraPc for ShapeExtraRefPc<'_> {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    vals.info.write_from(self.info).context("info")?;
                    vals.offs.write_from(self.offs).context("offs")?;
                    vals.data.write_from(self.data).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpShapeExtraXbox for ShapeExtraRefXbox<'_> {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpXbox) -> Result<()> {
                    vals.info.write_from(self.info).context("info")?;
                    vals.offs.write_from(self.offs).context("offs")?;
                    vals.data.write_from(self.data).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpShapeExtraPs3 for ShapeExtraRefPs3<'_> {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpPs3) -> Result<()> {
                    vals.info.write_from(self.info).context("info")?;
                    vals.offs.write_from(self.offs).context("offs")?;
                    vals.data.write_from(self.data).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpShapeExtraPc for &ShapeExtra {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    *vals.info = (&self.info).conv();
                    for (src, dst) in self.offs.iter().zip(vals.offs) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    vals.data.write_from(&self.data).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpShapeExtraXbox for &ShapeExtra {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpXbox) -> Result<()> {
                    *vals.info = (&self.info).conv();
                    for (src, dst) in self.offs.iter().zip(vals.offs) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    vals.data.write_from(&self.data).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpShapeExtraPs3 for &ShapeExtra {
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize) {
                    (self.offs.len(), self.data.len())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: ShapeExtraDumpPs3) -> Result<()> {
                    *vals.info = (&self.info).conv();
                    for (src, dst) in self.offs.iter().zip(vals.offs) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    vals.data.write_from(&self.data).context("data")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            pub trait DumpShapePc {
                fn extra(&self) -> Option<impl DumpShapeExtraPc>;
                fn hk_shapes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl DumpHkShapePc>;
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut ShapeInfoPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    infos: &mut DumpInfosPc,
                    extra_off: Option<usize>,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    let info = infos.shapes.next();
                    self.write_info(info).context("info")?;
                    if let Some(off) = extra_off {
                        info.offset = off.conv();
                        *infos.offsets.next() = (infos.shapes.offset - info.size())
                            .conv();
                    }
                    for (i, shape) in self.hk_shapes().enumerate() {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, infos: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {

                                        >(
                                            &'a T,
                                        );

                                            &'a T,
                                        );
                                        struct AssertDstIsFromBytes<
                                            'a,
                                            U: ?::core::marker::Sized + ::zerocopy::FromBytes,
                                        >(
                                            &'a U,
                                        );
                                        struct AssertDstIsImmutable<
                                            'a,
                                            T: ?::core::marker::Sized + ::zerocopy::Immutable,
                                        >(
                                            &'a T,
                                        );
                                        let _ = AssertSrcIsSized(e);
                                        let _ = AssertSrcIsIntoBytes(e);
                                        let _ = AssertSrcIsImmutable(e);
                                        if true {
                                            #[allow(unused, unreachable_code)]
                                            let u = AssertDstIsSized(loop {});
                                            u.0
                                        } else if true {
                                            #[allow(unused, unreachable_code)]
                                            let u = AssertDstIsFromBytes(loop {});
                                            u.0
                                        } else {
                                            #[allow(unused, unreachable_code)]
                                            let u = AssertDstIsImmutable(loop {});
                                            u.0
                                        }
                                    } else if false {
                                        let mut t = loop {};
                                        e = &t;
                                        let u;
                                        {
                                            if false {
                                                u = unsafe {
                                                    #[allow(
                                                        clippy::useless_transmute,
                                                        clippy::missing_transmute_annotations
                                                    )]
                                                    ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::core_reexport::mem::transmute(
                                                        t,
                                                    )
                                                };
                                            } else {
                                                loop {}
                                            }
                                        };
                                        {
                                            if false {

                                                    "internal error: entered unreachable code",
                                                );
                                                t = align_of.into_t();

                                                    t,

                                                };

                                            }
                                        };

                                    } else {
                                        let u = unsafe {
                                            ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::transmute_ref(e)
                                        };
                                        ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::must_use(u)
                                    }
                                };
                                let tree = u8::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.tree_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.tree_size.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                let verts = Vector3Pc::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.verts_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.vert_num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                let inds = u16Pc::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.inds_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.tri_num.to_native() as usize * 3,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                HkShapePc::BVTreeMesh {
                                    info: info.into(),
                                    tree: tree.into(),
                                    verts: verts.into(),
                                    inds: inds.into(),
                                }
                            }
                            _ => {
                                {
                                    {
                                        let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                        if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                            && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                        {
                                            ::log::__private_api::log(
                                                { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                                format_args!(
                                                    "Unknown & Unhandled HkShape type {0}",
                                                    info.kind,
                                                ),
                                                lvl,
                                                &(
                                                    "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                                    "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                                    ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                                ),
                                                (),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    }
                                };
                                HkShapePc::Unknown(info.into())
                            }
                        },
                    )
                }
                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> HkShapeRefPc<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Box(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Sphere(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Capsule(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Cylinder(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, norms, verts } => {
                            HkShapeRefPc::ConvexVertices {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                norms: norms.as_ref(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref(),
                            }
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, tree, verts, inds } => {
                            HkShapeRefPc::BVTreeMesh {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                tree: tree.as_ref(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref(),
                                inds: inds.as_ref(),
                            }
                        }
                        Self::Unknown(info) => HkShapeRefPc::Unknown(info.as_ref()),
                    }
                }
            }
