                                            #[allow(unused, unreachable_code)]
                                            let u = AssertDstIsImmutable(loop {});
                                            u.0
                                        }
                                    } else if false {
                                        let mut t = loop {};
                                        e = &t;
                                        let u;
                                        {
                                            if false {
                                                u = unsafe {
                                                    #[allow(
                                                        clippy::useless_transmute,
                                                        clippy::missing_transmute_annotations
                                                    )]
                                                    ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::core_reexport::mem::transmute(
                                                        t,
                                                    )
                                                };
                                            } else {
                                                loop {}
                                            }
                                        };
                                        {
                                            if false {
                                                let align_of: ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::AlignOf<_> = ::core::panicking::panic(
                                                    "internal error: entered unreachable code",
                                                );
                                                t = align_of.into_t();
                                                let mut max_aligns = ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::MaxAlignsOf::new(
                                                    t,
                                                    u,
                                                );
                                                max_aligns = unsafe {
                                                    #[allow(clippy::missing_transmute_annotations)]
                                                    ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::core_reexport::mem::transmute(
                                                        align_of,
                                                    )
                                                };
                                            } else {
                                                loop {}
                                            }
                                        };
                                        &u
                                    } else {
                                        let u = unsafe {
                                            ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::transmute_ref(e)
                                        };
                                        ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::must_use(u)
                                    }
                                };
                                let tree = u8::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.tree_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.tree_size.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                let verts = Vector3Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.verts_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.vert_num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                let inds = u16Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.inds_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.tri_num.to_native() as usize * 3,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                HkShapeXbox::BVTreeMesh {
                                    info: info.into(),
                                    tree: tree.into(),
                                    verts: verts.into(),
                                    inds: inds.into(),
                                }
                            }
                            _ => {
                                {
                                    {
                                        let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                        if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                            && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                        {
                                            ::log::__private_api::log(
                                                { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                                format_args!(
                                                    "Unknown & Unhandled HkShape type {0}",
                                                    info.kind,
                                                ),
                                                lvl,
                                                &(
                                                    "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                                    "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                                    ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                                ),
                                                (),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    }
                                };
                                HkShapeXbox::Unknown(info.into())
                            }
                        },
                    )
                }
                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> HkShapeRefXbox<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Box(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Sphere(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Capsule(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Cylinder(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, norms, verts } => {
                            HkShapeRefXbox::ConvexVertices {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                norms: norms.as_ref(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref(),
                            }
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, tree, verts, inds } => {
                            HkShapeRefXbox::BVTreeMesh {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                tree: tree.as_ref(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref(),
                                inds: inds.as_ref(),
                            }
                        }
                        Self::Unknown(info) => HkShapeRefXbox::Unknown(info.as_ref()),
                    }
                }
            }

                                            } else {
                                                loop {}
                                            }
                                        };
                                        &u
                                    } else {
                                        let u = unsafe {
                                            ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::transmute_ref(e)
                                        };
                                        ::zerocopy::util::macro_util::must_use(u)
                                    }
                                };
                                let tree = u8::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.tree_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.tree_size.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                let verts = Vector3Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.verts_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.vert_num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                let inds = u16Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &src[info.inds_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                        info.tri_num.to_native() as usize * 3,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?;
                                HkShapePs3::BVTreeMesh {
                                    info: info.into(),
                                    tree: tree.into(),
                                    verts: verts.into(),
                                    inds: inds.into(),
                                }
                            }
                            _ => {
                                {
                                    {
                                        let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                        if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                            && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                        {
                                            ::log::__private_api::log(
                                                { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                                format_args!(
                                                    "Unknown & Unhandled HkShape type {0}",
                                                    info.kind,
                                                ),
                                                lvl,
                                                &(
                                                    "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                                    "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                                    ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                                ),
                                                (),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    }
                                };
                                HkShapePs3::Unknown(info.into())
                            }
                        },
                    )
                }
                pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> HkShapeRefPs3<'_> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Box(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Sphere(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Capsule(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Cylinder(info.as_ref()),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, norms, verts } => {
                            HkShapeRefPs3::ConvexVertices {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                norms: norms.as_ref(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref(),
                            }
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, tree, verts, inds } => {
                            HkShapeRefPs3::BVTreeMesh {
                                info: info.as_ref(),
                                tree: tree.as_ref(),
                                verts: verts.as_ref(),
                                inds: inds.as_ref(),
                            }
                        }
                        Self::Unknown(info) => HkShapeRefPs3::Unknown(info.as_ref()),
                    }
                }

                    info: BVTreeMeshInfo,
                    tree: Vec<u8>,
                    verts: Vec<Vector3>,
                    inds: Vec<u16>,

                Unknown(HkShapeInfo),
            }

            pub trait DumpHkShapePc {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32;
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize);
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkShapeInfoPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                    counts.hk_shapes += 1;
                    match self.kind() {
                        5 => {
                            let sizes = self.get_sizes();
                            offset = align_offset(offset, 16);
                            offset += sizes.0 * Vector4Pc::size_of();
                            offset += sizes.1 * Vector3Pc::size_of();
                        }
                        6 => {
                            let sizes = self.get_sizes();
                            offset += sizes.0 * Vector3Pc::size_of();
                            offset += sizes.1 * u16Pc::size_of();
                            offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                            offset += sizes.2;
                            offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    offset
                }
                fn dump_into(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    infos: &mut DumpInfosPc,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    let info = infos.hk_shapes.next();
                    self.write_info(info).context("write info")?;
                    let vals = HkShapeDumpPc::from_bytes(dst, self.get_sizes(), info)
                        .context("vals")?;
                    self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
                    Ok(())
                }
            }

            impl DumpHkShapePc for HkShapeRefPc<'_> {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Unknown(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkShapeInfoPc) -> Result<()> {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(src) => {
                            info.write_from({
                                let e: &_ = *src;

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            Self::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpPc::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            Self::BVTreeMesh { verts: src1, inds: src2, tree: src3, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpPc::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapeXbox for HkShapeRefXbox<'_> {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Unknown(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpXbox) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            Self::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            Self::BVTreeMesh { verts: src1, inds: src2, tree: src3, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapePs3 for HkShapeRefPs3<'_> {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        Self::Box(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Sphere(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Capsule(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Cylinder(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind.to_native(),
                        Self::Unknown(info) => info.kind.to_native(),
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        Self::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        Self::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPs3) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            Self::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("norms")?;
                        }
                        (
                            Self::BVTreeMesh { verts: src1, inds: src2, tree: src3, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            dst1.write_from(src1).context("verts")?;
                            dst2.write_from(src2).context("inds")?;
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapePc for &HkShape {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::Box(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Sphere(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Capsule(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Cylinder(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Unknown(info) => info.kind,
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPc) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShape::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpPc::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                        }
                        (
                            HkShape::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: src1,
                                inds: src2,
                                tree: src3,
                                ..
                            },
                            HkShapeDumpPc::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapeXbox for &HkShape {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::Box(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Sphere(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Capsule(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Cylinder(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Unknown(info) => info.kind,
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpXbox) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShape::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                        }
                        (
                            HkShape::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: src1,
                                inds: src2,
                                tree: src3,
                                ..
                            },
                            HkShapeDumpXbox::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }
            impl DumpHkShapePs3 for &HkShape {
                fn kind(&self) -> u32 {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::Box(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Sphere(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Capsule(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Cylinder(info) => info.kind,
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { info, .. } => info.kind,
                        HkShape::Unknown(info) => info.kind,
                    }
                }
                fn get_sizes(&self) -> (usize, usize, usize) {
                    match self {
                        HkShape::ConvexVertices { info, verts, norms } => {
                            (
                                norms.len(),
                                verts.len(),
                                verts.len() - info.vert_num as usize,
                            )
                        }
                        HkShape::BVTreeMesh { tree, verts, inds, .. } => {
                            (verts.len(), inds.len(), tree.len())
                        }
                        _ => (0, 0, 0),
                    }
                }

                        HkShape::Unknown(src) => *info = src.conv(),
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: HkShapeDumpPs3) -> Result<()> {
                    match (self, vals) {
                        (
                            HkShape::ConvexVertices { verts: src1, norms: src2, .. },
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::ConvexVertices { verts: dst1, norms: dst2 },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                        }
                        (
                            HkShape::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: src1,
                                inds: src2,
                                tree: src3,
                                ..
                            },
                            HkShapeDumpPs3::BVTreeMesh {
                                verts: dst1,
                                inds: dst2,
                                tree: dst3,
                            },
                        ) => {
                            for (src, dst) in src1.iter().zip(dst1) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            for (src, dst) in src2.iter().zip(dst2) {
                                *dst = src.conv();
                            }
                            dst3.write_from(src3).context("tree")?;
                        }
                        _ => {}
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }

            impl HkConstraintPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let info = HkConstraintInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..])
                        .context("info")?;
                    if info.kind.to_native() != 0 {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!(
                                            "Unknown & Unhandled HkConstraint type {0}",
                                            info.kind,
                                        ),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                            "lotrc::level::model::shape",
                                            ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                        ),
                                        (),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        };
                    }
                    let bone_parents = i16Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_parents_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.bone_parents_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("bone_parents")?;
                    if !(bone_parents[0].to_native() == -1) {
                        ::core::panicking::panic(
                            "assertion failed: bone_parents[0].to_native() == -1",
                        )
                    }
                    let name_offsets = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_names_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.bone_names_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("name_offsets")?;
                    let mut bone_names = Vec::with_capacity(name_offsets.len());
                    for offset_ in name_offsets.iter() {
                        let start = u32Pc::from_data(
                                &src[offset_.to_native() as usize..],
                            )
                            .context("start")?;
                        let val_ = u32Pc::from_data(
                                &src[offset_.to_native() as usize + 4..],
                            )
                            .context("val_")?;
                        let mut offset = start.to_native() as usize;
                        while src[offset] != 0 {
                            offset += 1;
                        }
                        bone_names
                            .push((
                                NonNull::from_ref(
                                    str::from_utf8(&src[start.to_native() as usize..offset])
                                        .context("string")?,
                                ),
                                *start,
                                *val_,
                            ));
                    }
                    let bone_transforms = TRSPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_transforms_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.bone_transforms_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("bone_tranforms")?;
                    let bones = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bones_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.bones_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let bones_order = Key2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.bone_order_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.bone_order_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let vals2 = f32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.vals2_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.vals2_num.to_native() as usize * 42,
                        )
                        .context("vals2")?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        info: info.into(),
                        bone_parents: bone_parents.into(),
                        bone_names: bone_names.into(),
                        name_offsets: name_offsets.into(),
                        bone_transforms: bone_transforms.into(),
                        bones: bones.into(),
                        bones_order: bones_order.into(),
                        vals2: vals2.into(),
                    })
                }
            }

            pub trait DumpHkConstraintPc {
                fn bone_names_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn bone_transforms_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn bone_order_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn bone_parents_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn vals2_num(&self) -> usize;
                fn bone_names(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str>;
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkConstraintInfoPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bone_transforms(
                    &self,
                    bone_transforms: &mut [TRSPc],
                ) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bone_order(&self, bone_order: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bone_parents(&self, bone_parents: &mut [i16Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_bone_name_vals<'a>(
                    &self,
                    vals: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut u32Pc>,
                );
                fn write_vals2(&self, vals2: &mut [f32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn dump_into(
                    &self,
                    dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                    infos: &mut DumpInfosPc,
                    bones_num: u16,
                    bones_offset: u32,
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    let info = infos.hk_constraints.next();
                    self.write_info(info).context("write info")?;
                    info.bones_num = bones_num.conv();
                    info.bones_offset = bones_offset.conv();
                    info.bone_names_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let mut name_off = dst.offset;
                    let name_offsets = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.bone_names_num(),
                        )
                        .context("name_offsets")?;
                    let mut string_off = dst.offset;
                    let string_offs = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            name_offsets.len() * 2,
                        )
                        .context("string_offs")?;
                    info.bone_names_num = name_offsets.len().conv();
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let bone_transforms = TRSPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.bone_transforms_num(),
                        )
                        .context("bone_transforms")?;
                    info.bone_transforms_num = bone_transforms.len().conv();
                    self.write_bone_transforms(bone_transforms)
                        .context("write bone_transforms")?;
                    info.bone_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let bone_order = Key2Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.bone_order_num(),
                        )
                        .context("bone_order")?;
                    info.bone_order_num = bone_order.len().conv();
                    self.write_bone_order(bone_order).context("write bone_order")?;
                    info.bone_parents_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let bone_parents = i16Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.bone_parents_num(),
                        )
                        .context("bone_parents")?;
                    info.bone_parents_num = bone_parents.len().conv();
                    self.write_bone_parents(bone_parents).context("write bone_parents")?;
                    dst.align(4);
                    self.write_bone_name_vals(string_offs.iter_mut().skip(1).step_by(2));
                    for (i, string) in self.bone_names().enumerate() {
                        let s = string.as_bytes();
                        let off = string_off + i * 2 * size_of::<u32Pc>();
                        name_offsets[i] = off.conv();
                        string_offs[i * 2] = dst.offset.conv();
                        s.dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string: {0}", string))
                            }))?;
                        dst.align(4);
                        *infos.offsets.next() = name_off.conv();
                        *infos.offsets.next() = string_off.conv();
                        name_off += size_of::<u32Pc>();
                        string_off += size_of::<u32Pc>() * 2;
                    }
                    info.vals2_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let vals2 = f32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals2_num())
                        .context("vals2")?;
                    self.write_vals2(vals2).context("write vals2")?;
                    if vals2.len() == 0 {
                        info.vals2_offset = 0u32.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, infos: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                    infos.hk_constraints += 1;
                    infos.offsets += self.bone_names_num() * 2;
                    offset += size_of::<u32Pc>() * self.bone_names_num() * 3;
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                        + size_of::<TRSPc>() * self.bone_transforms_num();
                    offset += size_of::<Key2Pc>() * self.bone_order_num();
                    offset += size_of::<i16Pc>() * self.bone_parents_num();
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                    for string in self.bone_names() {
                        let s = string.as_bytes();
                        offset += s.len();
                        offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                    }
                    offset += size_of::<f32Pc>() * self.vals2_num();
                    offset
                }
            }

            impl DumpHkConstraintPc for HkConstraintPc {
                fn bone_names_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_names.len()
                }
                fn bone_transforms_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_transforms.len()
                }
                fn bone_order_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bones_order.len()
                }
                fn bone_parents_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_parents.len()
                }
                fn vals2_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals2.len()
                }
                fn bone_names(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str> {
                    self.bone_names.iter().map(|x| unsafe { x.0.as_ref() })
                }
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkConstraintInfoPc) -> Result<()> {
                    info.write_from(self.info())
                }
                fn write_bone_transforms(
                    &self,
                    bone_transforms: &mut [TRSPc],
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    bone_transforms.write_from(self.bone_transforms())
                }
                fn write_bone_order(&self, bone_order: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    bone_order.write_from(self.bones_order())
                }
                fn write_bone_parents(&self, bone_parents: &mut [i16Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    bone_parents.write_from(self.bone_parents())
                }
                fn write_bone_name_vals<'a>(
                    &self,
                    vals: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut u32Pc>,
                ) {
                    for (src, dst) in self.bone_names().iter().map(|x| x.2).zip(vals) {
                        *dst = src;
                    }
                }
                fn write_vals2(&self, vals2: &mut [f32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    vals2.write_from(self.vals2())
                }
            }

            impl DumpHkConstraintPc for HkConstraint {
                fn bone_names_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_names.len()
                }
                fn bone_transforms_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_transforms.len()
                }
                fn bone_order_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_names.len()
                }
                fn bone_parents_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_parents.len()
                }
                fn vals2_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals2.len()
                }
                fn bone_names(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str> {
                    self.bone_names.iter().map(|val| val.as_str())
                }
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkConstraintInfoPc) -> Result<()> {
                    *info = (&self.info).conv();
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_bone_transforms(
                    &self,
                    bone_transforms: &mut [TRSPc],
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    for (src, dst) in self.bone_transforms.iter().zip(bone_transforms) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_bone_order(&self, bone_order: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    let mut new_bone_order = self
                        .bone_names
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, val)| Key2 {
                            key: hash_string(val.as_ref(), None).into(),
                            val: i as u32,
                        })
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    new_bone_order.sort_by_key(|x| x.key.get());
                    for (src, dst) in new_bone_order.iter().zip(bone_order) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_bone_parents(&self, bone_parents: &mut [i16Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    for (src, dst) in self.bone_parents.iter().zip(bone_parents) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_bone_name_vals<'a>(
                    &self,
                    vals: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut u32Pc>,
                ) {
                    for val in vals {
                        *val = 0u32.conv();
                    }
                }
                fn write_vals2(&self, vals2: &mut [f32Pc]) -> Result<()> {
                    for (src, dst) in self.vals2.iter().zip(vals2) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }

            impl DumpHkConstraintPs3 for HkConstraint {
                fn bone_names_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_names.len()
                }
                fn bone_transforms_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_transforms.len()
                }
                fn bone_order_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_names.len()
                }
                fn bone_parents_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.bone_parents.len()
                }
                fn vals2_num(&self) -> usize {
                    self.vals2.len()
                }
                fn bone_names(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str> {
                    self.bone_names.iter().map(|val| val.as_str())
                }
                fn write_info(&self, info: &mut HkConstraintInfoPs3) -> Result<()> {
                    *info = (&self.info).conv();
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_bone_transforms(
                    &self,
                    bone_transforms: &mut [TRSPs3],
                ) -> Result<()> {
                    for (src, dst) in self.bone_transforms.iter().zip(bone_transforms) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_bone_order(&self, bone_order: &mut [Key2Ps3]) -> Result<()> {
                    let mut new_bone_order = self
                        .bone_names
                        .iter()
                        .enumerate()
                        .map(|(i, val)| Key2 {
                            key: hash_string(val.as_ref(), None).into(),
                            val: i as u32,
                        })
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    new_bone_order.sort_by_key(|x| x.key.get());
                    for (src, dst) in new_bone_order.iter().zip(bone_order) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_bone_parents(&self, bone_parents: &mut [i16Ps3]) -> Result<()> {
                    for (src, dst) in self.bone_parents.iter().zip(bone_parents) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn write_bone_name_vals<'a>(
                    &self,
                    vals: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut u32Ps3>,
                ) {
                    for val in vals {
                        *val = 0u32.conv();
                    }
                }
                fn write_vals2(&self, vals2: &mut [f32Ps3]) -> Result<()> {
                    for (src, dst) in self.vals2.iter().zip(vals2) {
                        *dst = src.conv();
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
            }

        impl BlockPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                mut offset: usize,
                size: usize,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let info1 = BlockHeader1Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info1")?;
                offset += info1.size();
                let vals_a = BlockValAPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[offset..],
                        info1.a.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                offset += vals_a.size();
                let vals_b = BlockValAPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[offset..],
                        info1.b.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals_b")?;
                offset += vals_b.size();
                let info2 = BlockHeader2Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info2")?;
                offset += info2.size();
                let vals_c = BlockValBPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[offset..],
                        info2.n.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals_c")?;
                offset += vals_c.size();
                let pad = &src[offset..offset + size];
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    info1: info1.into(),
                    info2: info2.into(),
                    vals_a: vals_a.into(),
                    vals_b: vals_b.into(),
                    vals_c: vals_c.into(),
                    pad: pad.into(),
                })
            }
        }

            transforms: Option<NonNull<Matrix4x4Ps3>>,
            bounding_boxes: Option<NonNull<BoundingBoxPs3>>,
            size: usize,
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for BonesPs3 {
            #[inline]
            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field5_finish(
                    f,
                    "BonesPs3",
                    "names",
                    &self.names,
                    "parents",
                    &self.parents,
                    "transforms",
                    &self.transforms,
                    "bounding_boxes",
                    &self.bounding_boxes,
                    "size",
                    &&self.size,
                )
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for BonesPs3 {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> BonesPs3 {
                BonesPs3 {

                    parents: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.parents),
                    transforms: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.transforms),

                }

        pub struct BonesRefPc<'a> {
            names: &'a [CrcPc],
            parents: &'a [i32Pc],
            transforms: &'a [Matrix4x4Pc],
            bounding_boxes: &'a [BoundingBoxPc],
        }
        pub struct BonesRefXbox<'a> {
            names: &'a [CrcXbox],
            parents: &'a [i32Xbox],
            transforms: &'a [Matrix4x4Xbox],
            bounding_boxes: &'a [BoundingBoxXbox],
        }
        pub struct BonesRefPs3<'a> {
            names: &'a [CrcPs3],
            parents: &'a [i32Ps3],
            transforms: &'a [Matrix4x4Ps3],
            bounding_boxes: &'a [BoundingBoxPs3],
        }
        impl BonesRefPc<'_> {
            pub fn names(&self) -> &[CrcPc] {
                self.names
            }
            pub fn parents(&self) -> &[i32Pc] {
                self.parents
            }
            pub fn transforms(&self) -> &[Matrix4x4Pc] {
                self.transforms
            }
            pub fn bounding_boxes(&self) -> &[BoundingBoxPc] {
                self.bounding_boxes
            }
        }
        impl BonesRefXbox<'_> {
            pub fn names(&self) -> &[CrcXbox] {
                self.names
            }
            pub fn parents(&self) -> &[i32Xbox] {
                self.parents
            }
            pub fn transforms(&self) -> &[Matrix4x4Xbox] {
                self.transforms
            }
            pub fn bounding_boxes(&self) -> &[BoundingBoxXbox] {
                self.bounding_boxes
            }
        }
        impl BonesRefPs3<'_> {
            pub fn names(&self) -> &[CrcPs3] {
                self.names
            }
            pub fn parents(&self) -> &[i32Ps3] {
                self.parents
            }
            pub fn transforms(&self) -> &[Matrix4x4Ps3] {
                self.transforms
            }
            pub fn bounding_boxes(&self) -> &[BoundingBoxPs3] {
                self.bounding_boxes
            }
        }
        impl BonesPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, info: &ModelInfoPc) -> Result<Self> {
                let size = info.bones_num.to_native() as usize;
                let parents = i32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.bone_parents_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        size.max(4),
                    )
                    .context("parents")?;
                if parents[0].to_native() != -1 {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!(
                                    "first bone should be the root, but parent != -1",
                                ),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    );
                }
                let names_off = info.bones_offset.to_native() as usize;
                let names = if names_off != 0 {
                    Some(
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(&src[names_off..], size).context("names")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let transforms = Matrix4x4Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.bone_transforms_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        size,
                    )
                    .context("transforms")?;
                let bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.bones_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("bounding_boxes")?;
                Ok(Self {
                    names: names.and_then(|x| x.first().map(|x| x.into())),
                    parents: parents.first().map(|x| x.into()),
                    transforms: transforms.first().map(|x| x.into()),
                    bounding_boxes: bounding_boxes.first().map(|x| x.into()),
                    size,
                })
            }
            pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> BonesRefPc<'_> {
                BonesRefPc {
                    names: self
                        .names
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()
                        })
                        .unwrap_or(&[]),
                    parents: self
                        .parents
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()
                        })
                        .unwrap_or(&[]),
                    transforms: self
                        .transforms
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()
                        })
                        .unwrap_or(&[]),
                    bounding_boxes: self
                        .bounding_boxes
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()
                        })
                        .unwrap_or(&[]),
                }
            }
        }

                        .unwrap_or(&[]),
                    transforms: self
                        .transforms
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()

                        .unwrap_or(&[]),
                    bounding_boxes: self
                        .bounding_boxes
                        .map(|x| unsafe {
                            NonNull::slice_from_raw_parts(x, self.size).as_ref()

        pub struct ModelRawPc {
            _ptr: Arc<[u8]>,
            info: NonNull<ModelInfoPc>,
            bones: BonesPc,
            mat_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            mesh_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            mesh_bounding_boxes: NonNull<[BoundingBoxPc]>,
            skin_binds: NonNull<[Matrix4x4Pc]>,
            vals_j: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            val_k_header: NonNull<[u16Pc]>,
            vals_k: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            skin_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            slots: NonNull<[Key2Pc]>,
            slot_map: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            block_header: Option<u32Pc>,
            block_offsets: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            blocks: Box<[BlockPc]>,
            val: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            buffer_infos: NonNull<[BufferInfoPc]>,
            vbuff_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            ibuff_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            _vbuffs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<VBuffInfoPc>>,
            _ibuffs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<IBuffInfoPc>>,
            mats: IndexMap<u32, MatPc>,
            hk_constraint: Option<HkConstraintPc>,
            hk_constraint_datas: NonNull<[HkConstraintDataPc]>,
            shapes: Box<[ShapePc]>,
            data: CompressedDataRef,
        }
        pub struct ModelRawXbox {
            _ptr: Arc<[u8]>,

            mat_order: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,

            mesh_bounding_boxes: NonNull<[BoundingBoxXbox]>,
            skin_binds: NonNull<[Matrix4x4Xbox]>,
            vals_j: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,

            vals_k: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,
            skin_order: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,
            slots: NonNull<[Key2Xbox]>,
            slot_map: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,
            block_header: Option<u32Xbox>,
            block_offsets: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,
            blocks: Box<[BlockXbox]>,
            val: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,
            buffer_infos: NonNull<[BufferInfoXbox]>,
            vbuff_order: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,
            ibuff_order: NonNull<[u32Xbox]>,
            _vbuffs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<VBuffInfoXbox>>,
            _ibuffs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<IBuffInfoXbox>>,
