        }
        pub struct ModelRawPs3 {
            _ptr: Arc<[u8]>,
            info: NonNull<ModelInfoPs3>,
            bones: BonesPs3,
            mat_order: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            mesh_order: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            mesh_bounding_boxes: NonNull<[BoundingBoxPs3]>,
            skin_binds: NonNull<[Matrix4x4Ps3]>,
            vals_j: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            val_k_header: NonNull<[u16Ps3]>,
            vals_k: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            skin_order: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            slots: NonNull<[Key2Ps3]>,
            slot_map: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            block_header: Option<u32Ps3>,
            block_offsets: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            blocks: Box<[BlockPs3]>,
            val: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            buffer_infos: NonNull<[BufferInfoPs3]>,
            vbuff_order: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            ibuff_order: NonNull<[u32Ps3]>,
            _vbuffs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<VBuffInfoPs3>>,
            _ibuffs: IndexMap<u32, NonNull<IBuffInfoPs3>>,
            mats: IndexMap<u32, MatPs3>,
            hk_constraint: Option<HkConstraintPs3>,
            hk_constraint_datas: NonNull<[HkConstraintDataPs3]>,
            shapes: Box<[ShapePs3]>,
            data: CompressedDataRef,
        }
        impl ModelRawPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                model_data: &IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,
                offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let info = ModelInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                let bones = BonesPc::from_bytes(src, info).context("bones")?;
                let mat_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mat_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.skin_binds_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.skin_binds_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let vals_j = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vals_j_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.vals_j_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let (val_k_header, vals_k) = if info.vals_k_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                    (
                        u16Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                2,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.to_native() as usize + 4..],
                                35,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let skin_order = if info.skin_order_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                    u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.skin_order_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.skin_binds_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?
                } else {
                    &[] as _
                };
                let (slots, slot_map) = if info.slots_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                    if info.slot_map_offset.to_native() == 0 {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("expected non zero slot_map_offset"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                    let mut i = 0;
                    {
                        while {
                            let val = u32Pc::from_data(
                                    &src[info.slots_offset.to_native() as usize + i * 8..],
                                )
                                .context("vals")?;
                            val.to_native() != 0
                        } {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let slots = Key2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.slots_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            i,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    (
                        slots,
                        u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.slot_map_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                slots.last().unwrap().val.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let (block_header, block_offsets, blocks) = if info
                    .block_offset
                    .to_native() != 0
                {
                    let block_header = u32Pc::from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let n = ((info.lod0.physics_end.to_native()
                        - info.lod0.skinned_end.to_native()) as usize)
                        .max(0);
                    let block_offsets = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.to_native() as usize + 4..],
                            n + 1,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                    for i in 0..n {
                        let size = (block_offsets[i + 1].to_native()
                            - block_offsets[i].to_native()) as usize;
                        let offset = (block_offsets[i].to_native()
                            + info.block_offset.to_native()) as usize;
                        let block = BlockPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?;
                        blocks.push(block);
                    }
                    (Some(*block_header), block_offsets, blocks)
                } else {
                    (None, &[] as _, ::alloc::vec::Vec::new())
                };
                let val = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        4,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let hk_constraint = if info.hk_constraint_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                    Some(
                        shape::HkConstraintPc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.hk_constraint_offset.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("hk_constarint")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let hk_constraint_datas = shape::HkConstraintDataPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.hk_constraint_data_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.hk_constraint_data_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                let shapes = (0..info.shape_num.to_native() as usize)
                    .map(|i| {
                        shape::ShapePc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.shape_offset.to_native() as usize
                                    + i * shape::ShapeInfoPc::size_of(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                let mats = mat_order
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, x)| {
                        Ok((
                            x.to_native(),
                            mat::MatPc::from_bytes(src, x.to_native() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("mat {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let buffer_infos = data::BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.buffer_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("buffer infos")?;
                let vbuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vbuff_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.vbuff_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let ibuff_order = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.ibuff_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.ibuff_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let _vbuffs = vbuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.to_native(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::VBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src[x.to_native() as usize..])
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let _ibuffs = ibuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.to_native(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::IBuffInfoPc::from_data(&src[x.to_native() as usize..])
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let data = model_data
                    .get(&info.asset_key.to_native())
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    info: info.into(),
                    bones,
                    mat_order: mat_order.into(),
                    mesh_order: mesh_order.into(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: mesh_bounding_boxes.into(),
                    skin_binds: skin_binds.into(),
                    vals_j: vals_j.into(),
                    val_k_header: val_k_header.into(),
                    vals_k: vals_k.into(),
                    skin_order: skin_order.into(),
                    slots: slots.into(),
                    slot_map: slot_map.into(),
                    block_header: block_header.into(),
                    block_offsets: block_offsets.into(),
                    blocks: blocks.into(),
                    mats,
                    buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                    vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                    ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                    _vbuffs,
                    _ibuffs,
                    val: val.into(),
                    hk_constraint,
                    hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                    shapes: shapes.into(),
                    data,
                })
            }
        }
        impl ModelRawXbox {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                model_data: &IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,
                offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let info = ModelInfoXbox::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                let bones = BonesXbox::from_bytes(src, info).context("bones")?;
                let mat_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mat_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let mesh_bounding_boxes = BoundingBoxXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.lod3.breakable_end.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.skin_binds_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.skin_binds_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let vals_j = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vals_j_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.vals_j_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let (val_k_header, vals_k) = if info.vals_k_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                    (
                        u16Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                2,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                        u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.vals_k_offset.to_native() as usize + 4..],
                                35,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let skin_order = if info.skin_order_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                    u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.skin_order_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            info.skin_binds_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?
                } else {
                    &[] as _
                };
                let (slots, slot_map) = if info.slots_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                    if info.slot_map_offset.to_native() == 0 {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("expected non zero slot_map_offset"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                    let mut i = 0;
                    {
                        while {
                            let val = u32Xbox::from_data(
                                    &src[info.slots_offset.to_native() as usize + i * 8..],
                                )
                                .context("vals")?;
                            val.to_native() != 0
                        } {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let slots = Key2Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.slots_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            i,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    (
                        slots,
                        u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.slot_map_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                slots.last().unwrap().val.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let (block_header, block_offsets, blocks) = if info
                    .block_offset
                    .to_native() != 0
                {
                    let block_header = u32Xbox::from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let n = ((info.lod0.physics_end.to_native()
                        - info.lod0.skinned_end.to_native()) as usize)
                        .max(0);
                    let block_offsets = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.to_native() as usize + 4..],
                            n + 1,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    let mut blocks = Vec::with_capacity(n);
                    for i in 0..n {
                        let size = (block_offsets[i + 1].to_native()
                            - block_offsets[i].to_native()) as usize;
                        let offset = (block_offsets[i].to_native()
                            + info.block_offset.to_native()) as usize;
                        let block = BlockXbox::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?;
                        blocks.push(block);
                    }
                    (Some(*block_header), block_offsets, blocks)
                } else {
                    (None, &[] as _, ::alloc::vec::Vec::new())
                };
                let val = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.mesh_order_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        4,
                    )
                    .context("vals")?;
                let hk_constraint = if info.hk_constraint_offset.to_native() != 0 {
                    Some(
                        shape::HkConstraintXbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.hk_constraint_offset.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("hk_constarint")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    None
                };
                let hk_constraint_datas = shape::HkConstraintDataXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.hk_constraint_data_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.hk_constraint_data_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                let shapes = (0..info.shape_num.to_native() as usize)
                    .map(|i| {
                        shape::ShapeXbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.shape_offset.to_native() as usize
                                    + i * shape::ShapeInfoXbox::size_of(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                let mats = mat_order
                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, x)| {
                        Ok((
                            x.to_native(),
                            mat::MatXbox::from_bytes(src, x.to_native() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("mat {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ))
                    })
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let buffer_infos = data::BufferInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.buffer_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("buffer infos")?;
                let vbuff_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.vbuff_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.vbuff_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let ibuff_order = u32Xbox::slice_from_data(
                        &src[info.ibuff_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.ibuff_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let _vbuffs = vbuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.to_native(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::VBuffInfoXbox::from_data(
                                    &src[x.to_native() as usize..],
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let _ibuffs = ibuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.to_native(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::IBuffInfoXbox::from_data(
                                    &src[x.to_native() as usize..],
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let data = model_data
                    .get(&info.asset_key.to_native())
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    info: info.into(),
                    bones,
                    mat_order: mat_order.into(),
                    mesh_order: mesh_order.into(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: mesh_bounding_boxes.into(),
                    skin_binds: skin_binds.into(),
                    vals_j: vals_j.into(),
                    val_k_header: val_k_header.into(),
                    vals_k: vals_k.into(),
                    skin_order: skin_order.into(),
                    slots: slots.into(),
                    slot_map: slot_map.into(),
                    block_header: block_header.into(),
                    block_offsets: block_offsets.into(),
                    blocks: blocks.into(),
                    mats,
                    buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                    vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                    ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                    _vbuffs,
                    _ibuffs,
                    val: val.into(),
                    hk_constraint,
                    hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                    shapes: shapes.into(),
                    data,
                })
            }
        }
        impl ModelRawPs3 {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                model_data: &IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,

            ) -> Result<Self> {

                                    &src[info.slots_offset.to_native() as usize + i * 8..],

                                .context("vals")?;
                            val.to_native() != 0
                        } {
                            i += 1;
                        }
                        i += 1;
                    }
                    let slots = Key2Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.slots_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            i,
                        )
                        .context("vals")?;
                    (
                        slots,
                        u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.slot_map_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                slots.last().unwrap().val.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("vals")?,
                    )
                } else {
                    (&[] as _, &[] as _)
                };
                let (block_header, block_offsets, blocks) = if info
                    .block_offset
                    .to_native() != 0
                {

                            &src[info.block_offset.to_native() as usize..],

                        .context("vals")?;
                    let n = ((info.lod0.physics_end.to_native()
                        - info.lod0.skinned_end.to_native()) as usize)
                        .max(0);
                    let block_offsets = u32Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[info.block_offset.to_native() as usize + 4..],

                        .context("vals")?;

                                src,
                                info.hk_constraint_offset.to_native() as usize,
                            )
                            .context("hk_constarint")?,

                    None
                };

                        &src[info.hk_constraint_data_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.hk_constraint_data_num.to_native() as usize,

                    .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;

                    .map(|i| {
                        shape::ShapePs3::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.shape_offset.to_native() as usize
                                    + i * shape::ShapeInfoPs3::size_of(),

                            }))

                    .iter()
                    .enumerate()
                    .map(|(i, x)| {
                        Ok((
                            x.to_native(),
                            mat::MatPs3::from_bytes(src, x.to_native() as usize)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("mat {0}", i))
                                }))?,

                        &src[info.buffer_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.mat_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("buffer infos")?;

                        &src[info.vbuff_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.vbuff_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;

                        &src[info.ibuff_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        info.ibuff_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vbuff order")?;
                let _vbuffs = vbuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.to_native(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::VBuffInfoPs3::from_data(&src[x.to_native() as usize..])
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("vbuff info {0}", x.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let _ibuffs = ibuff_order
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| Ok((
                        x.to_native(),
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            data::IBuffInfoPs3::from_data(&src[x.to_native() as usize..])
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("ibuff info {0}", x.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )))
                    .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                let data = model_data
                    .get(&info.asset_key.to_native())
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    info: info.into(),
                    bones,
                    mat_order: mat_order.into(),
                    mesh_order: mesh_order.into(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: mesh_bounding_boxes.into(),
                    skin_binds: skin_binds.into(),
                    vals_j: vals_j.into(),
                    val_k_header: val_k_header.into(),
                    vals_k: vals_k.into(),
                    skin_order: skin_order.into(),
                    slots: slots.into(),
                    slot_map: slot_map.into(),
                    block_header: block_header.into(),
                    block_offsets: block_offsets.into(),
                    blocks: blocks.into(),
                    mats,
                    buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                    vbuff_order: vbuff_order.into(),
                    ibuff_order: ibuff_order.into(),
                    _vbuffs,
                    _ibuffs,
                    val: val.into(),
                    hk_constraint,
                    hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                    shapes: shapes.into(),
                    data,
                })
            }
        }
        pub struct ModelPc {
            _ptr: Arc<[u8]>,
            info: NonNull<ModelInfoPc>,
            bones: BonesPc,
            mat_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            mesh_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            mesh_bounding_boxes: NonNull<[BoundingBoxPc]>,
            skin_binds: NonNull<[Matrix4x4Pc]>,
            vals_j: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            val_k_header: NonNull<[u16Pc]>,
            vals_k: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            skin_order: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            slots: NonNull<[Key2Pc]>,
            slot_map: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            block_header: Option<u32Pc>,
            block_offsets: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            blocks: Box<[BlockPc]>,
            val: NonNull<[u32Pc]>,
            mats: IndexMap<u32, mat::MatPc>,
            hk_constraint: Option<shape::HkConstraintPc>,
            hk_constraint_datas: NonNull<[shape::HkConstraintDataPc]>,
            shapes: Box<[shape::ShapePc]>,
            data: data::ModelDataPc,
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for ModelPc {
            #[inline]
            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                let names: &'static _ = &[
                    "_ptr",
                    "info",
                    "bones",
                    "mat_order",
                    "mesh_order",
                    "mesh_bounding_boxes",
                    "skin_binds",
                    "vals_j",
                    "val_k_header",
                    "vals_k",
                    "skin_order",
                    "slots",
                    "slot_map",
                    "block_header",
                    "block_offsets",
                    "blocks",
                    "val",
                    "mats",
                    "hk_constraint",
                    "hk_constraint_datas",
                    "shapes",
                    "data",
                ];
                let values: &[&dyn ::core::fmt::Debug] = &[
                    &self._ptr,
                    &self.info,
                    &self.bones,
                    &self.mat_order,
                    &self.mesh_order,
                    &self.mesh_bounding_boxes,
                    &self.skin_binds,
                    &self.vals_j,
                    &self.val_k_header,
                    &self.vals_k,
                    &self.skin_order,
                    &self.slots,
                    &self.slot_map,
                    &self.block_header,
                    &self.block_offsets,
                    &self.blocks,
                    &self.val,
                    &self.mats,
                    &self.hk_constraint,
                    &self.hk_constraint_datas,
                    &self.shapes,
                    &&self.data,
                ];
                ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_fields_finish(
                    f,
                    "ModelPc",
                    names,
                    values,
                )
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for ModelPc {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> ModelPc {
                ModelPc {
                    _ptr: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self._ptr),
                    info: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.info),
                    bones: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.bones),
                    mat_order: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.mat_order),
                    mesh_order: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.mesh_order),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(
                        &self.mesh_bounding_boxes,
                    ),
