        impl Model {
            pub fn from_pc(
                val: &ModelPc,
                _pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
                _objs: &ObjsPc,
            ) -> Self {
                Self {
                    info: val.info().conv(),
                    bones: val.bones().into(),
                    mat_order: val
                        .mat_order()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| val.mats.get_index_of(&x.to_native()).unwrap() as u32)
                        .collect(),
                    mesh_order: val.mesh_order().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: val
                        .mesh_bounding_boxes()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.conv())
                        .collect(),
                    skin_binds: val.skin_binds().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    vals_j: val.vals_j().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    val_k_header: val.val_k_header().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    vals_k: val.vals_k().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    skin_order: val.skin_order().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    slots: val.slots().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    slot_map: val.slot_map().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    block_header: val.block_header().map(|x| x.conv()),
                    blocks: val.blocks.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                    mats: val
                        .mats
                        .values()
                        .map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() }.into())
                        .collect(),
                    hk_constraint: val.hk_constraint.as_ref().map(|x| x.into()),
                    hk_constraint_datas: val
                        .hk_constraint_datas()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.conv())
                        .collect(),
                    shapes: val.shapes.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                    data: val.data().into(),
                }
            }
            pub fn from_xbox(
                val: &ModelXbox,
                _pak_header: &PakHeaderXbox,
                _objs: &ObjsXbox,
            ) -> Self {
                Self {
                    info: val.info().conv(),
                    bones: val.bones().into(),
                    mat_order: val
                        .mat_order()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| val.mats.get_index_of(&x.to_native()).unwrap() as u32)
                        .collect(),
                    mesh_order: val.mesh_order().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: val
                        .mesh_bounding_boxes()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.conv())
                        .collect(),
                    skin_binds: val.skin_binds().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    vals_j: val.vals_j().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    val_k_header: val.val_k_header().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    vals_k: val.vals_k().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    skin_order: val.skin_order().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    slots: val.slots().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    slot_map: val.slot_map().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    block_header: val.block_header().map(|x| x.conv()),
                    blocks: val.blocks.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                    mats: val
                        .mats
                        .values()
                        .map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() }.into())
                        .collect(),
                    hk_constraint: val.hk_constraint.as_ref().map(|x| x.into()),
                    hk_constraint_datas: val
                        .hk_constraint_datas()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.conv())
                        .collect(),
                    shapes: val.shapes.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                    data: val.data().into(),
                }
            }
            pub fn from_ps3(
                val: &ModelPs3,
                _pak_header: &PakHeaderPs3,
                _objs: &ObjsPs3,
            ) -> Self {
                Self {
                    info: val.info().conv(),
                    bones: val.bones().into(),
                    mat_order: val
                        .mat_order()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| val.mats.get_index_of(&x.to_native()).unwrap() as u32)
                        .collect(),
                    mesh_order: val.mesh_order().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    mesh_bounding_boxes: val
                        .mesh_bounding_boxes()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.conv())
                        .collect(),
                    skin_binds: val.skin_binds().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    vals_j: val.vals_j().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    val_k_header: val.val_k_header().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    vals_k: val.vals_k().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    skin_order: val.skin_order().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    slots: val.slots().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    slot_map: val.slot_map().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                    block_header: val.block_header().map(|x| x.conv()),
                    blocks: val.blocks.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                    mats: val
                        .mats
                        .values()
                        .map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() }.into())
                        .collect(),
                    hk_constraint: val.hk_constraint.as_ref().map(|x| x.into()),
                    hk_constraint_datas: val
                        .hk_constraint_datas()
                        .iter()
                        .map(|x| x.conv())
                        .collect(),
                    shapes: val.shapes.iter().map(|x| x.into()).collect(),
                    data: val.data().into(),
                }
            }
        }
        pub struct BonesDumpPc<'a> {
            names: &'a mut [CrcPc],
            parents: &'a mut [i32Pc],
            transforms: &'a mut [Matrix4x4Pc],
            bounding_boxes: &'a mut [BoundingBoxPc],
        }
        pub struct BonesDumpXbox<'a> {
            names: &'a mut [CrcXbox],
            parents: &'a mut [i32Xbox],
            transforms: &'a mut [Matrix4x4Xbox],
            bounding_boxes: &'a mut [BoundingBoxXbox],
        }
        pub struct BonesDumpPs3<'a> {
            names: &'a mut [CrcPs3],
            parents: &'a mut [i32Ps3],
            transforms: &'a mut [Matrix4x4Ps3],
            bounding_boxes: &'a mut [BoundingBoxPs3],
        }
        pub trait DumpModelPc {
            fn bone_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vals_j_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn skin_bind_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_skin_order(&self) -> bool;
            fn mat_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn shape_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn mesh_order_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vbuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn ibuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_vals_k(&self) -> bool;
            fn slot_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn slot_map_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn block_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn hk_constraint_data_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_bones(&self, bones: BonesDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_j(&self, vals_j: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_binds(&self, skin_binds: &mut [Matrix4x4Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_order(&self, skin_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mat_order(&self, mat_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_order(&self, mesh_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_bounding_boxes(
                &self,
                mesh_bboxes: &mut [BoundingBoxPc],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vbuff_order(&self, vbuff_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_ibuff_order(&self, ibuff_order: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_k(
                &self,
                header: &mut [u16Pc],
                vals_k: &mut [u32Pc],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slots(&self, slots: &mut [Key2Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slot_map(&self, slot_map: &mut [u32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn mat_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn mats(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, impl DumpMatPc)>;
            fn hk_constraint_datas(
                &self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl Into<HkConstraintDataPc>>;
            fn shapes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpShapePc>;
            fn hk_constraint(&self) -> Option<&impl DumpHkConstraintPc>;
            fn block_header(&self) -> Option<impl Into<u32Pc>>;
            fn blocks(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpBlockPc>;
            fn dump_misc(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc,
                info: &mut ModelInfoPc,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.vals_k_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let vals_k_header = u16Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 2)
                        .context("val_k_header")?;
                    let vals_k = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 35).context("vals_k")?;
                    self.write_vals_k(vals_k_header, vals_k).context("vals_k")?;
                } else {
                    info.vals_k_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    info.slots_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slots = Key2Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_num())
                        .context("slots")?;
                    self.write_slots(slots).context("write slots")?;
                    info.slot_map_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slot_map = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_map_num())
                        .context("slot_map")?;
                    self.write_slot_map(slot_map).context("write slot_map")?;
                } else {
                    info.slots_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if let Some(block_header) = self.block_header() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    let start = dst.offset;
                    info.block_offset = start.conv();
                    *u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("block_header")? = block_header
                        .into();
                    let block_offsets = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.block_num() + 1,
                        )
                        .context("block_offsets")?;
                    for (i, (block, off)) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_offsets.iter_mut())
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        dst.align(16);
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                        block
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    if let Some(off) = block_offsets.last_mut() {
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    }
                }
                info.hk_constraint_data_num = self.hk_constraint_data_num().conv();
                if info.hk_constraint_data_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.hk_constraint_data_offset = infos
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .offset
                        .conv();
                    for info in self.hk_constraint_datas() {
                        *infos.hk_constraint_datas.next() = info.into();
                    }
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_misc_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16) + 2 * u16Pc::size_of()
                        + 35 * u32Pc::size_of();
                }
                offset
                    += Key2Pc::size_of() * self.slot_num()
                        + u32Pc::size_of() * self.slot_map_num();
                if self.block_header().is_some() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                        + (2 + self.block_num()) * u32Pc::size_of();
                    for block in self.blocks() {
                        offset = block.add_size(align_offset(offset, 16));
                    }
                }
                counts.hk_constraint_datas += self.hk_constraint_data_num();
                offset
            }
            fn dump_mats(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc,
                info: &mut ModelInfoPc,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                info.mat_offset = off.conv();
                let mat_map = self
                    .mats()
                    .map(|(i, mat)| (i, mat.dump_infos(infos)))
                    .collect::<HashMap<_, _>>();
                let mat_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mat_num())
                    .context("mat_order")?;
                info.mat_num = mat_order.len().conv();
                for (i, mat) in self.mat_order().zip(mat_order) {
                    *mat = mat_map
                        .get(&i)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("mats is missing item {0}", i),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_mat_counts(&self, counts: &mut InfoCounts) {
                for mat in self.mats() {
                    mat.1.add_counts(counts);
                }
            }
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bones = CrcPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.bone_num())
                    .context("bones")?;
                info.bones_num = bones.len().conv();
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_bboxes = BoundingBoxPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vals_j_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_j = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_j_num())
                    .context("vals_j")?;
                info.vals_j_num = vals_j.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_j(vals_j).context("write vals_j")?;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.to_native() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.to_native(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.skin_binds_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.skin_bind_num(),
                    )
                    .context("skin_binds")?;
                info.skin_binds_num = skin_binds.len().conv();
                self.write_skin_binds(skin_binds).context("write skin_binds")?;
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    info.skin_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let skin_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, skin_binds.len())
                        .context("skin_order")?;
                    self.write_skin_order(skin_order).context("write skin_order")?;
                } else {
                    info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.bone_parents_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_parents = i32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_parents")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpPc {
                        names: bones,
                        parents: bone_parents,
                        bounding_boxes: bone_bboxes,
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, None)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        mesh_order.len(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vbuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let vbuff_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vbuff_num())
                    .context("vbuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..vbuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.vbuff_num = vbuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_vbuff_order(vbuff_order).context("write vbuff_order")?;
                info.ibuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let ibuff_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.ibuff_num())
                    .context("ibuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..ibuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.ibuff_num = ibuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_ibuff_order(ibuff_order).context("write ibuff_order")?;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                offset += CrcPc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.vals_j_num();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Pc::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                }
                offset += i32Pc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Pc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPc::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                counts.offsets += self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num();
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * (self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num());
                self.add_misc_size(offset, counts)
            }
            fn dump_terrain_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPc,
                indices_offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let bone_bbox_offset = infos.models.offset + 16;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bones_num = self.bone_num().conv();
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = bone_bbox_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_num = 0u32.conv();
                info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bone_parents_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.to_native() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.to_native(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                let mut shape_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(self.shape_num());
                for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        shape_offsets.push(Some(dst.offset));
                        extra
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0} extra", i))
                            }))?;
                    } else {
                        shape_offsets.push(None);
                    }
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.mesh_order_num(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Pc::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.bone_num(),
                    )
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpPc {
                        names: &mut [],
                        parents: &mut [],
                        bounding_boxes: &mut [],
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                info.vbuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let vbuff_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vbuff_num())
                    .context("vbuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..vbuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.vbuff_num = vbuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_vbuff_order(vbuff_order).context("write vbuff_order")?;
                let off_dest = dst.offset + 320;
                info.ibuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let ibuff_order = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.ibuff_num())
                    .context("ibuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..ibuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.ibuff_num = ibuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_ibuff_order(ibuff_order).context("write ibuff_order")?;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info)?;
                if dst.offset < off_dest {
                    *dst = dst.split(off_dest - dst.offset);
                }
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for ((i, shape), off) in self.shapes().enumerate().zip(shape_offsets)
                    {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_terrain_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        offset = extra.add_size(offset);
                    }
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPc::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset += Matrix4x4Pc::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                counts.offsets += self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num();
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.vbuff_num();
                let off_dest = offset + 320;
                offset += u32Pc::size_of() * self.ibuff_num();
                offset += self.add_misc_size(offset, counts);
                offset = off_dest.max(offset);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpModelXbox {
            fn bone_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vals_j_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn skin_bind_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_skin_order(&self) -> bool;
            fn mat_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn shape_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn mesh_order_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vbuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn ibuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_vals_k(&self) -> bool;
            fn slot_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn slot_map_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn block_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn hk_constraint_data_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_bones(&self, bones: BonesDumpXbox) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_j(&self, vals_j: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_binds(&self, skin_binds: &mut [Matrix4x4Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_order(&self, skin_order: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mat_order(&self, mat_order: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_order(&self, mesh_order: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_bounding_boxes(
                &self,
                mesh_bboxes: &mut [BoundingBoxXbox],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vbuff_order(&self, vbuff_order: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_ibuff_order(&self, ibuff_order: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_k(
                &self,
                header: &mut [u16Xbox],
                vals_k: &mut [u32Xbox],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slots(&self, slots: &mut [Key2Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slot_map(&self, slot_map: &mut [u32Xbox]) -> Result<()>;
            fn mat_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn mats(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, impl DumpMatXbox)>;
            fn hk_constraint_datas(
                &self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl Into<HkConstraintDataXbox>>;
            fn shapes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpShapeXbox>;
            fn hk_constraint(&self) -> Option<&impl DumpHkConstraintXbox>;
            fn block_header(&self) -> Option<impl Into<u32Xbox>>;
            fn blocks(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpBlockXbox>;
            fn dump_misc(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosXbox,
                info: &mut ModelInfoXbox,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.vals_k_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let vals_k_header = u16Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 2)
                        .context("val_k_header")?;
                    let vals_k = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 35)
                        .context("vals_k")?;
                    self.write_vals_k(vals_k_header, vals_k).context("vals_k")?;
                } else {
                    info.vals_k_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    info.slots_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slots = Key2Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_num())
                        .context("slots")?;
                    self.write_slots(slots).context("write slots")?;
                    info.slot_map_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slot_map = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_map_num())
                        .context("slot_map")?;
                    self.write_slot_map(slot_map).context("write slot_map")?;
                } else {
                    info.slots_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if let Some(block_header) = self.block_header() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    let start = dst.offset;
                    info.block_offset = start.conv();
                    *u32Xbox::mut_from_data(dst).context("block_header")? = block_header
                        .into();
                    let block_offsets = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.block_num() + 1,
                        )
                        .context("block_offsets")?;
                    for (i, (block, off)) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_offsets.iter_mut())
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        dst.align(16);
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                        block
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    if let Some(off) = block_offsets.last_mut() {
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    }
                }
                info.hk_constraint_data_num = self.hk_constraint_data_num().conv();
                if info.hk_constraint_data_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.hk_constraint_data_offset = infos
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .offset
                        .conv();
                    for info in self.hk_constraint_datas() {
                        *infos.hk_constraint_datas.next() = info.into();
                    }
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_misc_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16) + 2 * u16Xbox::size_of()
                        + 35 * u32Xbox::size_of();
                }
                offset
                    += Key2Xbox::size_of() * self.slot_num()
                        + u32Xbox::size_of() * self.slot_map_num();
                if self.block_header().is_some() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                        + (2 + self.block_num()) * u32Xbox::size_of();
                    for block in self.blocks() {
                        offset = block.add_size(align_offset(offset, 16));
                    }
                }
                counts.hk_constraint_datas += self.hk_constraint_data_num();
                offset
            }
            fn dump_mats(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosXbox,
                info: &mut ModelInfoXbox,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                info.mat_offset = off.conv();
                let mat_map = self
                    .mats()
                    .map(|(i, mat)| (i, mat.dump_infos(infos)))
                    .collect::<HashMap<_, _>>();
                let mat_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mat_num())
                    .context("mat_order")?;
                info.mat_num = mat_order.len().conv();
                for (i, mat) in self.mat_order().zip(mat_order) {
                    *mat = mat_map
                        .get(&i)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("mats is missing item {0}", i),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_mat_counts(&self, counts: &mut InfoCounts) {
                for mat in self.mats() {
                    mat.1.add_counts(counts);
                }
            }
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosXbox,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bones = CrcXbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.bone_num())
                    .context("bones")?;
                info.bones_num = bones.len().conv();
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_bboxes = BoundingBoxXbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vals_j_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_j = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_j_num())
                    .context("vals_j")?;
                info.vals_j_num = vals_j.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_j(vals_j).context("write vals_j")?;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.to_native() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.to_native(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.skin_binds_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.skin_bind_num(),
                    )
                    .context("skin_binds")?;
                info.skin_binds_num = skin_binds.len().conv();
                self.write_skin_binds(skin_binds).context("write skin_binds")?;
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    info.skin_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let skin_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, skin_binds.len())
                        .context("skin_order")?;
                    self.write_skin_order(skin_order).context("write skin_order")?;
                } else {
                    info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.bone_parents_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_parents = i32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_parents")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        bones.len(),
                    )
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpXbox {
                        names: bones,
                        parents: bone_parents,
                        bounding_boxes: bone_bboxes,
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, None)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        mesh_order.len(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vbuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let vbuff_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vbuff_num())
                    .context("vbuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..vbuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.vbuff_num = vbuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_vbuff_order(vbuff_order).context("write vbuff_order")?;
                info.ibuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let ibuff_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.ibuff_num())
                    .context("ibuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..ibuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.ibuff_num = ibuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_ibuff_order(ibuff_order).context("write ibuff_order")?;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                offset += CrcXbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxXbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.vals_j_num();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Xbox::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                }
                offset += i32Xbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Xbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxXbox::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                counts.offsets += self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num();
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * (self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num());
                self.add_misc_size(offset, counts)
            }
            fn dump_terrain_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosXbox,
                indices_offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let bone_bbox_offset = infos.models.offset + 16;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bones_num = self.bone_num().conv();
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = bone_bbox_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_num = 0u32.conv();
                info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bone_parents_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.to_native() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.to_native(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                let mut shape_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(self.shape_num());
                for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        shape_offsets.push(Some(dst.offset));
                        extra
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0} extra", i))
                            }))?;
                    } else {
                        shape_offsets.push(None);
                    }
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxXbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.mesh_order_num(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.bone_num(),
                    )
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpXbox {
                        names: &mut [],
                        parents: &mut [],
                        bounding_boxes: &mut [],
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                info.vbuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let vbuff_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vbuff_num())
                    .context("vbuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..vbuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.vbuff_num = vbuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_vbuff_order(vbuff_order).context("write vbuff_order")?;
                let off_dest = dst.offset + 320;
                info.ibuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let ibuff_order = u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.ibuff_num())
                    .context("ibuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..ibuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.ibuff_num = ibuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_ibuff_order(ibuff_order).context("write ibuff_order")?;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info)?;
                if dst.offset < off_dest {
                    *dst = dst.split(off_dest - dst.offset);
                }
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for ((i, shape), off) in self.shapes().enumerate().zip(shape_offsets)
                    {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_terrain_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        offset = extra.add_size(offset);
                    }
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxXbox::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset += Matrix4x4Xbox::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                counts.offsets += self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num();
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.vbuff_num();
                let off_dest = offset + 320;
                offset += u32Xbox::size_of() * self.ibuff_num();
                offset += self.add_misc_size(offset, counts);
                offset = off_dest.max(offset);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpModelPs3 {
            fn bone_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vals_j_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn skin_bind_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_skin_order(&self) -> bool;
            fn mat_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn shape_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn mesh_order_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn vbuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn ibuff_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn has_vals_k(&self) -> bool;
            fn slot_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn slot_map_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn block_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn hk_constraint_data_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn write_bones(&self, bones: BonesDumpPs3) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_j(&self, vals_j: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_binds(&self, skin_binds: &mut [Matrix4x4Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_skin_order(&self, skin_order: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mat_order(&self, mat_order: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_order(&self, mesh_order: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_mesh_bounding_boxes(
                &self,
                mesh_bboxes: &mut [BoundingBoxPs3],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vbuff_order(&self, vbuff_order: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_ibuff_order(&self, ibuff_order: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_vals_k(
                &self,
                header: &mut [u16Ps3],
                vals_k: &mut [u32Ps3],
            ) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slots(&self, slots: &mut [Key2Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_slot_map(&self, slot_map: &mut [u32Ps3]) -> Result<()>;
            fn mat_order(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = u32>;
            fn mats(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = (u32, impl DumpMatPs3)>;
            fn hk_constraint_datas(
                &self,
            ) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl Into<HkConstraintDataPs3>>;
            fn shapes(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpShapePs3>;
            fn hk_constraint(&self) -> Option<&impl DumpHkConstraintPs3>;
            fn block_header(&self) -> Option<impl Into<u32Ps3>>;
            fn blocks(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpBlockPs3>;
            fn dump_misc(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPs3,
                info: &mut ModelInfoPs3,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    info.vals_k_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let vals_k_header = u16Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 2)
                        .context("val_k_header")?;
                    let vals_k = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, 35).context("vals_k")?;
                    self.write_vals_k(vals_k_header, vals_k).context("vals_k")?;
                } else {
                    info.vals_k_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if self.slot_num() != 0 {
                    info.slots_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slots = Key2Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_num())
                        .context("slots")?;
                    self.write_slots(slots).context("write slots")?;
                    info.slot_map_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let slot_map = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.slot_map_num())
                        .context("slot_map")?;
                    self.write_slot_map(slot_map).context("write slot_map")?;
                } else {
                    info.slots_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                if let Some(block_header) = self.block_header() {
                    dst.align(16);
                    let start = dst.offset;
                    info.block_offset = start.conv();
                    *u32Ps3::mut_from_data(dst).context("block_header")? = block_header
                        .into();
                    let block_offsets = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(
                            dst,
                            self.block_num() + 1,
                        )
                        .context("block_offsets")?;
                    for (i, (block, off)) in self
                        .blocks()
                        .zip(block_offsets.iter_mut())
                        .enumerate()
                    {
                        dst.align(16);
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                        block
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                    if let Some(off) = block_offsets.last_mut() {
                        *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                    }
                }
                info.hk_constraint_data_num = self.hk_constraint_data_num().conv();
                if info.hk_constraint_data_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.hk_constraint_data_offset = infos
                        .hk_constraint_datas
                        .offset
                        .conv();
                    for info in self.hk_constraint_datas() {
                        *infos.hk_constraint_datas.next() = info.into();
                    }
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_misc_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                if self.has_vals_k() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16) + 2 * u16Ps3::size_of()
                        + 35 * u32Ps3::size_of();
                }
                offset
                    += Key2Ps3::size_of() * self.slot_num()
                        + u32Ps3::size_of() * self.slot_map_num();
                if self.block_header().is_some() {
                    offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                        + (2 + self.block_num()) * u32Ps3::size_of();
                    for block in self.blocks() {
                        offset = block.add_size(align_offset(offset, 16));
                    }
                }
                counts.hk_constraint_datas += self.hk_constraint_data_num();
                offset
            }
            fn dump_mats(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPs3,
                info: &mut ModelInfoPs3,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                info.mat_offset = off.conv();
                let mat_map = self
                    .mats()
                    .map(|(i, mat)| (i, mat.dump_infos(infos)))
                    .collect::<HashMap<_, _>>();
                let mat_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mat_num())
                    .context("mat_order")?;
                info.mat_num = mat_order.len().conv();
                for (i, mat) in self.mat_order().zip(mat_order) {
                    *mat = mat_map
                        .get(&i)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("mats is missing item {0}", i),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?
                        .conv();
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_mat_counts(&self, counts: &mut InfoCounts) {
                for mat in self.mats() {
                    mat.1.add_counts(counts);
                }
            }
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPs3,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bones = CrcPs3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.bone_num())
                    .context("bones")?;
                info.bones_num = bones.len().conv();
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_bboxes = BoundingBoxPs3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vals_j_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let vals_j = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_j_num())
                    .context("vals_j")?;
                info.vals_j_num = vals_j.len().conv();
                self.write_vals_j(vals_j).context("write vals_j")?;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.to_native() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.to_native(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.skin_binds_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let skin_binds = Matrix4x4Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.skin_bind_num(),
                    )
                    .context("skin_binds")?;
                info.skin_binds_num = skin_binds.len().conv();
                self.write_skin_binds(skin_binds).context("write skin_binds")?;
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    info.skin_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                    let skin_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, skin_binds.len())
                        .context("skin_order")?;
                    self.write_skin_order(skin_order).context("write skin_order")?;
                } else {
                    info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.bone_parents_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_parents = i32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_parents")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, bones.len())
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpPs3 {
                        names: bones,
                        parents: bone_parents,
                        bounding_boxes: bone_bboxes,
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, None)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxPs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        mesh_order.len(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.vbuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let vbuff_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vbuff_num())
                    .context("vbuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..vbuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.vbuff_num = vbuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_vbuff_order(vbuff_order).context("write vbuff_order")?;
                info.ibuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let ibuff_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.ibuff_num())
                    .context("ibuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..ibuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.ibuff_num = ibuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_ibuff_order(ibuff_order).context("write ibuff_order")?;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info)?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_size(&self, mut offset: usize, counts: &mut InfoCounts) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                offset += CrcPs3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPs3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.vals_j_num();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Ps3::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                if self.has_skin_order() {
                    offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.skin_bind_num();
                }
                offset += i32Ps3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + Matrix4x4Ps3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPs3::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                counts.offsets += self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num();
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * (self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num());
                self.add_misc_size(offset, counts)
            }
            fn dump_terrain_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                infos: &mut DumpInfosPs3,
                indices_offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let bone_bbox_offset = infos.models.offset + 16;
                let info = infos.models.next();
                info.bones_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bones_num = self.bone_num().conv();
                info.bone_bounding_boxes_offset = bone_bbox_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                info.skin_binds_num = 0u32.conv();
                info.skin_order_offset = 0u32.conv();
                info.bone_parents_offset = indices_offset.conv();
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = infos.hk_constraints.offset.conv();
                    hk_constraint
                        .dump_into(
                            dst,
                            infos,
                            info.bones_offset.to_native() as u16,
                            info.bones_num.to_native(),
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint")?;
                } else {
                    info.hk_constraint_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                let mut shape_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(self.shape_num());
                for (i, shape) in self.shapes().enumerate() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        shape_offsets.push(Some(dst.offset));
                        extra
                            .dump_into(dst)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0} extra", i))
                            }))?;
                    } else {
                        shape_offsets.push(None);
                    }
                }
                dst.align(16);
                info.mesh_bounding_boxes_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_bboxes = BoundingBoxPs3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.mesh_order_num(),
                    )
                    .context("mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                self.write_mesh_bounding_boxes(mesh_bboxes)
                    .context("write mesh_bounding_boxes")?;
                info.bone_transforms_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let bone_transforms = Matrix4x4Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(
                        dst,
                        self.bone_num(),
                    )
                    .context("bone_transforms")?;
                self.write_bones(BonesDumpPs3 {
                        names: &mut [],
                        parents: &mut [],
                        bounding_boxes: &mut [],
                        transforms: bone_transforms,
                    })
                    .context("write bones")?;
                self.dump_mats(dst, infos, info)?;
                info.mesh_order_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mesh_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.mesh_order_num())
                    .context("mesh_order")?;
                self.write_mesh_order(mesh_order).context("write mesh_order")?;
                info.vbuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let vbuff_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vbuff_num())
                    .context("vbuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..vbuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.vbuff_num = vbuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_vbuff_order(vbuff_order).context("write vbuff_order")?;
                let off_dest = dst.offset + 320;
                info.ibuff_offset = dst.offset.conv();
                let mut off = dst.offset;
                let ibuff_order = u32Ps3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.ibuff_num())
                    .context("ibuff_order")?;
                for _ in 0..ibuff_order.len() {
                    *infos.offsets.next() = off.conv();
                    off += 4;
                }
                info.ibuff_num = ibuff_order.len().conv();
                self.write_ibuff_order(ibuff_order).context("write ibuff_order")?;
                self.dump_misc(dst, infos, info)?;
                if dst.offset < off_dest {
                    *dst = dst.split(off_dest - dst.offset);
                }
                info.shape_num = self.shape_num().conv();
                if info.shape_num.to_native() != 0 {
                    info.shape_offset = infos.shapes.offset.conv();
                    for ((i, shape), off) in self.shapes().enumerate().zip(shape_offsets)
                    {
                        shape
                            .dump_into(dst, infos, off)
                            .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                            }))?;
                    }
                } else {
                    info.shape_offset = 0u32.conv();
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            fn add_terrain_size(
                &self,
                mut offset: usize,
                counts: &mut InfoCounts,
            ) -> usize {
                counts.models += 1;
                if let Some(hk_constraint) = self.hk_constraint() {
                    offset = hk_constraint.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    if let Some(extra) = shape.extra() {
                        offset = extra.add_size(offset);
                    }
                }
                offset = align_offset(offset, 16)
                    + BoundingBoxPs3::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                offset += Matrix4x4Ps3::size_of() * self.bone_num();
                self.add_mat_counts(counts);
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.mesh_order_num();
                counts.offsets += self.vbuff_num() + self.ibuff_num();
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.vbuff_num();
                let off_dest = offset + 320;
                offset += u32Ps3::size_of() * self.ibuff_num();
                offset += self.add_misc_size(offset, counts);
                offset = off_dest.max(offset);
                for shape in self.shapes() {
                    offset = shape.add_size(offset, counts);
                }
                offset
            }
        }
    }

            impl Obj1Pc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    mut offset: usize,
                    flags: u8,
                    kind: u8,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let start = offset;
                    let (s1, s2, data) = if flags & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        let s1 = u16Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("s1")?;
                        offset += s1.size();
                        let s2 = u8::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("s2")?;
                        offset += s2.size();
                        let data = u8::slice_from_data(
                                &src[offset..],
                                s1.to_native() as usize + *s2 as usize + 2,
                            )
                            .context("data")?;
                        offset += data.size();
                        (*s1, *s2, data.into())
                    } else {
                        (u16Pc::from(0), 0, NonNull::from_ref(&[] as &[u8]))
                    };
                    let vals_a = if flags != 0 {
                        offset = align_offset(offset, 4);
                        let num = Self::COUNTS[(flags & 7) as usize]
                            + 2 * Self::COUNTS[(((flags >> 4) & !flags) & 7) as usize];
                        let vals_a = f32Pc::slice_from_data(&src[offset..], num)
                            .context("vals_a")?;
                        offset += vals_a.size();
                        vals_a.into()
                    } else {
                        NonNull::from_ref(&[] as &[f32Pc])
                    };
                    let vals = if flags & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        offset = align_offset(offset, 2);
                        let num = Self::COUNTS[((flags >> 4) & 7) as usize]
                            * (s1.to_native() as usize + 1);
                        let vals = Obj1TypesPc::from_bytes(src, offset, num, kind)
                            .context("vals")?;
                        offset += vals.size();
                        vals
                    } else {
                        Obj1TypesPc::empty(kind).context("vals")?
                    };
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        flags,
                        data,
                        s1,
                        s2,
                        vals_a,
                        vals,
                        size: offset - start,
                    })
                }
            }

            pub trait DumpObj1Pc {
                fn flags(&self) -> u8;
                fn write_s1(&self, s1: &mut u16Pc) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_s2(&self, s2: &mut u8) -> Result<()>;
                fn data_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn vals_a_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn write_data(&self, data: &mut [u8]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_vals_a(&self, vals_a: &mut [f32Pc]) -> Result<()>;
                fn write_vals(&self, vals: Obj1TypesDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
                fn vals_kind(&self) -> u8;
                fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
                fn vals_size(&self) -> usize {
                    match self.vals_kind() {
                        0 => self.vals_len(),
                        1 | 2 | 3 => self.vals_len() * u16Pc::size_of(),
                        _ => {
                            ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(
                                format_args!("Invalid vals kind"),
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
                fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                    if self.flags() & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        let s1 = u16Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("s1")?;
                        self.write_s1(s1).context("write s1")?;
                        let s2 = u8::mut_from_data(dst).context("s2")?;
                        self.write_s2(s2).context("write s2")?;
                        let data = u8::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.data_len())
                            .context("data")?;
                        self.write_data(data).context("write data")?;
                    }
                    if self.flags() != 0 {
                        dst.align(4);
                        let vals_a = f32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_a_len())
                            .context("vals_a")?;
                        self.write_vals_a(vals_a).context("write vals_a")?;
                    }
                    if self.flags() & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        dst.align(2);
                        let vals = Obj1TypesDumpPc::mut_from_data(
                                dst,
                                self.vals_kind(),
                                self.vals_len(),
                            )
                            .context("vals")?;
                        self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
                    }
                    Ok(())
                }
                fn size(&self) -> usize {
                    let mut size = 0;
                    if self.flags() & 0xf0 != 0 {
                        size += u16Pc::size_of();
                        size += u8::size_of();
                        size += self.data_len();
                    }
                    if self.flags() != 0 {
                        size = align_offset(size, 4);
                        size += f32Pc::size_of() * self.vals_a_len();
                    }
                    if self.flags() != 0xf0 {
                        size = align_offset(size, 2);
                        size += self.vals_size();
                    }
                    size
                }
            }
