            unsafe impl Sync for ObjsPc {}
            unsafe impl Sync for ObjsXbox {}
            unsafe impl Sync for ObjsPs3 {}
            unsafe impl Send for ObjsPc {}
            unsafe impl Send for ObjsXbox {}
            unsafe impl Send for ObjsPs3 {}
            impl ObjsPc {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    bin: &BinPc,
                    sub_blocks: &SubBlocksPc,
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let objas = ObjAPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obja_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obja_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("objas")?;
                    let obj0s = Obj0Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obj0_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obj0_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    let model_data = bin.model_data();
                    let model_off = pak_header.model_info_offset.to_native() as usize;
                    let models = (0..pak_header.model_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            ModelRawPc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    model_data,
                                    model_off + i * ModelInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .and_then(|x| ModelPc::try_from(x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("model {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.buffer_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.buffer_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let mat1s = Mat1Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat1_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat1_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    let mat2s = Mat2Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat2_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat2_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    let mat3s = Mat3Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat3_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat3_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    let mat4s = Mat4Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat4_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat4_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    let mat_extras = MatExtraPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat_extra_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat_extra_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    let shape_off = pak_header.shape_info_offset.to_native() as usize;
                    let shapes = (0..pak_header.shape_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            ShapePc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    shape_off + i * ShapeInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_shape_off = pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.to_native()
                        as usize;
                    let hk_shapes = (0..pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.to_native()
                        as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkShapePc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    hk_shape_off + i * HkShapeInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_constraint_off = pak_header
                        .hk_constraint_info_offset
                        .to_native() as usize;
                    let hk_constraints = (0..pak_header
                        .hk_constraint_info_num
                        .to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkConstraintPc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    hk_constraint_off + i * HkConstraintInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_constraint {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_constraint_datas = HkConstraintDataPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    let texture_infos = TextureInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.texture_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.texture_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    let animation_infos = AnimationInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_info_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let foliage_off = pak_header.foliage_info_offset.to_native()
                        as usize;
                    let foliages = (0..pak_header.foliage_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            FoliagePc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    foliage_off + i * FoliageInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_val_off = pak_header
                        .radiosity_vals_info_offset
                        .to_native() as usize;
                    let radiosity_vals = (0..pak_header
                        .radiosity_vals_info_num
                        .to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            RadiosityValsPc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    radiosity_val_off + i * RadiosityValsInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("radiosity_vals {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let gfx_blocks = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| {
                            NonNull::from_ref(
                                &src[info.offset.to_native()
                                    as usize..(info.offset.to_native() + info.size.to_native())
                                    as usize],
                            )
                        })
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    let effects = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| {
                            GameObjsPc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.offset.to_native() as usize,
                                info.size.to_native() as usize,
                                info.gamemodemask.to_native(),
                            )
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let level = sub_blocks
                        .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missing level sub_block"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                        .level()
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("incorrect level type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?;
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRawPc::from_bytes(
                            src,
                            bin,
                            level,
                            pak_header,
                        )
                        .and_then(|x| RadiosityPc::try_from(x))
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    let texture_data = bin.texture_data();
                    let textures = (0..pak_header.texture_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            TextureRawPc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    texture_data,
                                    model_off + i * TextureInfoPc::size_of(),
                                )
                                .and_then(|x| TexturePc::try_from(x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        textures: textures.into(),
                        models: models.into(),
                        shapes: shapes.into(),
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                        hk_constraints: hk_constraints.into(),
                        effects: effects.into(),
                        gfx_blocks: gfx_blocks.into(),
                        radiosity_vals: radiosity_vals.into(),
                        foliages: foliages.into(),
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }
            impl ObjsXbox {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    bin: &BinXbox,
                    sub_blocks: &SubBlocksXbox,
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderXbox,

                        .map(|i| {

                                    src,
                                    model_data,
                                    model_off + i * ModelInfoXbox::size_of(),
                                )
                                .and_then(|x| ModelXbox::try_from(x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({

                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoXbox::slice_from_data(

                        .context("buffer_infos")?;

                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_shape_off = pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.to_native()
                        as usize;
                    let hk_shapes = (0..pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.to_native()
                        as usize)

                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })

                    let hk_constraint_off = pak_header
                        .hk_constraint_info_offset
                        .to_native() as usize;
                    let hk_constraints = (0..pak_header
                        .hk_constraint_info_num
                        .to_native() as usize)

                        )

                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.to_native() as usize,

                        )

                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let foliage_off = pak_header.foliage_info_offset.to_native()
                        as usize;
                    let foliages = (0..pak_header.foliage_info_num.to_native() as usize)

                            FoliageXbox::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    foliage_off + i * FoliageInfoXbox::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_val_off = pak_header
                        .radiosity_vals_info_offset
                        .to_native() as usize;
                    let radiosity_vals = (0..pak_header
                        .radiosity_vals_info_num
                        .to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            RadiosityValsXbox::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    radiosity_val_off + i * RadiosityValsInfoXbox::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("radiosity_vals {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoXbox::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let gfx_blocks = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| {
                            NonNull::from_ref(
                                &src[info.offset.to_native()
                                    as usize..(info.offset.to_native() + info.size.to_native())
                                    as usize],
                            )
                        })
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    let effects = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| {
                            GameObjsXbox::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.offset.to_native() as usize,
                                info.size.to_native() as usize,
                                info.gamemodemask.to_native(),
                            )
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let level = sub_blocks
                        .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missing level sub_block"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                        .level()
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("incorrect level type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?;
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRawXbox::from_bytes(
                            src,
                            bin,
                            level,
                            pak_header,
                        )
                        .and_then(|x| RadiosityXbox::try_from(x))
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    let texture_data = bin.texture_data();
                    let textures = (0..pak_header.texture_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            TextureRawXbox::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    texture_data,
                                    model_off + i * TextureInfoXbox::size_of(),
                                )
                                .and_then(|x| TextureXbox::try_from(x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        textures: textures.into(),
                        models: models.into(),
                        shapes: shapes.into(),
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                        hk_constraints: hk_constraints.into(),
                        effects: effects.into(),
                        gfx_blocks: gfx_blocks.into(),
                        radiosity_vals: radiosity_vals.into(),
                        foliages: foliages.into(),
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }
            impl ObjsPs3 {
                pub fn from_bytes(
                    src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                    bin: &BinPs3,
                    sub_blocks: &SubBlocksPs3,
                    pak_header: &PakHeaderPs3,
                ) -> Result<Self> {
                    let objas = ObjAPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obja_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obja_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("objas")?;
                    let obj0s = Obj0Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.obj0_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.obj0_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("obj0s")?;
                    let model_data = bin.model_data();
                    let model_off = pak_header.model_info_offset.to_native() as usize;
                    let models = (0..pak_header.model_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            ModelRawPs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    model_data,
                                    model_off + i * ModelInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .and_then(|x| ModelPs3::try_from(x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("model {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let buffer_infos = BufferInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.buffer_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.buffer_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("buffer_infos")?;
                    let mat1s = Mat1Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat1_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat1_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat1s")?;
                    let mat2s = Mat2Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat2_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat2_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat2s")?;
                    let mat3s = Mat3Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat3_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat3_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat3s")?;
                    let mat4s = Mat4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat4_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat4_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat4s")?;
                    let mat_extras = MatExtraPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.mat_extra_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.mat_extra_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("mat_extras")?;
                    let shape_off = pak_header.shape_info_offset.to_native() as usize;
                    let shapes = (0..pak_header.shape_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            ShapePs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    shape_off + i * ShapeInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_shape_off = pak_header.hk_shape_info_offset.to_native()
                        as usize;
                    let hk_shapes = (0..pak_header.hk_shape_info_num.to_native()
                        as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkShapePs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    hk_shape_off + i * HkShapeInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_shape {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_constraint_off = pak_header
                        .hk_constraint_info_offset
                        .to_native() as usize;
                    let hk_constraints = (0..pak_header
                        .hk_constraint_info_num
                        .to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            HkConstraintPs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    hk_constraint_off + i * HkConstraintInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("hk_constraint {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let hk_constraint_datas = HkConstraintDataPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.hk_constraint_data_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.hk_constraint_data_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("hk_constraint_datas")?;
                    let vbuff_infos = VBuffInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.vbuff_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.vbuff_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("vbuff_infos")?;
                    let ibuff_infos = IBuffInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.ibuff_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.ibuff_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("ibuff_infos")?;
                    let texture_infos = TextureInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.texture_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.texture_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("texture_infos")?;
                    let animation_infos = AnimationInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_info_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_infos")?;
                    let effect_infos = EffectInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.effect_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.effect_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("effect_infos")?;
                    let foliage_off = pak_header.foliage_info_offset.to_native()
                        as usize;
                    let foliages = (0..pak_header.foliage_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            FoliagePs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    foliage_off + i * FoliageInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("foliage {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let pfield_infos = PFieldInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.pfield_info_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                            pak_header.pfield_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("pfield_infos")?;
                    let gfx_block_infos = GFXBlockInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.gfx_block_info_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.gfx_block_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("gfx_block_infos")?;
                    let radiosity_val_off = pak_header
                        .radiosity_vals_info_offset
                        .to_native() as usize;
                    let radiosity_vals = (0..pak_header
                        .radiosity_vals_info_num
                        .to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            RadiosityValsPs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    radiosity_val_off + i * RadiosityValsInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("radiosity_vals {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let animation_block_infos = AnimationBlockInfoPs3::slice_from_data(
                            &src[pak_header.animation_block_info_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.animation_block_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("animation_block_infos")?;
                    let gfx_blocks = gfx_block_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| {
                            NonNull::from_ref(
                                &src[info.offset.to_native()
                                    as usize..(info.offset.to_native() + info.size.to_native())
                                    as usize],
                            )
                        })
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
                    let effects = effect_infos
                        .iter()
                        .map(|info| {
                            GameObjsPs3::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                info.offset.to_native() as usize,
                                info.size.to_native() as usize,
                                info.gamemodemask.to_native(),
                            )
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    let level = sub_blocks
                        .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missing level sub_block"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                        .level()
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("incorrect level type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?;
                    let radiosity = RadiosityRawPs3::from_bytes(
                            src,
                            bin,
                            level,
                            pak_header,
                        )
                        .and_then(|x| RadiosityPs3::try_from(x))
                        .context("radiosity")?;
                    let texture_data = bin.texture_data();
                    let textures = (0..pak_header.texture_info_num.to_native() as usize)
                        .map(|i| {
                            TextureRawPs3::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    texture_data,
                                    model_off + i * TextureInfoPs3::size_of(),
                                )
                                .and_then(|x| TexturePs3::try_from(x))
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("texture {0}", i))
                                }))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    Ok(Self {
                        _ptr: src.clone(),
                        objas: objas.into(),
                        obj0s: obj0s.into(),
                        buffer_infos: buffer_infos.into(),
                        mat1s: mat1s.into(),
                        mat2s: mat2s.into(),
                        mat3s: mat3s.into(),
                        mat4s: mat4s.into(),
                        mat_extras: mat_extras.into(),
                        hk_constraint_datas: hk_constraint_datas.into(),
                        vbuff_infos: vbuff_infos.into(),
                        ibuff_infos: ibuff_infos.into(),
                        texture_infos: texture_infos.into(),
                        animation_infos: animation_infos.into(),
                        effect_infos: effect_infos.into(),
                        pfield_infos: pfield_infos.into(),
                        gfx_block_infos: gfx_block_infos.into(),
                        animation_block_infos: animation_block_infos.into(),
                        textures: textures.into(),
                        models: models.into(),
                        shapes: shapes.into(),
                        hk_shapes: hk_shapes.into(),
                        hk_constraints: hk_constraints.into(),
                        effects: effects.into(),
                        gfx_blocks: gfx_blocks.into(),
                        radiosity_vals: radiosity_vals.into(),
                        foliages: foliages.into(),
                        radiosity,
                    })
                }
            }

            pub struct Objs {
                pub objas: Vec<ObjA>,

            pub struct DumpInfo<'a, T: RefFromData> {
                pub vals: &'a mut [T],
                pub ind: usize,
                pub offset: usize,
            }
            impl<'a, T: RefFromData> Default for DumpInfo<'a, T> {
                fn default() -> Self {
                    Self {
                        vals: &mut [],
                        ind: 0,
                        offset: 0,
                    }
                }
            }
            impl<'a, T: RefFromData> DumpInfo<'a, T> {
                pub fn as_ref(&mut self) -> &mut [T] {
                    self.vals
                }
                pub fn take(&mut self) -> &mut [T] {
                    let val = std::mem::take(self);
                    val.vals
                }
                pub fn ref_from(src: &mut DumpSlice<'a>, size: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                    let offset = src.offset;
                    let vals = T::mut_slice_from_data(src, size)?;
                    let ind = 0;
                    Ok(Self { vals, ind, offset })
                }
                pub fn next(&mut self) -> &'a mut T {
                    let Self { vals, mut ind, mut offset } = std::mem::take(self);
                    let (val, vals) = vals.split_first_mut().unwrap();
                    ind += 1;
                    offset += val.size();
                    *self = Self { vals, ind, offset };
                    val
                }
            }

                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                bin: &BinPc,
                pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let data: Arc<[u8]> = decompress_block(
                        &src[pak_header.block1_offset.to_native() as usize..],

                        pak_header.block1_size.to_native() as usize,

                    .context("compressed_data")?
                    .into();
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let sub_blocks = sub_blocks::SubBlocksPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        pak_header.sub_blocks1_offset.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("sub_blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 sub_blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let objs = objs::ObjsPc::from_bytes(&data, bin, &sub_blocks, pak_header)
                    .context("objs")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 objs parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let string_keys = types::StringKeysPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,

                {

                        format_args!(

                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),

                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: data,

                    string_keys,

            }

                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 objs parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let string_keys = types::StringKeysPs3::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        pak_header.string_keys_offset.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("string_keys")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block1 string_keys parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: data,
                    objs,
                    sub_blocks,
                    string_keys,
                })
            }
        }

        impl Block2Pc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let data: Arc<[u8]> = decompress_block(
                        &src[pak_header.block2_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        pak_header.block2_size_comp.to_native() as usize,
                        pak_header.block2_size.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("compressed_data")?
                    .into();
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 data parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let sub_blocks = sub_blocks::SubBlocksPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        pak_header.sub_blocks2_offset.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("sub_blocks")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 sub_blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let offsets = NonNull::from_ref(
                    u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                            &data[pak_header.block2_offsets_offset.to_native()
                                as usize..],
                            pak_header.block2_offsets_num.to_native() as usize,
                        )
                        .context("offsets")?,
                );
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Block2 offsets parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: data,
                    sub_blocks,
                    offsets,
                })
            }
        }

        impl PakPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(data: Arc<[u8]>) -> Result<Self> {
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let header = PakHeaderPc::from_data(&data[..]).context("header")?;
                let strings = types::StringsPc::from_bytes(
                        &data,
                        header.strings_offset.to_native() as usize,
                        header.strings_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("strings")?;
                update_crc(strings.strings());
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak headers parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                let vals_a = BlockAValPc::slice_from_data(
                        &data[header.block_a_offset.to_native() as usize..],
                        header.block_a_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("vals_a")?;
                {
                    ::std::io::_print(
                        format_args!(
                            "Pak vals_a parsed in {0}\n",
                            t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                        ),
                    );
                };
                let header = NonNull::from_ref(header);
                let vals_a = NonNull::from_ref(vals_a);
                Ok(Self {
                    data,
                    header,
                    strings,
                    block1: None,
                    block2: None,
                    animation_blocks: None,
                    vals_a,
                })
            }
        }

        impl PakPc {
            pub fn parse_block1(&mut self, bin: &BinPc) -> Result<()> {
                if self.block1.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    self.block1
                        .replace(Block1Pc::from_bytes(&self.data, bin, self.header())?);
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak block1 parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse_block2(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
                if self.block2.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    self.block2
                        .replace(Block2Pc::from_bytes(&self.data, self.header())?);
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak block2 parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse_animation_blocks(&mut self, bin: &BinPc) -> Result<()> {
                self.parse_block1(bin).context("block1")?;
                if self.animation_blocks.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let block1 = self.block1.as_ref().unwrap();
                    self.animation_blocks
                        .replace(
                            AnimationsPc::from_bytes(
                                    &self.data,
                                    self.header(),
                                    &block1._ptr,
                                )
                                .context("animation_blocks")?,
                        );
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak animation blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse(&mut self, bin: &BinPc) -> Result<()> {
                self.parse_block2().context("block2")?;
                self.parse_animation_blocks(bin)
            }
            pub fn header(&self) -> &PakHeaderPc {
                unsafe { self.header.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn strings(&self) -> &types::StringsPc {
                &self.strings
            }
            pub fn block1(&self) -> Option<&Block1Pc> {
                self.block1.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn block2(&self) -> Option<&Block2Pc> {
                self.block2.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn animation_blocks(&self) -> Option<&AnimationsPc> {
                self.animation_blocks.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn vals_a(&self) -> &[BlockAValPc] {
                unsafe { self.vals_a.as_ref() }
            }
        }
        impl PakXbox {
            pub fn parse_block1(&mut self, bin: &BinXbox) -> Result<()> {
                if self.block1.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    self.block1
                        .replace(
                            Block1Xbox::from_bytes(&self.data, bin, self.header())?,
                        );
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak block1 parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse_block2(&mut self) -> Result<()> {
                if self.block2.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    self.block2
                        .replace(Block2Xbox::from_bytes(&self.data, self.header())?);
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak block2 parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse_animation_blocks(&mut self, bin: &BinXbox) -> Result<()> {
                self.parse_block1(bin).context("block1")?;
                if self.animation_blocks.is_none() {
                    let t = std::time::Instant::now();
                    let block1 = self.block1.as_ref().unwrap();
                    self.animation_blocks
                        .replace(
                            AnimationsXbox::from_bytes(
                                    &self.data,
                                    self.header(),
                                    &block1._ptr,
                                )
                                .context("animation_blocks")?,
                        );
                    {
                        ::std::io::_print(
                            format_args!(
                                "Pak animation blocks parsed in {0}\n",
                                t.elapsed().as_secs_f32(),
                            ),
                        );
                    };
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            pub fn parse(&mut self, bin: &BinXbox) -> Result<()> {
                self.parse_block2().context("block2")?;
                self.parse_animation_blocks(bin)
            }
            pub fn header(&self) -> &PakHeaderXbox {
                unsafe { self.header.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn strings(&self) -> &types::StringsXbox {
                &self.strings
            }
            pub fn block1(&self) -> Option<&Block1Xbox> {
                self.block1.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn block2(&self) -> Option<&Block2Xbox> {
                self.block2.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn animation_blocks(&self) -> Option<&AnimationsXbox> {
                self.animation_blocks.as_ref()
            }
            pub fn vals_a(&self) -> &[BlockAValXbox] {
                unsafe { self.vals_a.as_ref() }
            }
        }

        impl RadiosityRawPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                bin: &BinPc,
                level: &GameObjsPc,
                pak_header: &PakHeaderPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let infos = RadiosityValsInfoPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_offset.to_native()
                            as usize..],
                        pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("infos")?;
                let offs = infos
                    .iter()
                    .map(|info| Ok(
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            i32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                &src[info.offset.to_native() as usize..],
                                info.num.to_native() as usize,
                            )?,
                        ),
                    ))
                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()
                    .context("offs")?;
                let field = level
                    .objs()
                    .iter()
                    .find(|(_, v)| {
                        v.header().key
                            == CrcPc::from(hash_string(b"templateLevel", None))
                    })
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateLevel not found"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?
                    .1
                    .get(&hash_string(b"name", None))
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateLevel missing name field"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?;
                let name = field
                    .crc()
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                            let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                format_args!("templateObject name field is not a crc"),
                            );
                            error
                        }),
                    )?;
                let radiosity_name = hash_string(b"_radiosity", Some(name.to_native()));
                let model_data = bin.model_data();
                let ind = model_data.get_index_of(&radiosity_name);
                let data = ind
                    .map(|x| model_data.get_index(x).unwrap().1.clone())
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let usage = ind
                    .map(|x| bin.model_handles()[x].kind.to_native())
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    data,
                    infos: infos.into(),
                    offs: offs.into(),
                    usage,
                })
            }
        }

        impl TryFrom<RadiosityRawPc> for RadiosityPc {
            type Error = anyhow::Error;
            fn try_from(
                RadiosityRawPc { _ptr, data, infos, offs, usage }: RadiosityRawPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let _data = data.get()?.clone();
                if _data.len() % 4 != 0 {
                    {
                        {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!("Radiosity length is incorrect?"),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::level::radiosity",
                                        "lotrc::level::radiosity",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                let vals = NonNull::from_ref(
                    ColorPc::slice_from_data(&_data[..], _data.len() / 4)
                        .context("vals")?,
                );
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr,
                    _data,
                    infos,
                    offs,
                    vals,
                    usage,
                })
            }
        }

        pub enum RadiosityVal {
            Radiosity(Vec<Color>),
            NoRadiosity(u32),
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for RadiosityVal {
            #[inline]
            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                match self {
                    RadiosityVal::Radiosity(__self_0) => {
                        ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                            f,
                            "Radiosity",
                            &__self_0,
                        )
                    }
                    RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(__self_0) => {
                        ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                            f,
                            "NoRadiosity",
                            &__self_0,
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for RadiosityVal {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> RadiosityVal {
                match self {
                    RadiosityVal::Radiosity(__self_0) => {
                        RadiosityVal::Radiosity(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                    }
                    RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(__self_0) => {
                        RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        pub struct Radiosity {
            pub vals: IndexMap<u32, Vec<RadiosityVal>>,
            pub usage: u32,
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for Radiosity {
            #[inline]

                ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field2_finish(
                    f,

        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::default::Default for Radiosity {

                    vals: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                    usage: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                }
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for Radiosity {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> Radiosity {
                Radiosity {
                    vals: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vals),
                    usage: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.usage),
                }
            }
        }
        impl Radiosity {
            pub fn from_pc(val: &RadiosityPc, block1: &Block1Pc) -> Self {
                let objs = block1.objs();
                let gameobjs = block1
                    .sub_blocks()
                    .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                    .unwrap()
                    .level()
                    .unwrap();
                let model_inds: IndexMap<_, _> = objs
                    .models()
                    .iter()
                    .map(|model| (model.info().key, model))
                    .collect();
                let mut off: usize = 0;
                Radiosity {
                    vals: val
                        .offs
                        .iter()
                        .zip(val.infos())
                        .map(|(vals, info)| {
                            let obj = gameobjs
                                .objs()
                                .get(&info.guid.to_native())
                                .unwrap();
                            let model = Context::<
                                _,
                                anyhow::Error,
                            >::with_context(
                                {
                                    let field = obj
                                        .get(&hash_string(b"mesh", None))
                                        .ok_or(
                                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                                    format_args!("missing mesh field"),
                                                );
                                                error
                                            }),
                                        )?;
                                    let mesh = field
                                        .crc()
                                        .ok_or(
                                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                                    format_args!("mesh field not crc"),
                                                );
                                                error
                                            }),
                                        )?;
                                    Result::Ok(
                                        *model_inds
                                            .get(mesh)
                                            .ok_or_else(|| ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("model {0} missing", mesh),
                                                    )
                                                }),
                                            ))?,
                                    )
                                },
                                || ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("obj {0}", info.guid.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }),
                            )?;
                            Ok((
                                info.guid.to_native(),
                                model
                                    .data()
                                    .infos()
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|x| {
                                        (x.vbuff_size.to_native() / x.v_size.to_native()) as usize
                                    })
                                    .zip(unsafe { vals.as_ref() })
                                    .map(|(offset, size)| {
                                        if offset != off {
                                            RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(offset as u32)
                                        } else {
                                            off += size.to_native() as usize;
                                            RadiosityVal::Radiosity(
                                                val
                                                    .vals()[offset..offset + size.to_native() as usize]
                                                    .iter()
                                                    .map(|x| x.conv())
                                                    .collect(),
                                            )
                                        }
                                    })
                                    .collect(),
                            ))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()
                        .unwrap(),
                    usage: val.usage,
                }
            }
            pub fn from_xbox(val: &RadiosityXbox, block1: &Block1Xbox) -> Self {
                let objs = block1.objs();
                let gameobjs = block1
                    .sub_blocks()
                    .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                    .unwrap()
                    .level()
                    .unwrap();
                let model_inds: IndexMap<_, _> = objs
                    .models()
                    .iter()
                    .map(|model| (model.info().key, model))
                    .collect();
                let mut off: usize = 0;
                Radiosity {
                    vals: val
                        .offs
                        .iter()
                        .zip(val.infos())
                        .map(|(vals, info)| {
                            let obj = gameobjs
                                .objs()
                                .get(&info.guid.to_native())
                                .unwrap();
                            let model = Context::<
                                _,
                                anyhow::Error,
                            >::with_context(
                                {
                                    let field = obj
                                        .get(&hash_string(b"mesh", None))
                                        .ok_or(
                                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                                    format_args!("missing mesh field"),
                                                );
                                                error
                                            }),
                                        )?;
                                    let mesh = field
                                        .crc()
                                        .ok_or(
                                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                                    format_args!("mesh field not crc"),
                                                );
                                                error
                                            }),
                                        )?;
                                    Result::Ok(
                                        *model_inds
                                            .get(mesh)
                                            .ok_or_else(|| ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("model {0} missing", mesh),
                                                    )
                                                }),
                                            ))?,
                                    )
                                },
                                || ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("obj {0}", info.guid.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }),
                            )?;
                            Ok((
                                info.guid.to_native(),
                                model
                                    .data()
                                    .infos()
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|x| {
                                        (x.vbuff_size.to_native() / x.v_size.to_native()) as usize
                                    })
                                    .zip(unsafe { vals.as_ref() })
                                    .map(|(offset, size)| {
                                        if offset != off {
                                            RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(offset as u32)
                                        } else {
                                            off += size.to_native() as usize;
                                            RadiosityVal::Radiosity(
                                                val
                                                    .vals()[offset..offset + size.to_native() as usize]
                                                    .iter()
                                                    .map(|x| x.conv())
                                                    .collect(),
                                            )
                                        }
                                    })
                                    .collect(),
                            ))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()
                        .unwrap(),
                    usage: val.usage,
                }
            }
            pub fn from_ps3(val: &RadiosityPs3, block1: &Block1Ps3) -> Self {
                let objs = block1.objs();
                let gameobjs = block1
                    .sub_blocks()
                    .get(&hash_string(b"level", None))
                    .unwrap()
                    .level()
                    .unwrap();
                let model_inds: IndexMap<_, _> = objs
                    .models()
                    .iter()
                    .map(|model| (model.info().key, model))
                    .collect();
                let mut off: usize = 0;
                Radiosity {
                    vals: val
                        .offs
                        .iter()
                        .zip(val.infos())
                        .map(|(vals, info)| {
                            let obj = gameobjs
                                .objs()
                                .get(&info.guid.to_native())
                                .unwrap();
                            let model = Context::<
                                _,
                                anyhow::Error,
                            >::with_context(
                                {
                                    let field = obj
                                        .get(&hash_string(b"mesh", None))
                                        .ok_or(
                                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                                    format_args!("missing mesh field"),
                                                );
                                                error
                                            }),
                                        )?;
                                    let mesh = field
                                        .crc()
                                        .ok_or(
                                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                                    format_args!("mesh field not crc"),
                                                );
                                                error
                                            }),
                                        )?;
                                    Result::Ok(
                                        *model_inds
                                            .get(mesh)
                                            .ok_or_else(|| ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("model {0} missing", mesh),
                                                    )
                                                }),
                                            ))?,
                                    )
                                },
                                || ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("obj {0}", info.guid.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }),
                            )?;
                            Ok((
                                info.guid.to_native(),
                                model
                                    .data()
                                    .infos()
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|x| {
                                        (x.vbuff_size.to_native() / x.v_size.to_native()) as usize
                                    })
                                    .zip(unsafe { vals.as_ref() })
                                    .map(|(offset, size)| {
                                        if offset != off {
                                            RadiosityVal::NoRadiosity(offset as u32)
                                        } else {
                                            off += size.to_native() as usize;
                                            RadiosityVal::Radiosity(
                                                val
                                                    .vals()[offset..offset + size.to_native() as usize]
                                                    .iter()
                                                    .map(|x| x.conv())
                                                    .collect(),
                                            )
                                        }
                                    })
                                    .collect(),
                            ))
                        })
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()
                        .unwrap(),
                    usage: val.usage,
                }
            }
        }
    }
