        pub const fn get_stride_width(format: u32) -> Option<(usize, usize)> {
            match format {
                10 | 0xb | 0xc | 0x11 => Some((4, 16)),
                7 | 8 | 13 => Some((4, 8)),
                3 | 4 => Some((1, 4)),
                6 => Some((1, 1)),
                _ => None,
            }
        }
        pub fn conv_img_a8(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            let mut dst = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, xs * ys);
            let w = w >> 5;
            for j in 0..((h * w) >> 4) {
                let off = (j & 3) + ((j >> 1) & !3);
                let x = (off % w) << 5;
                let y = ((off / w) << 5) + ((j << 2) & 16);
                for i in 0..512 {
                    let x = x + ((((i >> 4) & 16) + (i >> 3)) & 24) + (i & 7);
                    let y = y + ((i >> 5) & 8) + ((i >> 3) & 4) + ((i >> 2) & 2)
                        + ((i >> 4) & 1);
                    if x < x_off || x >= x_off + xs || y < y_off || y >= y_off + ys {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let k = (y - y_off) * xs + (x - x_off);
                    dst[k] = data[i + (j << 9)];
                }
            }
            dst
        }
        pub fn conv_img_argb8(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            let mut dst = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, xs * ys * 4);
            let w = w >> 5;
            for j in 0..((h * w) >> 5) {
                let x = (j % w) << 5;
                let y = (j / w) << 5;
                for i in 0..1024 {
                    let x = x + ((((i >> 4) & 16) + (i >> 1)) & 24) + ((i >> 1) & 4)
                        + (i & 3);
                    let y = y + ((i >> 5) & 8) + (((i >> 5) & 16)) + ((i >> 5) & 6)
                        + ((i >> 2) & 1);
                    if x < x_off || x >= x_off + xs || y < y_off || y >= y_off + ys {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let i = (i << 2) + (j << 12);
                    let j = ((y - y_off) * xs + (x - x_off)) << 2;
                    dst[j] = data[i + 3];
                    dst[j + 1] = data[i + 2];
                    dst[j + 2] = data[i + 1];
                    dst[j + 3] = data[i];
                }
            }
            dst
        }
        pub fn conv_img_dxt1(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            let mut dst = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, xs * ys * 8);
            let w = w >> 5;
            for j in 0..((h * w) >> 5) {
                let x = (j % w) << 5;
                let y = (j / w) << 5;
                for i in 0..1024 {
                    let x = x + ((((i >> 5) & 16) + i) & 24) + ((i >> 3) & 4)
                        + ((i >> 1) & 2) + (i & 1);
                    let y = y + ((i >> 6) & 8) + (((i >> 4) & 16)) + ((i >> 5) & 6)
                        + ((i >> 1) & 1);
                    if x < x_off || x >= x_off + xs || y < y_off || y >= y_off + ys {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut i = (i << 3) + (j << 13);
                    let mut j = ((y - y_off) * xs + (x - x_off)) << 3;
                    for _ in 0..4 {
                        dst[j] = data[i + 1];
                        dst[j + 1] = data[i];
                        j += 2;
                        i += 2;
                    }
                }
            }
            dst
        }
        pub fn conv_img_dxt5(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            let mut dst = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, xs * ys * 16);
            let w = w >> 5;
            for j in 0..((h * w) >> 5) {
                let x = (j % w) << 5;
                let y = (j / w) << 5;
                for i in 0..1024 {
                    let x = x + ((((i >> 5) & 16) + (i << 1)) & 24) + ((i >> 3) & 6)
                        + ((i >> 1) & 1);
                    let y = y + ((i >> 6) & 8) + (((i >> 3) & 16)) + ((i >> 6) & 4)
                        + ((i >> 5) & 2) + (i & 1);
                    if x < x_off || x >= x_off + xs || y < y_off || y >= y_off + ys {
                        continue;
                    }
                    let mut i = (i << 4) + (j << 14);
                    let mut j = ((y - y_off) * xs + (x - x_off)) << 4;
                    for _ in 0..8 {
                        dst[j] = data[i + 1];
                        dst[j + 1] = data[i];
                        j += 2;
                        i += 2;
                    }
                }
            }
            dst
        }
        pub fn conv_img_slice(
            data: &[u8],
            h: usize,
            w: usize,
            y_off: usize,
            x_off: usize,
            ys: usize,
            xs: usize,
            d: usize,
        ) -> Vec<u8> {
            match d {
                16 => conv_img_dxt5(data, h, w, y_off, x_off, ys, xs),
                8 => conv_img_dxt1(data, h, w, y_off, x_off, ys, xs),
                4 => conv_img_argb8(data, h, w, y_off, x_off, ys, xs),
                _ => conv_img_a8(data, h, w, y_off, x_off, ys, xs),
            }
        }
        fn bin_mip(arr: &[u8], w: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
            arr.chunks(w).step_by(2).flat_map(|x| x.iter().step_by(2)).cloned().collect()
        }
        fn decomp_bc4(arr: &[u8], w: usize, h: usize) -> Vec<u8> {
            bcndecode::decode(
                    arr,
                    w,
                    h,
                    bcndecode::BcnEncoding::Bc4,
                    bcndecode::BcnDecoderFormat::LUM,
                )
                .unwrap()
        }

        impl TextureRawPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                texture_data: &IndexMap<u32, CompressedDataRef>,
                offset: usize,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let info = TextureInfoPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("info")?;
                let data0 = texture_data
                    .get(&info.asset_key.to_native())
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                let data1 = texture_data
                    .get(&hash_string(b"*", Some(info.asset_key.to_native())))
                    .cloned()
                    .unwrap_or_default();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    info: info.into(),
                    data0,
                    data1,
                })
            }
        }

        unsafe impl Sync for TexturePc {}

        impl TryFrom<TextureRawPc> for TexturePc {
            type Error = anyhow::Error;
            fn try_from(
                TextureRawPc { _ptr, info, data0, data1 }: TextureRawPc,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let _data0 = data0.get().context("data0")?.clone();
                let _data1 = data1.get().context("data1")?.clone();
                let info_ref = unsafe { info.as_ref() };
                let data = match info_ref.kind.to_native() {
                    0 | 7 | 8 => {
                        parse_texture_pc(info_ref, &_data0, &_data1)
                            .context("texture data")?
                    }
                    1 | 9 => {
                        parse_cube_pc(info_ref, &_data0, &_data1).context("cube data")?
                    }
                    _ => {
                        {
                            {
                                let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                    && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                {
                                    ::log::__private_api::log(
                                        { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                        format_args!(
                                            "Unsupported Texture Type {0} for texture {1:?}",
                                            info_ref.kind,
                                            info_ref.key,
                                        ),
                                        lvl,
                                        &(
                                            "lotrc::level::texture",
                                            "lotrc::level::texture",
                                            ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                        ),
                                        (),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        };
                        <[_]>::into_vec(
                                ::alloc::boxed::box_new([
                                    NonNull::from_ref(&_data0[..]),
                                    NonNull::from_ref(&_data1[..]),
                                ]),
                            )
                            .into()
                    }
                };
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr,
                    info,
                    _data0,
                    _data1,
                    data,
                })
            }
        }

        fn parse_texture_pc(
            info: &TextureInfoPc,
            data0: &[u8],
            data1: &[u8],
        ) -> Result<Box<[NonNull<[u8]>]>> {
            let (s, d) = match get_stride_width(info.format.to_native()) {
                Some((s, d)) => (s as usize, d as usize),
                None => {
                    {
                        {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!("Unhandled Texture Format {0}", info.format),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    return Ok(Box::new([]));
                }
            };
            let mut width = info.width.to_native() as usize;
            let mut height = info.height.to_native() as usize;
            let min_size = if false && s != 1 { 128 / s } else { 1 };
            let mut levels = Vec::with_capacity(info.levels.to_native() as usize);
            if info.levels.to_native() == 1 {
                let expected_size = (width / s).max(min_size)
                    * (height / s).max(min_size) * d;
                if data1.len() != expected_size {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                        expected_size,
                                        data1.len(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    );
                }
                levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data1[..]));
            } else {
                if !false
                    || (info.width.to_native() > 16 && info.height.to_native() > 16)
                {
                    let expected_size = (width / s).max(min_size)
                        * (height / s).max(min_size) * d;
                    if data0.len() != expected_size {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                            expected_size,
                                            data0.len(),
                                        ),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                    levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data0[..]));
                } else {
                    width = width * 2;
                    height = height * 2;
                }
                let mut offset = 0;
                for _ in 1..info.levels.to_native() {
                    width /= 2;
                    height /= 2;
                    let size = (width / s).max(min_size) * (height / s).max(min_size)
                        * d;
                    levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data1[offset..offset + size]));
                    offset += size;
                    if false && (width == 16 || height == 16) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if offset != data1.len() {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                        offset,
                                        data0.len(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    );
                }
            }
            Ok(levels.into())
        }
        fn parse_texture_xbox(
            info: &TextureInfoXbox,
            data0: &[u8],
            data1: &[u8],
        ) -> Result<Box<[NonNull<[u8]>]>> {
            let (s, d) = match get_stride_width(info.format.to_native()) {
                Some((s, d)) => (s as usize, d as usize),
                None => {
                    {
                        {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!("Unhandled Texture Format {0}", info.format),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    return Ok(Box::new([]));
                }
            };
            let mut width = info.width.to_native() as usize;
            let mut height = info.height.to_native() as usize;
            let min_size = if true && s != 1 { 128 / s } else { 1 };
            let mut levels = Vec::with_capacity(info.levels.to_native() as usize);
            if info.levels.to_native() == 1 {
                let expected_size = (width / s).max(min_size)
                    * (height / s).max(min_size) * d;
                if data1.len() != expected_size {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                        expected_size,
                                        data1.len(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    );
                }
                levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data1[..]));
            } else {
                if !true || (info.width.to_native() > 16 && info.height.to_native() > 16)
                {
                    let expected_size = (width / s).max(min_size)
                        * (height / s).max(min_size) * d;
                    if data0.len() != expected_size {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                            expected_size,
                                            data0.len(),
                                        ),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                    levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data0[..]));
                } else {
                    width = width * 2;
                    height = height * 2;
                }
                let mut offset = 0;
                for _ in 1..info.levels.to_native() {
                    width /= 2;
                    height /= 2;
                    let size = (width / s).max(min_size) * (height / s).max(min_size)
                        * d;
                    levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data1[offset..offset + size]));
                    offset += size;
                    if true && (width == 16 || height == 16) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if offset != data1.len() {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                        offset,
                                        data0.len(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    );
                }
            }
            Ok(levels.into())
        }
        fn parse_texture_ps3(
            info: &TextureInfoPs3,
            data0: &[u8],
            data1: &[u8],
        ) -> Result<Box<[NonNull<[u8]>]>> {
            let (s, d) = match get_stride_width(info.format.to_native()) {
                Some((s, d)) => (s as usize, d as usize),

                    {
                        {

                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!("Unhandled Texture Format {0}", info.format),
                                    lvl,

                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    return Ok(Box::new([]));
                }

            let mut height = info.height.to_native() as usize;

            let mut levels = Vec::with_capacity(info.levels.to_native() as usize);
            if info.levels.to_native() == 1 {
                let expected_size = (width / s).max(min_size)
                    * (height / s).max(min_size) * d;
                if data1.len() != expected_size {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(

                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                        expected_size,
                                        data1.len(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    );
                }
                levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data1[..]));
            } else {
                if !false
                    || (info.width.to_native() > 16 && info.height.to_native() > 16)
                {
                    let expected_size = (width / s).max(min_size)
                        * (height / s).max(min_size) * d;
                    if data0.len() != expected_size {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                            expected_size,
                                            data0.len(),
                                        ),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                    levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data0[..]));
                } else {
                    width = width * 2;
                    height = height * 2;
                }
                let mut offset = 0;
                for _ in 1..info.levels.to_native() {
                    width /= 2;
                    height /= 2;

                        * d;
                    levels.push(NonNull::from_ref(&data1[offset..offset + size]));
                    offset += size;
                    if false && (width == 16 || height == 16) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if offset != data1.len() {
                    return Err(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!(
                                        "expected texture data to be of size {0} but got {1}",
                                        offset,
                                        data0.len(),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    );
                }
            }
            Ok(levels.into())
        }
        fn parse_cube_pc(
            info: &TextureInfoPc,
            data0: &[u8],
            data1: &[u8],
        ) -> Result<Box<[NonNull<[u8]>]>> {
            if info.levels.to_native() > 1 {
                return Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("Cube Textures with > 1 level are unhanded"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                );
            }
            let (s, d) = match get_stride_width(info.format.to_native()) {
                Some((s, d)) => (s as usize, d as usize),
                None => {
                    {
                        {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!(
                                        "Unhandled Cube Texture Format {0}",
                                        info.format,
                                    ),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    };
                    return Ok(Box::new([]));
                }
            };
            let min_size = if false { 128 / s } else { 1 };
            let mut faces = Vec::with_capacity(6);
            if data0.len() != 0 {
                return Err(
                    ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                        ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!(
                                    "Cube Texture exepects first data to be empty but got {0} bytes",
                                    data0.len(),
                                ),
                            )
                        }),
                    ),
                );
            }
            let data_size = (info.width.to_native() as usize / s).max(min_size)
                * (info.height.to_native() as usize / s).max(min_size) * d;
            for i in 0..6 {
                faces
                    .push(
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            &data1[data_size * i..data_size * i + data_size],
                        ),
                    );
            }
            Ok(faces.into())
        }
        fn parse_cube_xbox(

        impl TexturePc {
            pub fn info(&self) -> &TextureInfoPc {
                unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn data(&self) -> Vec<&[u8]> {
                self.data.iter().map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() }).collect()
            }
        }
        impl TextureXbox {
            pub fn info(&self) -> &TextureInfoXbox {
                unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn data(&self) -> Vec<&[u8]> {
                self.data.iter().map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() }).collect()
            }
        }
        impl TexturePs3 {
            pub fn info(&self) -> &TextureInfoPs3 {
                unsafe { self.info.as_ref() }
            }
            pub fn data(&self) -> Vec<&[u8]> {
                self.data.iter().map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() }).collect()
            }
        }
        pub struct Texture {
            pub info: TextureInfo,
            pub data: Vec<Vec<u8>>,
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for Texture {
            #[inline]
            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field2_finish(
                    f,
                    "Texture",
                    "info",
                    &self.info,
                    "data",
                    &&self.data,
                )
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for Texture {
            #[inline]
            fn clone(&self) -> Texture {
                Texture {
                    info: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.info),
                    data: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.data),
                }
            }
        }
        impl Texture {
            pub fn dump(&self) -> (Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>) {
                match self.info.kind {
                    0 | 7 | 8 => {
                        if self.data.len() == 1 {
                            (::alloc::vec::Vec::new(), self.data[0].clone())
                        } else {
                            (
                                self.data[0].clone(),
                                self.data[1..].iter().flatten().copied().collect(),
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    1 | 9 => {
                        (
                            ::alloc::vec::Vec::new(),
                            self.data.iter().flatten().copied().collect(),
                        )
                    }
                    _ => (self.data[0].clone(), self.data[1].clone()),
                }
            }
        }
        impl Texture {
            pub fn from_pc(val: &TexturePc, info: &TextureInfoPc) -> Self {
                let mut info: TextureInfo = info.conv();
                let mut data = val
                    .data
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() }.iter().cloned().collect())
                    .collect();
                if false {
                    let (s, d) = match get_stride_width(info.format) {
                        Some((s, d)) => (s as usize, d as usize),
                        None => {
                            {
                                {
                                    let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                    if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                        && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                    {
                                        ::log::__private_api::log(
                                            { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                            format_args!(
                                                "Unhandled Texture Format {0} for texture {1:?}",
                                                info.format,
                                                info.key,
                                            ),
                                            lvl,
                                            &(
                                                "lotrc::level::texture",
                                                "lotrc::level::texture",
                                                ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                            ),
                                            (),
                                        );
                                    }
                                }
                            };
                            return Texture { info, data };
                        }
                    };
                    let min_size = if s != 1 { 128 / s } else { 1 };
                    let mut width = info.width as usize;
                    let mut height = info.height as usize;
                    match info.kind {
                        0 | 7 | 8 => {
                            if info.levels == 1 {
                                data.push(
                                    conv_img_slice(
                                        unsafe { val.data[0].as_ref() },
                                        (height / s).max(min_size),
                                        (width / s).max(min_size),
                                        0,
                                        0,
                                        (height / s).max(1),
                                        (width / s).max(1),
                                        d,
                                    ),
                                );
                                return Texture { info, data };
                            }
                            let wide_img = info.width > info.height;
                            let mut level = 0;
                            for vals in &val.data[..val.data.len() - 1] {
                                data.push(
                                    conv_img_slice(
                                        unsafe { vals.as_ref() },
                                        (height / s).max(min_size),
                                        (width / s).max(min_size),
                                        0,
                                        0,
                                        (height / s).max(1),
                                        (width / s).max(1),
                                        d,
                                    ),
                                );
                                width /= 2;
                                height /= 2;
                                level += 1;
                            }
                            let packed_data: &[u8] = unsafe {
                                val.data.last().unwrap().as_ref()
                            };
                            while height >= 4 && width >= 4 && level < info.levels {
                                data.push(
                                    if wide_img {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            packed_data,
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            height / s,
                                            0,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    } else {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            packed_data,
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            0,
                                            width / s,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    },
                                );
                                width /= 2;
                                height /= 2;
                                level += 1;
                            }
                            for _ in level..info.levels {
                                data.push(
                                    if wide_img {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            packed_data,
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            0,
                                            width.max(1),
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    } else {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            packed_data,
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            height.max(1),
                                            0,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    },
                                );
                                width /= 2;
                                height /= 2;
                            }
                            if info.format == 13 {
                                info.format = 6;
                                width = info.width as usize;
                                height = info.height as usize;
                                data = data
                                    .into_iter()
                                    .enumerate()
                                    .map(|(i, x)| decomp_bc4(
                                        &x,
                                        (width >> i).max(4),
                                        (height >> i).max(4),
                                    ))
                                    .collect();
                                if info.levels != 1 {
                                    data[info.levels as usize - 2] = bin_mip(
                                        &data[info.levels as usize - 3][..],
                                        width >> (info.levels as usize - 3),
                                    );
                                    data[info.levels as usize - 1] = bin_mip(
                                        &data[info.levels as usize - 2][..],
                                        width >> (info.levels as usize - 2),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        1 | 9 => {
                            data.extend(
                                val
                                    .data
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|x| {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            unsafe { x.as_ref() },
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            0,
                                            0,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    }),
                            );
                        }
                        _ => {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!(
                                        "Unsupported Texture Type {0} for texture {1:?}",
                                        info.kind,
                                        info.key,
                                    ),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Texture { info, data }
            }
            pub fn from_xbox(val: &TextureXbox, info: &TextureInfoXbox) -> Self {
                let mut info: TextureInfo = info.conv();
                let mut data = val
                    .data

                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    },
                                );
                                width /= 2;
                                height /= 2;
                                level += 1;
                            }
                            for _ in level..info.levels {

                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            0,
                                            0,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),

                                            height / s,
                                            0,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    } else {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            packed_data,
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            0,
                                            width / s,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    },
                                );
                                width /= 2;
                                height /= 2;
                                level += 1;
                            }
                            for _ in level..info.levels {
                                data.push(
                                    if wide_img {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            packed_data,
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            0,
                                            width.max(1),
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    } else {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            packed_data,
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            height.max(1),
                                            0,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    },
                                );
                                width /= 2;
                                height /= 2;
                            }
                            if info.format == 13 {
                                info.format = 6;
                                width = info.width as usize;
                                height = info.height as usize;
                                data = data
                                    .into_iter()
                                    .enumerate()
                                    .map(|(i, x)| decomp_bc4(
                                        &x,
                                        (width >> i).max(4),
                                        (height >> i).max(4),
                                    ))
                                    .collect();
                                if info.levels != 1 {
                                    data[info.levels as usize - 2] = bin_mip(
                                        &data[info.levels as usize - 3][..],
                                        width >> (info.levels as usize - 3),
                                    );
                                    data[info.levels as usize - 1] = bin_mip(
                                        &data[info.levels as usize - 2][..],
                                        width >> (info.levels as usize - 2),
                                    );
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        1 | 9 => {
                            data.extend(
                                val
                                    .data
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|x| {
                                        conv_img_slice(
                                            unsafe { x.as_ref() },
                                            (height / s).max(min_size),
                                            (width / s).max(min_size),
                                            0,
                                            0,
                                            (height / s).max(1),
                                            (width / s).max(1),
                                            d,
                                        )
                                    }),
                            );
                        }
                        _ => {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!(
                                        "Unsupported Texture Type {0} for texture {1:?}",
                                        info.kind,
                                        info.key,
                                    ),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        "lotrc::level::texture",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                Texture { info, data }
            }
        }
    }

    pub enum LevelRef {
        PC(LevelPc),
        XBOX(LevelXbox),
        PS3(LevelPs3),
    }
    impl LevelRef {
        pub fn from_data<P: AsRef<Path>>(path: P) -> Result<LevelRef> {
            let t = std::time::Instant::now();
            let path = path.as_ref();
            let pak_data = std::fs::read(path.with_extension("PAK"))
                .context("pak_data")?;
            let bin_data = std::fs::read(path.with_extension("BIN"))
                .context("bin_data")?;
            {
                ::std::io::_print(
                    format_args!("Files read in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                );
            };
            if bin_data[0] == 6 {
                Ok(
                    Self::PC(
                        LevelPc::from_bytes(pak_data, bin_data).context("level_pc")?,
                    ),
                )
            } else if bin_data[3] == 6 && bin_data[7] == 2 {
                Ok(
                    Self::XBOX(
                        LevelXbox::from_bytes(pak_data, bin_data).context("level_xbox")?,
                    ),
                )
            } else if bin_data[3] == 6 && bin_data[7] == 3 {
                Ok(
                    Self::PS3(
                        LevelPs3::from_bytes(pak_data, bin_data).context("level_ps3")?,
                    ),
                )
            } else {
                Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("unknown level version"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )
            }
        }
    }
    impl LevelPc {
        pub fn new(
            pak_data: impl Into<Arc<[u8]>>,
            bin_data: impl Into<Arc<[u8]>>,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            Ok(Self {
                pak: PakPc::from_bytes(pak_data.into()).context("pak")?,
                bin: BinPc::from_bytes(bin_data.into()).context("bin")?,
            })
        }
        pub fn from_bytes(
            pak_data: impl Into<Arc<[u8]>>,
            bin_data: impl Into<Arc<[u8]>>,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            let t = std::time::Instant::now();
            let mut bin = BinPc::from_bytes(bin_data.into()).context("pak")?;
            bin.parse().context("parse bin")?;
            {
                ::std::io::_print(
                    format_args!("Bin parsed in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                );
            };
            let t = std::time::Instant::now();
            let mut pak = PakPc::from_bytes(pak_data.into()).context("pak")?;
            pak.parse(&bin).context("parse pak")?;
            {
                ::std::io::_print(
                    format_args!("Pak parsed in {0}\n", t.elapsed().as_secs_f32()),
                );
            };
            Ok(Self { pak, bin })
        }
        pub fn pak(&self) -> &pak::PakPc {
            &self.pak
        }
        pub fn bin(&self) -> &bin::BinPc {
            &self.bin
        }
    }

                &self.obj0s,

    fn level_parse_pc(level: &LevelPc) -> Result<Level> {
        let block1 = level.pak().block1().unwrap();
        let block2 = level.pak().block2().unwrap();
        let objs = block1.objs();
        let mut foliages: IndexMap<Crc, Vec<_>> = IndexMap::with_capacity(
            level.pak().header().foliage_info_num.to_native() as usize,
        );
        for foliage in objs.foliages() {
            foliages.entry(foliage.info().key.conv()).or_default().push(foliage.into());
        }
        Ok(Level {
            bin_header: level.bin().header().conv(),
            bin_strings: level.bin().strings().into(),
            pak_header: level.pak().header().conv(),
            pak_strings: level.pak().strings().into(),
            sub_blocks1: sub_blocks::SubBlocks::from_pc(
                block1.sub_blocks(),
                objs.pfield_infos(),
            ),
            string_keys: block1.string_keys().into(),
            sub_blocks2: sub_blocks::SubBlocks::from_pc(
                block2.sub_blocks(),
                objs.pfield_infos(),
            ),
            block2_offsets: block2.offsets().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            objas: objs.objas().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            obj0s: objs.obj0s().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            gfx_blocks: objs
                .gfx_block_infos()
                .iter()
                .zip(block1.objs().gfx_blocks())
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.key.conv(), v.to_vec()))
                .collect(),
            effects: objs
                .effect_infos()
                .iter()
                .zip(objs.effects())
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.key.conv(), v.into()))
                .collect(),
            models: objs
                .models()
                .iter()
                .map(|model| {
                    (
                        model.info().key.conv(),
                        model::Model::from_pc(model, level.pak().header(), objs),
                    )
                })
                .collect(),
            textures: IndexMap::new(),
            animations: level.pak().animation_blocks().unwrap().into(),
            foliages,
            radiosity: None,
            pak_vals_a: level.pak().vals_a().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
        })
    }
    fn level_parse_xbox(level: &LevelXbox) -> Result<Level> {
        let block1 = level.pak().block1().unwrap();
        let block2 = level.pak().block2().unwrap();
        let objs = block1.objs();
        let mut foliages: IndexMap<Crc, Vec<_>> = IndexMap::with_capacity(
            level.pak().header().foliage_info_num.to_native() as usize,
        );
        for foliage in objs.foliages() {
            foliages.entry(foliage.info().key.conv()).or_default().push(foliage.into());
        }
        Ok(Level {
            bin_header: level.bin().header().conv(),
            bin_strings: level.bin().strings().into(),
            pak_header: level.pak().header().conv(),
            pak_strings: level.pak().strings().into(),
            sub_blocks1: sub_blocks::SubBlocks::from_xbox(
                block1.sub_blocks(),
                objs.pfield_infos(),
            ),
            string_keys: block1.string_keys().into(),
            sub_blocks2: sub_blocks::SubBlocks::from_xbox(
                block2.sub_blocks(),
                objs.pfield_infos(),
            ),
            block2_offsets: block2.offsets().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            objas: objs.objas().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            obj0s: objs.obj0s().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            gfx_blocks: objs
                .gfx_block_infos()
                .iter()
                .zip(block1.objs().gfx_blocks())
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.key.conv(), v.to_vec()))
                .collect(),
            effects: objs
                .effect_infos()
                .iter()
                .zip(objs.effects())
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.key.conv(), v.into()))
                .collect(),
            models: objs
                .models()
                .iter()
                .map(|model| {
                    (
                        model.info().key.conv(),
                        model::Model::from_xbox(model, level.pak().header(), objs),
                    )
                })
                .collect(),
            textures: IndexMap::new(),
            animations: level.pak().animation_blocks().unwrap().into(),
            foliages,
            radiosity: None,
            pak_vals_a: level.pak().vals_a().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
        })
    }
    fn level_parse_ps3(level: &LevelPs3) -> Result<Level> {
        let block1 = level.pak().block1().unwrap();
        let block2 = level.pak().block2().unwrap();
        let objs = block1.objs();
        let mut foliages: IndexMap<Crc, Vec<_>> = IndexMap::with_capacity(
            level.pak().header().foliage_info_num.to_native() as usize,
        );
        for foliage in objs.foliages() {
            foliages.entry(foliage.info().key.conv()).or_default().push(foliage.into());
        }
        Ok(Level {
            bin_header: level.bin().header().conv(),
            bin_strings: level.bin().strings().into(),
            pak_header: level.pak().header().conv(),
            pak_strings: level.pak().strings().into(),
            sub_blocks1: sub_blocks::SubBlocks::from_ps3(
                block1.sub_blocks(),
                objs.pfield_infos(),
            ),
            string_keys: block1.string_keys().into(),
            sub_blocks2: sub_blocks::SubBlocks::from_ps3(
                block2.sub_blocks(),
                objs.pfield_infos(),
            ),
            block2_offsets: block2.offsets().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            objas: objs.objas().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            obj0s: objs.obj0s().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
            gfx_blocks: objs
                .gfx_block_infos()
                .iter()
                .zip(block1.objs().gfx_blocks())
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.key.conv(), v.to_vec()))
                .collect(),
            effects: objs
                .effect_infos()
                .iter()
                .zip(objs.effects())
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.key.conv(), v.into()))
                .collect(),
            models: objs
                .models()
                .iter()
                .map(|model| {
                    (
                        model.info().key.conv(),
                        model::Model::from_ps3(model, level.pak().header(), objs),
                    )
                })
                .collect(),
            textures: IndexMap::new(),
            animations: level.pak().animation_blocks().unwrap().into(),
            foliages,
            radiosity: None,
            pak_vals_a: level.pak().vals_a().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
        })
    }
    fn level_dump_pc(_level: &Level, _level_raw: &LevelPc) -> (Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>) {
        let pak_data = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
        let bin_data = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
        (pak_data, bin_data)
    }
    fn level_dump_xbox(_level: &Level, _level_raw: &LevelXbox) -> (Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>) {
        let pak_data = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
        let bin_data = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
        (pak_data, bin_data)
    }
    fn level_dump_ps3(_level: &Level, _level_raw: &LevelPs3) -> (Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>) {
        let pak_data = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
        let bin_data = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
        (pak_data, bin_data)
    }
    impl Level {
        pub fn parse(level: &LevelRef) -> Result<Self> {
            match level {
                LevelRef::PC(val) => level_parse_pc(val),
                LevelRef::XBOX(val) => level_parse_xbox(val),
                LevelRef::PS3(val) => level_parse_ps3(val),
            }
        }
        pub fn dump(&self, level: &LevelRef) -> (Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>) {
            match level {
                LevelRef::PC(val) => level_dump_pc(self, val),
                LevelRef::XBOX(val) => level_dump_xbox(self, val),
                LevelRef::PS3(val) => level_dump_ps3(self, val),
            }
        }
        pub fn dump_pc(&self) -> (Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>) {
            let bin_data = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            let mut texture_data = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            let mut seen_textures = HashSet::new();
            fn sort_texture(tex: &&texture::Texture) -> u32 {
                let k = tex.info.key.val;
                if k == 3804089404 { 0 } else if k == 4026460901 { 1 } else { k }
            }
            let _texture_infos = self
                .textures
                .values()
                .sorted_by_key(sort_texture)
                .map(|tex| {
                    let (data0, data1) = tex.dump();
                    if !seen_textures.contains(&tex.info.asset_key.val) {
                        let key_alt: Crc = hash_string(
                                "*".as_bytes(),
                                Some(tex.info.asset_key.val),
                            )
                            .into();
                        if data1.len() == 0 {
                            texture_data.push(((key_alt, tex.info.asset_type), data1));
                            texture_data
                                .push((
                                    (tex.info.asset_key.clone(), tex.info.asset_type),
                                    data0,
                                ));
                        } else {
                            texture_data
                                .push((
                                    (tex.info.asset_key.clone(), tex.info.asset_type),
                                    data0,
                                ));
                            texture_data.push(((key_alt, tex.info.asset_type), data1));
                        }
                        seen_textures.insert(tex.info.asset_key.val);
                    }
                    tex.info.clone()
                })
                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            let mut pak_header = self.pak_header.clone();
            let pak_data = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, PakHeaderPc::size_of());
            let pfield_infos = if let Some(sub_blocks::SubBlock::PFields(val)) = self
                .sub_blocks2
                .blocks
                .get(&Crc::from(sub_blocks::keys::KEY_PFIELDS))
            {
                val.infos_pc()
            } else {
                ::alloc::vec::Vec::new()
            };
            pak_header.radiosity_vals_info_num = self
                .radiosity
                .as_ref()
                .map(|x| x.vals.len() as u32)
                .unwrap_or(0);
            pak_header.foliage_info_num = self
                .foliages
                .iter()
                .map(|(_, x)| x.len())
                .sum::<usize>() as u32;
            pak_header.animation_info_num = self.animations.animations.len() as u32;
            pak_header.pfield_info_num = pfield_infos.len() as u32;
            let mut block1: Vec<u8> = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            pak_header.obja_offset = block1.len() as u32;
            block1
                .extend(
                    ::alloc::vec::from_elem(
                        0u8,
                        pak_header.obja_num as usize
                            * std::mem::size_of::<pak::objs::ObjAPc>(),
                    ),
                );
            block1
                .extend(
                    ::alloc::vec::from_elem(
                        0u8,
                        ((block1.len() + 15) & 0xFFFFFFF0) - block1.len(),
                    ),
                );
            pak_header.obj0_offset = block1.len() as u32;
            block1
                .extend(
                    ::alloc::vec::from_elem(
                        0u8,
                        pak_header.obj0_num as usize
                            * std::mem::size_of::<pak::objs::Obj0Pc>(),
                    ),
                );
            block1
                .extend(
                    ::alloc::vec::from_elem(
                        0u8,
                        ((block1.len() + 15) & 0xFFFFFFF0) - block1.len(),
                    ),
                );
            pak_header.model_info_offset = block1.len() as u32;
            block1
                .extend(
                    ::alloc::vec::from_elem(
                        0u8,
                        pak_header.model_info_num as usize
                            * std::mem::size_of::<model::ModelInfoPc>(),
                    ),
                );
            block1
                .extend(
                    ::alloc::vec::from_elem(
                        0u8,
                        ((block1.len() + 15) & 0xFFFFFFF0) - block1.len(),
                    ),
                );
            pak_header.buffer_info_offset = block1.len() as u32;
            block1
                .extend(
                    ::alloc::vec::from_elem(
                        0u8,
                        pak_header.buffer_info_num as usize
                            * std::mem::size_of::<model::data::BufferInfoPc>(),
                    ),
                );
            block1

    use lotrc_proc::{make_platforms, OrderedData};
    use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
    use std::ptr::NonNull;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    pub mod gameobjs {
        use crate::types::{
            align_offset, get_str_debug, hash_string, Crc, DumpData, DumpSlice,
            Matrix4x4, RefFromData, Vector2, Vector3, Vector4, Weight, OrderedData,
            OrderedDataStrict,
        };
        use crate::types::{
            CrcPc, Matrix4x4Pc, Vector2Pc, Vector3Pc, Vector4Pc, WeightPc, f32Pc, i32Pc,
            u32Pc,
        };
        use crate::types::{
            CrcXbox, Matrix4x4Xbox, Vector2Xbox, Vector3Xbox, Vector4Xbox, WeightXbox,
            f32Xbox, i32Xbox, u32Xbox,
        };
        use crate::types::{
            CrcPs3, Matrix4x4Ps3, Vector2Ps3, Vector3Ps3, Vector4Ps3, WeightPs3, f32Ps3,
            i32Ps3, u32Ps3,
        };
        use anyhow::{anyhow, Context, Result};
        use indexmap::IndexMap;
        use lotrc_proc::{make_platforms, OrderedData};
        use std::ptr::NonNull;
        use std::sync::Arc;
        struct List {
            num: u16,
            offset: u16,
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::fmt::Debug for List {
            #[inline]
            fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
                ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field2_finish(
                    f,
                    "List",
                    "num",
                    &self.num,
                    "offset",
                    &&self.offset,
                )
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::default::Default for List {
            #[inline]
            fn default() -> List {
                List {
                    num: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                    offset: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                }
            }
        }
        #[automatically_derived]
        impl ::core::clone::Clone for List {
            #[inline]

                        BaseTypeRefPs3::MatrixList(::core::clone::Clone::clone(__self_0))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        impl BaseTypePc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                data: &Arc<[u8]>,
                offset: usize,
                kind: u32,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                Ok(
                    match kind {
                        keys::CRC_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Crc(
                                CrcPc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::GUID_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::GUID(
                                u32Pc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::COLOR_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Color(
                                u32Pc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR2_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Vector2(
                                Vector2Pc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR3_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Vector3(
                                Vector3Pc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::VECTOR4_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Vector4(
                                Vector4Pc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Matrix4x4(
                                Matrix4x4Pc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?
                                    .into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::FLOAT_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Float(
                                f32Pc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::INT_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Int(
                                i32Pc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::BOOL_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::Bool(
                                u32Pc::from_data(&data[offset..]).context("val")?.into(),
                            )
                        }
                        keys::STRING_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::String({
                                let val = ListPc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                let off = val.offset.to_native() as usize + val.size();
                                core::str::from_utf8(
                                        &data[offset
                                            + off..offset + off + val.num.to_native() as usize],
                                    )?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::StringList({
                                let val = ListPc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                let vals = ListPc::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("list info")?;
                                vals.iter()
                                    .enumerate()
                                    .map(|(i, v)| {
                                        Ok({
                                            let off = (val.offset.to_native() + v.offset.to_native())
                                                as usize + val.size() * (i + 2);
                                            let s_data = &data[offset
                                                + off..offset + off + v.num.to_native() as usize];
                                            let s = std::str::from_utf8(s_data)
                                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("string {0}, {1:?}", i, s_data),
                                                    )
                                                }))?;
                                            NonNull::from_ref(s)
                                        })
                                    })
                                    .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::ObjectList({
                                let val = ListPc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::NODELIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::NodeList({
                                let val = ListPc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                Vector4Pc::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::INTLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::IntList({
                                let val = ListPc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                i32Pc::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::CRCLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::CrcList({
                                let val = ListPc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                CrcPc::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::WeightList({
                                let val = ListPc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                WeightPc::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePc::MatrixList({
                                let val = ListPc::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                Matrix4x4Pc::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        _ => {
                            return Err(
                                ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                        )
                                    }),
                                ),
                            );
                        }
                    },
                )
            }
            pub unsafe fn as_ref(&self) -> BaseTypeRefPc<'_> {
                match self {
                    BaseTypePc::Crc(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Crc(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::GUID(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::GUID(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Color(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Color(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Vector2(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Vector2(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Vector3(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Vector3(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Vector4(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Vector4(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Matrix4x4(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Matrix4x4(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Float(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Float(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Int(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Int(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::Bool(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::Bool(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::String(val) => BaseTypeRefPc::String(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::StringList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPc::StringList(
                            vals.iter().map(|x| x.as_ref()).collect(),
                        )
                    }
                    BaseTypePc::ObjectList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPc::ObjectList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypePc::NodeList(vals) => BaseTypeRefPc::NodeList(vals.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::IntList(vals) => BaseTypeRefPc::IntList(vals.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::CrcList(vals) => BaseTypeRefPc::CrcList(vals.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePc::WeightList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPc::WeightList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                    BaseTypePc::MatrixList(vals) => {
                        BaseTypeRefPc::MatrixList(vals.as_ref())
                    }
                }
            }
            pub fn size(kind: u32) -> usize {
                match kind {
                    keys::CRC_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::GUID_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::COLOR_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR2_KEY => Vector2Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR3_KEY => Vector3Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::VECTOR4_KEY => Vector4Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => Matrix4x4Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::FLOAT_KEY => f32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::INT_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::BOOL_KEY => u32Pc::size_of(),
                    keys::STRING_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::NODELIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::INTLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::CRCLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => ListPc::size_of(),
                    _ => 0,
                }
            }
