                                CrcPs3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::WeightList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                WeightPs3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                            BaseTypePs3::MatrixList({
                                let val = ListPs3::from_data(&data[offset..])
                                    .context("val")?;
                                Matrix4x4Ps3::slice_from_data(
                                        &data[offset + val.offset.to_native() as usize
                                            + val.size()..],
                                        val.num.to_native() as usize,
                                    )
                                    .context("vals")?
                                    .into()
                            })
                        }
                        _ => {
                            return Err(
                                ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                        )
                                    }),
                                ),
                            );
                        }
                    },
                )
            }

                match self {
                    BaseTypePs3::Crc(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Crc(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::GUID(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::GUID(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Color(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Color(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Vector2(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Vector2(val.as_ref()),
                    BaseTypePs3::Vector3(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Vector3(val.as_ref()),

                    BaseTypePs3::Bool(val) => BaseTypeRefPs3::Bool(val.as_ref()),

            NodeList(Vec<Vector4>),
            IntList(Vec<i32>),

            MatrixList(Vec<Matrix4x4>),

        impl From<BaseTypeRefPc<'_>> for BaseType {
            fn from(val: BaseTypeRefPc) -> Self {
                match val {
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Crc(val) => Self::Crc(val.conv()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::GUID(val) => Self::GUID(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Color(val) => Self::Color(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Vector2(val) => Self::Vector2(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Vector3(val) => Self::Vector3(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Vector4(val) => Self::Vector4(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Matrix4x4(val) => Self::Matrix4x4(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Float(val) => Self::Float(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Int(val) => Self::Int(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::Bool(val) => Self::Bool(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::String(val) => Self::String(val.to_string()),
                    BaseTypeRefPc::StringList(vals) => {
                        Self::StringList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.to_string()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::ObjectList(vals) => {
                        Self::ObjectList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.to_native()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::NodeList(vals) => {
                        Self::NodeList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::IntList(vals) => {
                        Self::IntList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.to_native()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::CrcList(vals) => {
                        Self::CrcList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::WeightList(vals) => {
                        Self::WeightList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefPc::MatrixList(vals) => {
                        Self::MatrixList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect())
                    }
                }
            }

        impl From<BaseTypeRefXbox<'_>> for BaseType {
            fn from(val: BaseTypeRefXbox) -> Self {
                match val {
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Crc(val) => Self::Crc(val.conv()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::GUID(val) => Self::GUID(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Color(val) => Self::Color(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Vector2(val) => Self::Vector2(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Vector3(val) => Self::Vector3(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Vector4(val) => Self::Vector4(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Matrix4x4(val) => Self::Matrix4x4(val.get()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Float(val) => Self::Float(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Int(val) => Self::Int(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::Bool(val) => Self::Bool(val.to_native()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::String(val) => Self::String(val.to_string()),
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::StringList(vals) => {
                        Self::StringList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.to_string()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::ObjectList(vals) => {
                        Self::ObjectList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.to_native()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::NodeList(vals) => {
                        Self::NodeList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::IntList(vals) => {
                        Self::IntList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.to_native()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::CrcList(vals) => {
                        Self::CrcList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::WeightList(vals) => {
                        Self::WeightList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect())
                    }
                    BaseTypeRefXbox::MatrixList(vals) => {
                        Self::MatrixList(vals.iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect())
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        pub enum BaseTypeDumpPc<'a> {
            Crc(&'a mut CrcPc),
            GUID(&'a mut u32Pc),
            Color(&'a mut u32Pc),
            Vector2(&'a mut Vector2Pc),
            Vector3(&'a mut Vector3Pc),
            Vector4(&'a mut Vector4Pc),
            Matrix4x4(&'a mut Matrix4x4Pc),
            Float(&'a mut f32Pc),
            Int(&'a mut i32Pc),
            Bool(&'a mut u32Pc),
            String(&'a mut [u8]),
            StringList(Vec<&'a mut [u8]>),
            ObjectList(&'a mut [u32Pc]),
            NodeList(&'a mut [Vector4Pc]),
            IntList(&'a mut [i32Pc]),
            CrcList(&'a mut [CrcPc]),
            WeightList(&'a mut [WeightPc]),
            MatrixList(&'a mut [Matrix4x4Pc]),
        }
        pub enum BaseTypeDumpXbox<'a> {

        pub trait DumpBaseTypePc {
            fn off_size(&self) -> usize;
            fn list_len(&self) -> usize;
            fn string_lens(&self) -> Option<impl Iterator<Item = usize>>;
            fn write_into(&self, other: BaseTypeDumpPc) -> Result<()>;
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                obj_dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                val_dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                kind: u32,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let val = match kind {
                    keys::CRC_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Crc(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::GUID_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::GUID(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::COLOR_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Color(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR2_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector2(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR3_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector3(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::VECTOR4_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Vector4(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::MATRIX4X4_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Matrix4x4(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::FLOAT_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Float(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::INT_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Int(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::BOOL_KEY => {
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::Bool(
                            RefFromData::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("val")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::STRING_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let vals = u8::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("vals")?;
                        if vals.len() != 0 {
                            val_dst.split(1);
                        }
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::String(vals)
                    }
                    keys::STRINGLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let mut offset = val_dst.offset;
                        let vals = ListPc::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("sub lists")?;
                        let mut valss = Vec::with_capacity(vals.len());
                        for (i, (len, val)) in self
                            .string_lens()
                            .unwrap()
                            .zip(vals)
                            .enumerate()
                        {
                            offset += ListPc::size_of();
                            val.offset = (val_dst.offset - offset).conv();
                            val.num = len.conv();
                            let s = u8::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, len)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("val {0}", i))
                                }))?;
                            if s.len() != 0 {
                                val_dst.split(1);
                            }
                            valss.push(s);
                        }
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::StringList(valss)
                    }
                    keys::OBJECTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::ObjectList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::NODELIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::NodeList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::INTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        let vals = i32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                            .context("vals")?;
                        val_dst.align(16);
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::IntList(vals)
                    }
                    keys::CRCLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::CrcList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::WeightList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPc::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPc::MatrixList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    _ => {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                };
                self.write_into(val)
            }
        }

                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::WEIGHTLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::WeightList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    keys::MATRIXLIST_KEY => {
                        let val = ListPs3::mut_from_data(obj_dst).context("list")?;
                        val.offset = (val_dst.offset - obj_dst.offset).conv();
                        val.num = self.list_len().conv();
                        BaseTypeDumpPs3::MatrixList(
                            RefFromData::mut_slice_from_data(val_dst, self.list_len())
                                .context("vals")?,
                        )
                    }
                    _ => {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("Unkown Type {0:?}", kind),
                                    )
                                }),
                            ),
                        );
                    }
                };
                self.write_into(val)
            }
        }

                    Self::NodeList(vals) => vals.size(),

                        if vals.len() != 0 { vals.len() + 1 } else { 0 }
                    }
                    BaseType::StringList(vals) => {
                        let mut s = vals.len() * ListPs3::size_of();
                        for v in vals {
                            if v.len() != 0 {
                                s += v.len() + 1;
                            }
                        }
                        s
                    }
                    BaseType::ObjectList(vals) => vals.len() * u32Ps3::size_of(),
                    BaseType::NodeList(vals) => vals.len() * Vector4Ps3::size_of(),
                    BaseType::IntList(vals) => vals.len() * i32Ps3::size_of(),
                    BaseType::CrcList(vals) => vals.len() * CrcPs3::size_of(),
                    BaseType::WeightList(vals) => vals.len() * WeightPs3::size_of(),
                    BaseType::MatrixList(vals) => vals.len() * Matrix4x4Ps3::size_of(),
                    _ => 0,
                }
            }
            fn write_into(&self, other: BaseTypeDumpPs3) -> Result<()> {
                match (self, other) {
                    (BaseType::Crc(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Crc(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::GUID(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::GUID(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Color(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Color(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Vector2(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Vector2(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Vector3(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Vector3(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Vector4(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Vector4(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Matrix4x4(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Matrix4x4(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Float(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Float(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Int(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Int(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::Bool(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::Bool(other)) => {
                        *other = val.conv();
                    }
                    (BaseType::String(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::String(other)) => {
                        other.write_from(val.as_bytes())?
                    }
                    (BaseType::StringList(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::StringList(other)) => {
                        for (val, other) in val.iter().zip(other) {
                            other.write_from(val.as_bytes())?;
                        }
                    }
                    (BaseType::ObjectList(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::ObjectList(other)) => {
                        for (val, other) in val.iter().zip(other) {
                            *other = val.conv();
                        }
                    }
                    (BaseType::NodeList(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::NodeList(other)) => {
                        for (val, other) in val.iter().zip(other) {
                            *other = val.conv();
                        }
                    }
                    (BaseType::IntList(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::IntList(other)) => {
                        for (val, other) in val.iter().zip(other) {
                            *other = val.conv();
                        }
                    }
                    (BaseType::CrcList(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::CrcList(other)) => {
                        for (val, other) in val.iter().zip(other) {
                            *other = val.conv();
                        }
                    }
                    (BaseType::WeightList(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::WeightList(other)) => {
                        for (val, other) in val.iter().zip(other) {
                            *other = val.conv();
                        }
                    }
                    (BaseType::MatrixList(val), BaseTypeDumpPs3::MatrixList(other)) => {
                        for (val, other) in val.iter().zip(other) {
                            *other = val.conv();
                        }
                    }
                    _ => {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("missmatched BaseTypeRef and BaseTypeDump"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                }
                Ok(())
            }
        }

        impl TypePc {
            pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, mut offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
                let start = offset;
                let header = TypeHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
                offset += header.size();
                let fields = TypeFieldPc::slice_from_data(
                        &src[offset..],
                        header.size.to_native() as usize,
                    )
                    .context("fields")?;
                offset += fields.size();
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    header: header.into(),
                    fields: fields.into(),
                    size: offset - start,
                })
            }
        }

        pub trait DumpTypePc {
            fn key(&self) -> u32;
            fn fields_len(&self) -> usize;
            fn fields(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl TypeFieldDump>;
            fn write_header(&self, header: &mut TypeHeaderPc) -> Result<()>;
            fn write_fields(&self, fields: &mut [TypeFieldPc]) -> Result<()>;
            fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                let header = TypeHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                self.write_header(header).context("write header")?;
                let fields = TypeFieldPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.fields_len())
                    .context("fields")?;
                self.write_fields(fields).context("write fileds")?;
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size(&self) -> usize {
                TypeHeaderPc::size_of() + self.fields_len() * TypeFieldPc::size_of()
            }
        }

                };

        impl ObjPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                mut offset: usize,
                types: &IndexMap<u32, TypePc>,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let header = ObjHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
                offset += header.size();
                let ts = types
                    .get(&header.key.to_native())
                    .ok_or(
                        ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                            ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                    format_args!("Missing Key {0:?}", header.key.to_native()),
                                )
                            }),
                        ),
                    )?
                    .fields();
                let mut fields = IndexMap::with_capacity(ts.len());
                for t in ts {
                    fields
                        .insert(
                            t.key.into(),
                            BaseTypePc::from_bytes(
                                    src,
                                    offset + t.offset.to_native() as usize,
                                    t.kind.to_native(),
                                )
                                .with_context(|| {
                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                            format_args!(
                                                "{0}field {1}",
                                                if let Some(BaseTypePc::GUID(o)) = fields
                                                    .get(&hash_string(b"guid", None))
                                                {
                                                    ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                        ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                            format_args!("guid {0}, ", unsafe { o.as_ref() }),
                                                        )
                                                    })
                                                } else {
                                                    String::new()
                                                },
                                                get_str_debug(&t.key.to_native()),
                                            ),
                                        )
                                    })
                                })?,
                        );
                }
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    header: header.into(),
                    fields,
                    size: header.size() + header.size.to_native() as usize,
                })
            }
            pub fn get(&self, index: &u32) -> Option<BaseTypeRefPc<'_>> {
                self.fields.get(index).map(|x| unsafe { x.as_ref() })
            }
        }

        pub trait DumpObjPc {
            fn key(&self) -> u32;
            fn layer(&self) -> u32;
            fn field(&self, index: &u32) -> Option<impl DumpBaseTypePc>;
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                ts: &impl DumpTypePc,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = ObjHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                let val_offset = ts
                    .fields()
                    .map(|t| t.offset() as usize + BaseTypePc::size(t.kind()))
                    .fold(0, usize::max);
                if !(val_offset > dst.offset) {
                    {
                        ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(
                            format_args!("malformed gameobj {0}", self.key()),
                        );
                    }
                }
                let mut val_dst = dst.split(val_offset);
                val_dst.align(16);
                for t in ts.fields() {
                    let key = t.key();
                    let f = self
                        .field(&key)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("missing field {0}", key))
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?;
                    let mut obj_dst = dst.view(t.offset() as usize);
                    f.dump_into(&mut obj_dst, &mut val_dst, t.kind())
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("field {0}", key))
                        }))?;
                }
                val_dst.align(16);
                *dst = val_dst;
                header.layer = self.layer().conv();
                header.key = self.key().conv();
                header.size = val_offset.conv();
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size<'a>(&'a self, ts: &impl DumpTypePc) -> usize {
                let mut off = ts
                    .fields()
                    .map(|t| t.offset() as usize + BaseTypePc::size(t.kind()))
                    .fold(0, usize::max);
                off = align_offset(off, 16);
                for t in ts.fields() {
                    let key = t.key();
                    let f = self
                        .field(&key)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("missing field {0}", key))
                                }),
                            ),
                        )
                        .unwrap();
                    off += f.off_size();
                    if key == keys::INTLIST_KEY {
                        off = align_offset(off, 16);
                    }
                }
                align_offset(off, 16) + ObjHeaderPc::size_of()
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpObjXbox {
            fn key(&self) -> u32;
            fn layer(&self) -> u32;
            fn field(&self, index: &u32) -> Option<impl DumpBaseTypeXbox>;
            fn dump_into(
                &self,
                dst: &mut DumpSlice,
                ts: &impl DumpTypeXbox,
            ) -> Result<()> {
                let header = ObjHeaderXbox::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                let val_offset = ts
                    .fields()
                    .map(|t| t.offset() as usize + BaseTypeXbox::size(t.kind()))
                    .fold(0, usize::max);
                if !(val_offset > dst.offset) {
                    {
                        ::core::panicking::panic_fmt(
                            format_args!("malformed gameobj {0}", self.key()),
                        );
                    }
                }
                let mut val_dst = dst.split(val_offset);
                val_dst.align(16);
                for t in ts.fields() {
                    let key = t.key();
                    let f = self
                        .field(&key)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("missing field {0}", key))
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?;
                    let mut obj_dst = dst.view(t.offset() as usize);
                    f.dump_into(&mut obj_dst, &mut val_dst, t.kind())
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("field {0}", key))
                        }))?;
                }
                val_dst.align(16);
                *dst = val_dst;
                header.layer = self.layer().conv();
                header.key = self.key().conv();
                header.size = val_offset.conv();
                Ok(())
            }
            fn size<'a>(&'a self, ts: &impl DumpTypeXbox) -> usize {
                let mut off = ts
                    .fields()
                    .map(|t| t.offset() as usize + BaseTypeXbox::size(t.kind()))
                    .fold(0, usize::max);
                off = align_offset(off, 16);
                for t in ts.fields() {
                    let key = t.key();

                        .field(&key)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("missing field {0}", key))
                                }),
                            ),
                        )
                        .unwrap();
                    off += f.off_size();
                    if key == keys::INTLIST_KEY {
                        off = align_offset(off, 16);
                    }
                }
                align_offset(off, 16) + ObjHeaderXbox::size_of()
            }
        }

        impl GameObjsPc {
            pub fn from_bytes(
                src: &Arc<[u8]>,
                mut offset: usize,
                _size: usize,
                gamemodemask: i32,
            ) -> Result<Self> {
                let start = offset;
                let header = HeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
                if header.const_.to_native() != 1296123652 {
                    {
                        {
                            let lvl = ::log::Level::Error;
                            if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                            {
                                ::log::__private_api::log(
                                    { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                    format_args!("Invalid gameobj block"),
                                    lvl,
                                    &(
                                        "lotrc::sub_blocks::gameobjs",
                                        "lotrc::sub_blocks::gameobjs",
                                        ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                    ),
                                    (),
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    };
                }
                offset = start + header.types_offset.to_native() as usize;
                let mut types = IndexMap::with_capacity(
                    header.types_num.to_native() as usize,
                );
                for i in 0..header.types_num.to_native() {
                    let t = TypePc::from_bytes(src, offset)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("ty {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                    offset += t.size();
                    types.insert(t.header().key.to_native(), t);
                }
                offset = start + header.obj_offset.to_native() as usize;
                let mut objs = IndexMap::with_capacity(
                    header.obj_num.to_native() as usize,
                );
                for i in 0..header.obj_num.to_native() {
                    let o = ObjPc::from_bytes(src, offset, &types)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("obj {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                    offset += o.size();
                    if let BaseTypePc::GUID(guid) = o
                        .fields
                        .get(&hash_string(b"guid", None))
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("obj missing guid"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        )?
                    {
                        objs.insert(unsafe { guid.as_ref() }.to_native(), o);
                    } else {
                        return Err(
                            ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                                let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                                    format_args!("obj incorrect guid type"),
                                );
                                error
                            }),
                        );
                    }
                }
                Ok(Self {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    gamemodemask,
                    header: header.into(),
                    objs,
                    types,
                })
            }
        }

        impl From<&GameObjsPc> for GameObjs {
            fn from(val: &GameObjsPc) -> Self {
                Self {
                    gamemodemask: val.gamemodemask,
                    objs: val
                        .objs
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| ((*k).into(), v.into()))
                        .collect(),
                    types: val
                        .types
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (
                            (*k).into(),
                            v.fields().iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect(),
                        ))
                        .collect(),
                }
            }
        }
        impl From<&GameObjsXbox> for GameObjs {
            fn from(val: &GameObjsXbox) -> Self {
                Self {
                    gamemodemask: val.gamemodemask,
                    objs: val
                        .objs
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| ((*k).into(), v.into()))
                        .collect(),
                    types: val
                        .types
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (
                            (*k).into(),
                            v.fields().iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect(),
                        ))
                        .collect(),
                }
            }
        }
        impl From<&GameObjsPs3> for GameObjs {
            fn from(val: &GameObjsPs3) -> Self {
                Self {
                    gamemodemask: val.gamemodemask,
                    objs: val
                        .objs
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| ((*k).into(), v.into()))
                        .collect(),
                    types: val
                        .types
                        .iter()
                        .map(|(k, v)| (
                            (*k).into(),
                            v.fields().iter().map(|x| x.get()).collect(),
                        ))
                        .collect(),
                }
            }
        }
        pub trait DumpGameObjsPc {
            fn gamemodemask(&self) -> i32;
            fn types(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl DumpTypePc>;
            fn types_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn get_type(&self, key: u32) -> Option<impl DumpTypePc>;
            fn objs(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpObjPc>;
            fn objs_num(&self) -> usize;
            fn size(&self) -> usize {
                let size = HeaderPc::size_of()
                    + self.types_num() * TypeHeaderPc::size_of()
                    + self.types().map(|x| x.fields_len()).sum::<usize>()
                        * TypeFieldPc::size_of();
                align_offset(size, 16)
                    + self
                        .objs()
                        .map(|x| x.size(&self.get_type(x.key()).unwrap()))
                        .sum::<usize>()
            }
            fn dump_into<'a>(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
                let start = dst.offset;
                let header = HeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
                header.const_ = 1296123652u32.conv();
                header.types_offset = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                header.types_num = self.types_num().conv();
                for ty in self.types() {
                    ty.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("type {0}", ty.key()))
                        }))?;
                }
                dst.align(16);
                header.obj_offset = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                header.obj_num = self.objs_num().conv();
                for (i, obj) in self.objs().enumerate() {
                    let key = obj.key();
                    let ty = self
                        .get_type(key)
                        .ok_or(
                            ::anyhow::Error::msg(
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("obj {0} ty {1}", i, key))
                                }),
                            ),
                        )?;
                    obj.dump_into(dst, &ty)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("obj {0}", i))
                        }))?;
                }
                Ok(())
            }
        }

    unsafe impl Sync for SubBlockPc {}
    unsafe impl Sync for SubBlockXbox {}
    unsafe impl Sync for SubBlockPs3 {}
    unsafe impl Send for SubBlockPc {}
    unsafe impl Send for SubBlockXbox {}
    unsafe impl Send for SubBlockPs3 {}
    impl SubBlockPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(
            src: &Arc<[u8]>,
            offset: usize,
            size: usize,
            key: u32,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            use keys::*;
            Ok(
                match key {
                    KEY_POLISH
                    | KEY_GERMAN
                    | KEY_FRENCH
                    | KEY_SPANISH
                    | KEY_RUSSIAN
                    | KEY_SWEDISH
                    | KEY_ENGLISH
                    | KEY_ITALIAN
                    | KEY_NORWEGIAN => {
                        Self::LangStrings(LangStringsPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                    }
                    KEY_SPRAY => Self::Spray(SprayPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?),
                    KEY_CROWD => Self::Crowd(CrowdPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?),
                    KEY_PFIELDS => {
                        Self::PFields(PFieldsPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                    }
                    KEY_LEVEL => {
                        Self::Level(GameObjsPc::from_bytes(&src, offset, size, -1)?)
                    }
                    KEY_ATLAS1 | KEY_ATLAS2 => {
                        Self::AtlasUV(AtlasUVPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                    }
                    _ => {
                        match get_str(&key) {
                            Some(x) if x.ends_with(".lua") => {
                                Self::Lua(LuaPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                            }
                            Some(x) if x.ends_with(".ssa") => {
                                Self::SSA(SSAPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                            }
                            Some(
                                x,
                            ) if x.ends_with(".csv") || x.ends_with(".txt")
                                || x.ends_with(".dat") => {
                                Self::Data(DataPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                            }
                            name => {
                                {
                                    {
                                        let lvl = ::log::Level::Warn;
                                        if lvl <= ::log::STATIC_MAX_LEVEL
                                            && lvl <= ::log::max_level()
                                        {
                                            ::log::__private_api::log(
                                                { ::log::__private_api::GlobalLogger },
                                                format_args!("Unknown block type {0:?}, {1:?}", key, name),
                                                lvl,
                                                &(
                                                    "lotrc::sub_blocks",
                                                    "lotrc::sub_blocks",
                                                    ::log::__private_api::loc(),
                                                ),
                                                (),
                                            );
                                        }
                                    }
                                };
                                Self::Data(DataPc::from_bytes(src, offset, size)?)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },
            )
        }
    }

    impl SubBlock {
        fn from_pc(val: &SubBlockPc, pfield_infos: &[PFieldInfoPc]) -> Self {
            match val {
                SubBlockPc::LangStrings(val) => Self::LangStrings(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::Data(val) => Self::Data(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::Spray(val) => Self::Spray(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::Crowd(val) => Self::Crowd(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::PFields(val) => {
                    Self::PFields(PFields::from_pc(val, pfield_infos))
                }
                SubBlockPc::Level(val) => Self::Level(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::AtlasUV(val) => Self::AtlasUV(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::Lua(val) => Self::Lua(val.into()),
                SubBlockPc::SSA(val) => Self::SSA(val.into()),
            }
        }
    }

        u32Ps3: ::zerocopy::Immutable,

    }

    impl SubBlocksPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, mut offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
            let start = offset;
            let header = SubBlocksHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
            offset += header.size();
            let block_headers = SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    header.block_num.to_native() as usize,
                )
                .context("block_headers")?;
            let blocks: IndexMap<u32, SubBlockPc> = block_headers
                .into_iter()
                .map(|info| {
                    Ok((
                        info.key.to_native(),
                        SubBlockPc::from_bytes(
                                src,
                                start + info.offset.to_native() as usize,
                                info.size.to_native() as usize,
                                info.key.to_native(),
                            )
                            .with_context(|| {
                                ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!(
                                            "sub_blocks {0}",
                                            get_str(&info.key.to_native())
                                                .map(|x| x.to_string())
                                                .unwrap_or_else(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                                        format_args!("id: {0}", info.key.to_native()),
                                                    )
                                                })),
                                        ),
                                    )
                                })
                            })?,
                    ))
                })
                .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                header: header.into(),
                block_headers: block_headers.into(),
                blocks: blocks.into(),
            })
        }
        pub fn get(&self, key: &u32) -> Option<&SubBlockPc> {
            self.blocks.get(key)
        }
        pub fn get_full(
            &self,
            key: &u32,
        ) -> Option<(&SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc, &SubBlockPc)> {
            self.blocks
                .get_full(key)
                .map(|(i, _, val)| {
                    let info = &self.block_headers()[i];
                    (info, val)
                })
        }
    }

    impl SubBlocks {
        pub fn from_pc(val: &SubBlocksPc, pfield_infos: &[PFieldInfoPc]) -> Self {
            Self {
                blocks: val
                    .blocks
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(k, block)| (
                        (*k).into(),
                        SubBlock::from_pc(block, pfield_infos),
                    ))
                    .collect(),
            }
        }
        pub fn from_xbox(val: &SubBlocksXbox, pfield_infos: &[PFieldInfoXbox]) -> Self {
            Self {
                blocks: val
                    .blocks
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(k, block)| (
                        (*k).into(),
                        SubBlock::from_xbox(block, pfield_infos),
                    ))
                    .collect(),
            }
        }
        pub fn from_ps3(val: &SubBlocksPs3, pfield_infos: &[PFieldInfoPs3]) -> Self {
            Self {
                blocks: val
                    .blocks
                    .iter()
                    .map(|(k, block)| (
                        (*k).into(),
                        SubBlock::from_ps3(block, pfield_infos),
                    ))
                    .collect(),
            }
        }
    }
    pub trait DumpSubBlocksPc {
        fn blocks_num(&self) -> usize;
        fn blocks(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpSubBlockPc>;
        fn write_names<'a>(&self, names: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPc>);
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            SubBlocksHeaderPc::size_of()
                + SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc::size_of() * self.blocks_num()
                + self.blocks().map(|x| x.size()).sum::<usize>()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let start = dst.offset;
            let header = SubBlocksHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            let block_headers = SubBlocksBlockHeaderPc::mut_slice_from_data(
                    dst,
                    self.blocks_num(),
                )
                .context("block_headers")?;
            header.block_num = block_headers.len().conv();
            dst.align(16);
            self.write_names(block_headers.iter_mut().map(|x| &mut x.key));
            for (i, (block, info)) in self.blocks().zip(block_headers).enumerate() {
                info.offset = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                let start = dst.offset;
                block
                    .dump_into(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("block {0}", i))
                    }))?;
                info.size = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                dst.align(16);
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    unsafe impl Send for LangStringsPs3 {}
    impl LangStringsPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(
            src: &Arc<[u8]>,
            mut offset: usize,
            size: usize,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            let mut strings = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            while offset < size {
                let start = offset;
                while src[offset] != 0 || src[offset + 1] != 0 {
                    offset += 2;
                }
                let s = u16Pc::slice_from_data(&src[start..offset], (offset - start) / 2)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({

        }

    impl DumpStringPc for &String {
        fn string_size(&self) -> usize {
            self.encode_utf16().count() * u16Pc::size_of()
        }
        fn dump_string(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let val = self.encode_utf16().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            let string = u16Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, val.len()).context("string")?;
            for (src, dst) in val.into_iter().zip(string) {
                *dst = src.into();
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    impl DumpStringXbox for &String {

    pub trait DumpLangStringsPc {
        fn strings(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl DumpStringPc>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            self.strings().map(|x| x.string_size() + u16Pc::size_of()).sum::<usize>()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for (i, string) in self.strings().enumerate() {
                string
                    .dump_string(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string {0}", i))
                    }))?;
                u16Pc::from(0u16)
                    .dump_into(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string pad {0}", i))
                    }))?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    impl SSAPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, offset: usize, size: usize) -> Result<Self> {
            let n = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("n")?;
            let vals = SSAValPc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset + 4..],
                    n.to_native() as usize,
                )
                .context("vals")?;
            let strings = (0..n.to_native() as usize)
                .map(|i| {
                    let start = vals[i].off.to_native() as usize + offset;
                    let end = if i == n.to_native() as usize - 1 {
                        size
                    } else {
                        vals[i + 1].off.to_native() as usize
                    } + offset;
                    Ok(
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            u16Pc::slice_from_data(&src[start..], (end - start) / 2)
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string {0}", i))
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    )
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                vals: vals.into(),
                strings: strings.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    impl From<&SSAPc> for SSA {
        fn from(val: &SSAPc) -> Self {
            Self {
                vals: val.vals().iter().map(|x| x.conv()).collect(),
                strings: val
                    .strings
                    .iter()
                    .map(|x| {
                        String::from_utf16(
                                unsafe { x.as_ref() }
                                    .iter()
                                    .map(|y| y.conv())
                                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                                    .as_ref(),
                            )
                            .unwrap()
                    })
                    .collect(),
            }
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpSSAPc {
        fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn strings(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = impl DumpStringPc>;
        fn write_vals(&self, vals: &mut [SSAValPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            u32Pc::size_of() + SSAValPc::size_of() * self.vals_len()
                + self.strings().map(|x| x.string_size()).sum::<usize>()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let start = dst.offset;
            let n = u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("n")?;
            let vals = SSAValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_len())
                .context("vals")?;
            *n = vals.len().conv();
            self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
            for (i, (string, val)) in self.strings().zip(vals).enumerate() {
                val.off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                string
                    .dump_string(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("string {0}", i))
                    }))?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

        pub unk_6: f32,
        pub unk_7: f32,
        pub size_w: u32,
        pub size_h: u32,
        pub scale_w: f32,
        pub scale_h: f32,
        pub delay: u32,
        pub stride_x: f32,
        pub stride_y: f32,
        pub unk_15: u32,
        pub unk_16: u32,
    }

                values,

        }
    }

    impl SprayPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(
            src: &Arc<[u8]>,
            mut offset: usize,
            _size: usize,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            let n = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("n1")?;
            offset += n.size();
            let instances = SprayInstancePc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    n.to_native() as usize,
                )
                .context("instances")?;
            offset += instances.size();
            let n = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("n2")?;
            offset += n.size();
            let vals = SprayValPc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    n.to_native() as usize,
                )
                .context("vals")?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                instances: instances.into(),
                vals: vals.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpSprayPc {
        fn instances_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn write_instances(&self, instances: &mut [SprayInstancePc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn write_vals(&self, vals: &mut [SprayValPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            u32Pc::size_of() * 2 + SprayInstancePc::size_of() * self.instances_len()
                + SprayValPc::size_of() * self.vals_len()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let n = u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("n1")?;
            let instances = SprayInstancePc::mut_slice_from_data(
                    dst,
                    self.instances_len(),
                )
                .context("instances")?;
            *n = instances.len().conv();
            self.write_instances(instances).context("write instances")?;
            let n = u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst).context("n1")?;
            let vals = SprayValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_len())
                .context("vals")?;
            *n = vals.len().conv();
            self.write_vals(vals).context("write vals")?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    impl CrowdItemPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, mut offset: usize) -> Result<Self> {
            let header = CrowdItemHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
            offset += header.size();
            let animations = CrcPc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    header.animation_num.to_native() as usize,
                )
                .context("animations")?;
            offset += animations.size();
            let instances = CrowdValPc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset..],
                    header.instance_num.to_native() as usize,
                )
                .context("instances")?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                header: header.into(),
                animations: animations.into(),
                instances: instances.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpCrowdItemPc {
        fn animations_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn instances_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn write_header(&self, header: &mut CrowdItemHeaderPc) -> Result<()>;
        fn write_animations(&self, animations: &mut [CrcPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn write_instances(&self, instances: &mut [CrowdValPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            CrowdItemHeaderPc::size_of() + CrcPc::size_of() * self.animations_len()
                + CrowdValPc::size_of() * self.instances_len()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let header = CrowdItemHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            self.write_header(header).context("write header")?;
            header.animation_num = self.animations_len().conv();
            header.instance_num = self.instances_len().conv();
            let animations = CrcPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.animations_len())
                .context("animations")?;
            self.write_animations(animations).context("write animations")?;
            let instances = CrowdValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.instances_len())
                .context("instances")?;
            self.write_instances(instances).context("write instances")?;
            Ok(())
        }
    }

    impl CrowdPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(src: &Arc<[u8]>, offset: usize, _size: usize) -> Result<Self> {
            let header = CrowdHeaderPc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("header")?;
            if header.const0x65.to_native() != 0x65 {
                return Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("Invalid Block Data for Crowd Block"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                );
            }
            let offs = u32Pc::slice_from_data(
                    &src[offset + header.size()..],
                    header.n.to_native() as usize,
                )
                .context("offs")?;
            let vals = offs
                .into_iter()
                .enumerate()
                .map(|(i, off)| {
                    CrowdItemPc::from_bytes(src, off.to_native() as usize + offset)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("item {0}", i))
                        }))
                })
                .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                header: header.into(),
                offs: offs.into(),
                vals: vals.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpCrowdPc {
        fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn vals(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &impl DumpCrowdItemPc>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            CrowdHeaderPc::size_of() + u32Pc::size_of() * self.vals_len()
                + self.vals().map(|x| x.size()).sum::<usize>()
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let start = dst.offset;
            let header = CrowdHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            let offs = u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_len()).context("offs")?;
            header.n = offs.len().conv();
            header.const0x65 = 0x65u32.into();
            for (i, (val, off)) in self.vals().zip(offs).enumerate() {
                *off = (dst.offset - start).conv();
                val.dump_into(dst)
                    .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                        ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("val {0}", i))
                    }))?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }

        fn vals_len(&self) -> usize;
        fn write_vals(&self, vals: &mut [AtlasUVValPc]) -> Result<()>;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals_len() * AtlasUVValPc::size_of()

            let vals = AtlasUVValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, self.vals_len())

    impl PFields {
        pub fn from_pc(val: &PFieldsPc, infos: &[PFieldInfoPc]) -> Self {
            let mut offset_maps: HashMap<u32, HashMap<u32, usize>> = HashMap::new();
            let mut pfields = IndexMap::new();
            let data = val.data();
            for info in infos {
                let link_guid = info.link_guid.to_native();
                let offset = info.offset.to_native();
                let gamemode_guid = info.gamemode_guid.to_native();
                let width = info.width.to_native();
                let height = info.height.to_native();
                if !pfields.contains_key(&link_guid) {
                    pfields
                        .insert(
                            link_guid,
                            PField {
                                link_guid,
                                width,
                                height,
                                ..Default::default()
                            },
                        );
                    offset_maps.insert(link_guid, HashMap::new());
                }
                let val = pfields.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                let offset_map = offset_maps.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                if let Some(&index) = offset_map.get(&offset) {
                    val.vals[index].0.insert(gamemode_guid);
                } else {
                    offset_map.insert(offset, val.vals.len());
                    let mut gamemodes = HashSet::new();
                    gamemodes.insert(gamemode_guid);
                    let offset = offset as usize;
                    let size = (width * height) as usize;
                    let vals = data[offset..offset + size].to_vec();
                    val.vals.push((gamemodes, vals));
                }
            }
            Self { vals: pfields }
        }
        pub fn from_xbox(val: &PFieldsXbox, infos: &[PFieldInfoXbox]) -> Self {
            let mut offset_maps: HashMap<u32, HashMap<u32, usize>> = HashMap::new();
            let mut pfields = IndexMap::new();
            let data = val.data();
            for info in infos {
                let link_guid = info.link_guid.to_native();
                let offset = info.offset.to_native();
                let gamemode_guid = info.gamemode_guid.to_native();
                let width = info.width.to_native();
                let height = info.height.to_native();
                if !pfields.contains_key(&link_guid) {
                    pfields
                        .insert(
                            link_guid,
                            PField {
                                link_guid,
                                width,
                                height,
                                ..Default::default()
                            },
                        );
                    offset_maps.insert(link_guid, HashMap::new());
                }
                let val = pfields.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                let offset_map = offset_maps.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                if let Some(&index) = offset_map.get(&offset) {
                    val.vals[index].0.insert(gamemode_guid);
                } else {
                    offset_map.insert(offset, val.vals.len());
                    let mut gamemodes = HashSet::new();
                    gamemodes.insert(gamemode_guid);
                    let offset = offset as usize;
                    let size = (width * height) as usize;
                    let vals = data[offset..offset + size].to_vec();
                    val.vals.push((gamemodes, vals));
                }
            }
            Self { vals: pfields }
        }
        pub fn from_ps3(val: &PFieldsPs3, infos: &[PFieldInfoPs3]) -> Self {
            let mut offset_maps: HashMap<u32, HashMap<u32, usize>> = HashMap::new();
            let mut pfields = IndexMap::new();
            let data = val.data();
            for info in infos {
                let link_guid = info.link_guid.to_native();
                let offset = info.offset.to_native();
                let gamemode_guid = info.gamemode_guid.to_native();
                let width = info.width.to_native();
                let height = info.height.to_native();
                if !pfields.contains_key(&link_guid) {
                    pfields
                        .insert(
                            link_guid,
                            PField {
                                link_guid,
                                width,
                                height,
                                ..Default::default()
                            },
                        );
                    offset_maps.insert(link_guid, HashMap::new());
                }
                let val = pfields.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                let offset_map = offset_maps.get_mut(&link_guid).unwrap();
                if let Some(&index) = offset_map.get(&offset) {
                    val.vals[index].0.insert(gamemode_guid);
                } else {
                    offset_map.insert(offset, val.vals.len());
                    let mut gamemodes = HashSet::new();
                    gamemodes.insert(gamemode_guid);
                    let offset = offset as usize;
                    let size = (width * height) as usize;
                    let vals = data[offset..offset + size].to_vec();
                    val.vals.push((gamemodes, vals));
                }
            }
            Self { vals: pfields }
        }
        pub fn infos_pc(&self) -> Vec<PFieldInfoPc> {
            let mut infos = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            let mut offset = 0u32;
            for pfield in self.vals.values() {
                for (gamemodes, _) in &pfield.vals {
                    for &gamemode_guid in gamemodes {
                        infos
                            .push(PFieldInfoPc {
                                link_guid: pfield.link_guid.into(),
                                width: pfield.width.into(),
                                height: pfield.height.into(),
                                gamemode_guid: gamemode_guid.into(),
                                offset: offset.into(),
                            });
                    }
                    offset += pfield.width * pfield.height;
                }
            }
            infos
        }
        pub fn infos_xbox(&self) -> Vec<PFieldInfoXbox> {
            let mut infos = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            let mut offset = 0u32;
            for pfield in self.vals.values() {
                for (gamemodes, _) in &pfield.vals {
                    for &gamemode_guid in gamemodes {
                        infos
                            .push(PFieldInfoXbox {
                                link_guid: pfield.link_guid.into(),
                                width: pfield.width.into(),
                                height: pfield.height.into(),
                                gamemode_guid: gamemode_guid.into(),
                                offset: offset.into(),
                            });
                    }
                    offset += pfield.width * pfield.height;
                }
            }
            infos
        }
        pub fn infos_ps3(&self) -> Vec<PFieldInfoPs3> {
            let mut infos = ::alloc::vec::Vec::new();
            let mut offset = 0u32;
            for pfield in self.vals.values() {
                for (gamemodes, _) in &pfield.vals {
                    for &gamemode_guid in gamemodes {
                        infos
                            .push(PFieldInfoPs3 {
                                link_guid: pfield.link_guid.into(),
                                width: pfield.width.into(),
                                height: pfield.height.into(),
                                gamemode_guid: gamemode_guid.into(),
                                offset: offset.into(),
                            });
                    }
                    offset += pfield.width * pfield.height;
                }
            }
            infos
        }
        pub fn size_pc(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals
                .values()
                .flat_map(|x| x.vals.iter())
                .map(|(_, vals)| vals.size())
                .sum::<usize>()
        }
        pub fn size_xbox(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals
                .values()
                .flat_map(|x| x.vals.iter())
                .map(|(_, vals)| vals.size())
                .sum::<usize>()
        }
        pub fn size_ps3(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals
                .values()
                .flat_map(|x| x.vals.iter())
                .map(|(_, vals)| vals.size())
                .sum::<usize>()
        }
        pub fn dump_into_pc(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for (i, pfield) in self.vals.values().enumerate() {
                for (j, (_, vals)) in pfield.vals.iter().enumerate() {
                    vals.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("pfield {0} val {1}", i, j),
                            )
                        }))?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        pub fn dump_into_xbox(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for (i, pfield) in self.vals.values().enumerate() {
                for (j, (_, vals)) in pfield.vals.iter().enumerate() {
                    vals.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("pfield {0} val {1}", i, j),
                            )
                        }))?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        pub fn dump_into_ps3(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for (i, pfield) in self.vals.values().enumerate() {
                for (j, (_, vals)) in pfield.vals.iter().enumerate() {
                    vals.dump_into(dst)
                        .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                            ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                format_args!("pfield {0} val {1}", i, j),
                            )
                        }))?;
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

                + std::fmt::Debug + Default + OrderedData<Self>,
            Self::Xbox: Immutable + KnownLayout + FromBytes + IntoBytes + Clone
                + std::fmt::Debug + Default + OrderedData<Self>,

                + std::fmt::Debug + Default + OrderedData<Self>,

            const SIZE_XBOX: usize = std::mem::size_of::<Self::Xbox>();
            const SIZE_PS3: usize = std::mem::size_of::<Self::Ps3>();
        }
