    pub use wrappers::*;
    pub struct ParseSlice {
        pub src: Arc<[u8]>,
        pub offset: usize,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::default::Default for ParseSlice {
        #[inline]
        fn default() -> ParseSlice {
            ParseSlice {
                src: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                offset: ::core::default::Default::default(),
            }
        }
    }
    impl From<Arc<[u8]>> for ParseSlice {
        fn from(src: Arc<[u8]>) -> Self {
            Self { src, offset: 0 }
        }
    }
    pub struct DumpSlice<'a> {
        pub vals: &'a mut [u8],
        pub offset: usize,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl<'a> ::core::default::Default for DumpSlice<'a> {
        #[inline]
        fn default() -> DumpSlice<'a> {
            DumpSlice {
                vals: ::core::default::Default::default(),
                offset: ::core::default::Default::default(),
            }
        }
    }
    impl<'a, T: AsMut<[u8]>> From<&'a mut T> for DumpSlice<'a> {
        fn from(val: &'a mut T) -> Self {
            Self {
                vals: val.as_mut(),
                offset: 0,
            }
        }
    }
    impl<'a> DumpSlice<'a> {
        pub fn view<'b>(&'b mut self, off: usize) -> DumpSlice<'b> {
            DumpSlice {
                vals: &mut self.vals[off..],
                offset: self.offset + off,
            }
        }
        pub fn split(&mut self, off: usize) -> Self {
            let Self { vals, mut offset } = std::mem::take(self);
            let (vals, res) = vals.split_at_mut(off);
            let res = Self { vals: res, offset };
            offset += off;
            *self = Self { vals, offset };
            res
        }
        pub fn align(&mut self, size: usize) {
            let new_off = align_offset(self.offset, size);
            self.split(new_off - self.offset);
        }
    }
    pub trait DumpData {
        fn write_from(&mut self, val: &Self) -> Result<()>;
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()>;
        fn dump(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {
            let mut data = ::alloc::vec::from_elem(0u8, self.size());
            let mut slice = (&mut data).into();
            self.dump_into(&mut slice)?;
            Ok(data)
        }
        fn size(&self) -> usize;
    }
    impl<T: Sized + KnownLayout + Immutable + IntoBytes + FromBytes> DumpData for T {
        fn write_from(&mut self, val: &Self) -> Result<()> {
            val.write_to(self.as_mut_bytes())
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))
        }
        fn dump_into<'a>(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            self.write_to_prefix(dst.vals)
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))?;
            dst.split(std::mem::size_of::<T>());
            Ok(())
        }
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            std::mem::size_of::<T>()
        }
    }
    impl<T: Sized + KnownLayout + Immutable + IntoBytes + FromBytes> DumpData for [T] {
        fn write_from(&mut self, val: &Self) -> Result<()> {
            val.write_to(self.as_mut_bytes())
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))
        }
        fn dump_into<'a>(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            self.write_to_prefix(dst.vals)
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))?;
            dst.split(std::mem::size_of_val(self));
            Ok(())
        }
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            std::mem::size_of_val(self)
        }
    }
    pub fn align_offset(offset: usize, size: usize) -> usize {
        (offset + (size - 1)) & (0xFFFFFFFF - (size - 1))
    }
    pub trait RefFromData
    where
        Self: Sized + KnownLayout + Immutable + FromBytes + IntoBytes + 'static,
    {
        fn from_data(data: &[u8]) -> Result<&Self> {
            Ok(
                FromBytes::ref_from_prefix(data)
                    .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                        let error = match e.to_string() {
                            error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                        };
                        error
                    }))?
                    .0,
            )
        }
        fn slice_from_data(data: &[u8], count: usize) -> Result<&[Self]> {
            Ok(
                FromBytes::ref_from_prefix_with_elems(data, count)
                    .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                        let error = match e.to_string() {
                            error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                        };
                        error
                    }))?
                    .0,
            )
        }
        fn size_of() -> usize {
            std::mem::size_of::<Self>()
        }
        fn mut_from_data<'a>(src: &mut DumpSlice<'a>) -> Result<&'a mut Self> {
            let val = FromBytes::mut_from_bytes(
                    src.split(std::mem::size_of::<Self>()).vals,
                )
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))?;
            Ok(val)
        }
        fn mut_slice_from_data<'a>(
            src: &mut DumpSlice<'a>,
            count: usize,
        ) -> Result<&'a mut [Self]> {
            let val = FromBytes::mut_from_bytes_with_elems(
                    src.split(std::mem::size_of::<Self>() * count).vals,
                    count,
                )
                .map_err(|e| ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                    use ::anyhow::__private::kind::*;
                    let error = match e.to_string() {
                        error => (&error).anyhow_kind().new(error),
                    };
                    error
                }))?;
            Ok(val)
        }
    }
    impl<T> RefFromData for T
    where
        T: Sized + KnownLayout + Immutable + FromBytes + IntoBytes + 'static,
    {}

    #[repr(transparent)]
    pub struct Crc {
        pub val: u32,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::default::Default for Crc {
        #[inline]
        fn default() -> Crc {
            Crc {
                val: ::core::default::Default::default(),
            }
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for Crc {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field1_finish(
                f,
                "Crc",
                "val",
                &&self.val,
            )
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for Crc {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> Crc {
            Crc {
                val: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.val),
            }
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::cmp::Eq for Crc {
        #[inline]
        #[doc(hidden)]

        type Error = anyhow::Error;
        fn try_from(val: &[f32]) -> Result<Self> {
            if val.len() != 2 {
                Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("need 2 values"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )
            } else {
                Ok(Self { x: val[0], y: val[1] })
            }
        }
    }

    impl TryFrom<&[f32]> for Vector4 {
        type Error = anyhow::Error;
        fn try_from(val: &[f32]) -> Result<Self> {
            if val.len() != 4 {
                Err(
                    ::anyhow::__private::must_use({
                        let error = ::anyhow::__private::format_err(
                            format_args!("need 4 values"),
                        );
                        error
                    }),
                )
            } else {
                Ok(Self {
                    x: val[0],
                    y: val[1],
                    z: val[2],
                    w: val[3],
                })
            }
        }
    }

        }
    }

        fn deref(&self) -> &Mutex<HashMap<u32, String>> {
            #[inline(always)]

            }

    pub fn update_crc<T>(vals: impl IntoIterator<Item = T>)
    where
        String: From<T>,
        T: Sized + AsRef<[u8]>,
    {
        let mut strings = CRC_VALS.lock();
        for string in vals {
            let k = hash_string(string.as_ref(), None);
            if strings.contains_key(&k) {
                continue;
            }
            strings.insert(k, String::from(string));
        }
    }
    pub fn get_str<'a>(val: &u32) -> Option<MappedMutexGuard<'a, str>> {
        MutexGuard::try_map(CRC_VALS.lock(), |x| x.get_mut(val).map(|x| x.as_mut_str()))
            .ok()
    }
    pub fn get_str_debug(val: &u32) -> String {
        CRC_VALS
            .lock()
            .get(val)
            .cloned()
            .unwrap_or_else(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                ::alloc::fmt::format(format_args!("unknown string {0}", val))
            }))
    }
    pub fn decompress_block(
        data: &[u8],
        size_comp: usize,
        size: usize,
    ) -> Result<Box<[u8]>> {
        Ok(
            match size_comp {
                0 => (&data[..size]).into(),
                _ => {
                    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(size);
                    flate2::read::ZlibDecoder::new(&data[..size_comp])
                        .read_to_end(&mut out)?;
                    out.into()
                }
            },
        )
    }

    pub const fn hash_string(string: &[u8], mask: Option<u32>) -> u32 {
        let mut h = !match mask {
            Some(val) => val,
            None => 0,
        };
        let mut i: usize = 0;
        loop {
            if i >= string.len() {
                break;
            }
            h = (h << 8)
                ^ HASHING_ARRAY[LOWERCASE_BYTES[string[i] as usize]
                    ^ (h >> 24) as usize];
            i += 1;
        }
        !h
    }

    impl StringsPc {
        pub fn from_bytes(
            src: &Arc<[u8]>,
            mut offset: usize,
            num: usize,
        ) -> Result<Self> {
            let mut strings = Vec::with_capacity(num);
            for i in 0..num {
                let k = u32Pc::from_data(&src[offset..]).context("size")?;
                offset += 4;
                strings
                    .push(
                        NonNull::from_ref(
                            std::str::from_utf8(
                                    &src[offset..offset + k.to_native() as usize],
                                )
                                .with_context(|| ::alloc::__export::must_use({
                                    ::alloc::fmt::format(
                                        format_args!("string {0} of size {1}", i, k.to_native()),
                                    )
                                }))?,
                        ),
                    );
                offset += k.to_native() as usize;
            }
            Ok(Self {
                _ptr: src.clone(),
                strings: strings.into(),
            })
        }
    }

    pub trait DumpStringsPc {
        fn strings(&self) -> impl Iterator<Item = &str>;
        fn dump_into<'a>(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            for val in self.strings() {
                let k = u32Pc::mut_from_data(dst)?;
                *k = val.len().conv();
                val.as_bytes().dump_into(dst)?;
            }
            Ok(())
        }
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            self.strings().map(|x| x.len() + 4).sum::<usize>()
        }
    }

            unsafe { self.vals.as_ref() }
        }
        pub fn pad(&self) -> &[u32Xbox] {
            unsafe { self.pad.as_ref() }
        }
    }
    impl StringKeysPs3 {
        pub fn header(&self) -> &StringKeysHeaderPs3 {
            unsafe { self.header.as_ref() }
        }
        pub fn vals(&self) -> &[StringKeysValPs3] {
            unsafe { self.vals.as_ref() }
        }
        pub fn pad(&self) -> &[u32Ps3] {
            unsafe { self.pad.as_ref() }
        }
    }
    #[repr(transparent)]
    pub struct StringKeys {
        pub vals: Vec<Crc>,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for StringKeys {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field1_finish(
                f,
                "StringKeys",
                "vals",
                &&self.vals,
            )
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for StringKeys {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> StringKeys {
            StringKeys {
                vals: ::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.vals),
            }
        }
    }
    impl From<&StringKeysPc> for StringKeys {
        fn from(val: &StringKeysPc) -> Self {
            Self {
                vals: val.vals().iter().map(|x| x.key.conv()).collect(),
            }
        }
    }
    impl From<&StringKeysXbox> for StringKeys {
        fn from(val: &StringKeysXbox) -> Self {
            Self {
                vals: val.vals().iter().map(|x| x.key.conv()).collect(),
            }
        }
    }
    impl From<&StringKeysPs3> for StringKeys {
        fn from(val: &StringKeysPs3) -> Self {
            Self {
                vals: val.vals().iter().map(|x| x.key.conv()).collect(),
            }
        }
    }
    pub trait DumpStringKeysPc {
        fn write_keys<'a>(&self, keys: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPc>);
        fn num(&self) -> usize;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            StringKeysHeaderPc::size_of()
                + self.num() * (u32Pc::size_of() + StringKeysValPc::size_of())
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let num = self.num();
            let header = StringKeysHeaderPc::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            let vals = StringKeysValPc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, num).context("vals")?;
            let mut off = dst.offset;
            u32Pc::mut_slice_from_data(dst, num).context("pad")?;
            header.num_a = num.conv();
            header.num_b = num.conv();
            self.write_keys(vals.iter_mut().map(|x| &mut x.key));
            for val in vals {
                val.offset = off.conv();
                off += size_of::<u32Pc>();
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    pub trait DumpStringKeysXbox {
        fn write_keys<'a>(&self, keys: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcXbox>);
        fn num(&self) -> usize;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            StringKeysHeaderXbox::size_of()
                + self.num() * (u32Xbox::size_of() + StringKeysValXbox::size_of())
        }
        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let num = self.num();
            let header = StringKeysHeaderXbox::mut_from_data(dst).context("header")?;
            let vals = StringKeysValXbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, num).context("vals")?;
            let mut off = dst.offset;
            u32Xbox::mut_slice_from_data(dst, num).context("pad")?;
            header.num_a = num.conv();
            header.num_b = num.conv();
            self.write_keys(vals.iter_mut().map(|x| &mut x.key));
            for val in vals {
                val.offset = off.conv();
                off += size_of::<u32Xbox>();
            }
            Ok(())
        }
    }
    pub trait DumpStringKeysPs3 {
        fn write_keys<'a>(&self, keys: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPs3>);
        fn num(&self) -> usize;
        fn size(&self) -> usize {
            StringKeysHeaderPs3::size_of()
                + self.num() * (u32Ps3::size_of() + StringKeysValPs3::size_of())

        fn dump_into(&self, dst: &mut DumpSlice) -> Result<()> {
            let num = self.num();

            let vals = StringKeysValPs3::mut_slice_from_data(dst, num).context("vals")?;

    }
    impl DumpStringKeysPc for StringKeysPc {
        fn write_keys<'a>(&self, keys: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPc>) {
            for (key, val) in keys.zip(self.vals()) {
                *key = val.key;
            }
        }
        fn num(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals.len()
        }
    }
    impl DumpStringKeysXbox for StringKeysXbox {
        fn write_keys<'a>(&self, keys: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcXbox>) {
            for (key, val) in keys.zip(self.vals()) {
                *key = val.key;
            }
        }
        fn num(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals.len()
        }
    }
    impl DumpStringKeysPs3 for StringKeysPs3 {
        fn write_keys<'a>(&self, keys: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPs3>) {
            for (key, val) in keys.zip(self.vals()) {
                *key = val.key;
            }
        }
        fn num(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals.len()
        }
    }
    impl DumpStringKeysPc for StringKeys {
        fn write_keys<'a>(&self, keys: impl Iterator<Item = &'a mut CrcPc>) {
            for (key, val) in keys.zip(&self.vals) {
                *key = val.conv();
            }
        }

        }
    }
    impl DumpStringKeysXbox for StringKeys {

    impl DumpStringKeysPs3 for StringKeys {

        fn num(&self) -> usize {
            self.vals.len()
        }
    }
    struct CompressedDataImpl {
        _ptr: Arc<[u8]>,
        data: NonNull<[u8]>,
        size: usize,
        data_decomp: std::sync::OnceLock<Arc<[u8]>>,
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for CompressedDataImpl {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_struct_field4_finish(
                f,
                "CompressedDataImpl",
                "_ptr",
                &self._ptr,
                "data",
                &self.data,
                "size",
                &self.size,
                "data_decomp",
                &&self.data_decomp,
            )
        }
    }
    unsafe impl Sync for CompressedDataImpl {}
    unsafe impl Send for CompressedDataImpl {}
    pub struct CompressedDataRef(Arc<CompressedDataImpl>);
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::clone::Clone for CompressedDataRef {
        #[inline]
        fn clone(&self) -> CompressedDataRef {
            CompressedDataRef(::core::clone::Clone::clone(&self.0))
        }
    }
    #[automatically_derived]
    impl ::core::fmt::Debug for CompressedDataRef {
        #[inline]
        fn fmt(&self, f: &mut ::core::fmt::Formatter) -> ::core::fmt::Result {
            ::core::fmt::Formatter::debug_tuple_field1_finish(
                f,
                "CompressedDataRef",
                &&self.0,
            )
        }
    }
    impl Default for CompressedDataRef {
        fn default() -> Self {
            Self(
                Arc::new(CompressedDataImpl {
                    _ptr: Arc::new([]),
                    data: NonNull::from_ref(&[]),
                    size: 0,
                    data_decomp: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
                }),
            )
        }
    }
    impl CompressedDataRef {
        pub fn from_bytes(
            src: &Arc<[u8]>,
            offset: usize,
            size: usize,
            size_comp: usize,
        ) -> Self {
            let data = &src[offset..offset + size_comp];
            Self(
                Arc::new(CompressedDataImpl {
                    _ptr: src.clone(),
                    data: data.into(),
                    size,
                    data_decomp: std::sync::OnceLock::new(),
                }),
            )
        }
        pub fn decomp(&self) -> Result<()> {
            let data_comp = unsafe { self.0.data.as_ref() };
            self.0
                .data_decomp
                .set(
                    match self.0.size {
                        0 => data_comp.into(),
                        x => {
                            let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(x);
                            flate2::read::ZlibDecoder::new(data_comp)
                                .read_to_end(&mut out)?;
                            out.into()
                        }
                    },
                )
                .ok();
            Ok(())
        }
        pub fn get(&self) -> Result<&Arc<[u8]>> {
            let val = self.0.data_decomp.get();
            Ok(
                if val.is_none() {
                    self.decomp()?;
                    self.0.data_decomp.get().unwrap()
                } else {
                    val.unwrap()
                },
            )
        }
    }
}
